summary.en: One icon hops for attention, each jump higher, squashing on every landing, while the camera is drawn to it and the rest goes soft.
summary.zh: 一个图标原地连跳讨关注，一次比一次高，每次落地压扁，镜头被它吸过去，其余画面虚掉。

bricks.fits: Introducing one new feature or app as a performer at half-screen size, before it opens its panel.
bricks.notFor: Small icons in a corner (no one sees the performance); text; more than once a film; serious or editorial films.

intent.en: A new feature asks to be noticed, louder each time, so the viewer looks at it before it opens.
intent.zh: 一个新功能一次比一次大声地讨关注，让观众在它打开之前先把目光投过去。

content.en: One icon or app tile in the scene (its rect), shown large (about half the screen); no text.
content.zh: 画面里的一个图标或应用方块（给出它的位置框），拍得够大（约半屏）；不需要文字。

fits.zh: 把一个新功能或新应用当作表演者引出来：半屏大小的图标，在它弹开面板之前。

notFor.zh: 角落里的小图标（没人看得见这场表演）；文字；一支片用两次以上；严肃、编辑感的片子。

pairs.note: after the last landing the icon can open into its panel

en: Leave headroom: the last hop rises 1.2 times the icon height plus the push; measure the top margin or it leaves the frame.
A small icon gets lost: the hop only reads at about half-screen size.
Each landing wants a rising "duk"; silent hops lose half their weight.
zh: 先留够上方空间：末跳高 1.2 倍图标高再加推近，量好上留白，否则顶出画框。
图标小了就看不见：这套弹跳只在约半屏大时成立。
每次落地配一声音调递升的“咚”，无声的弹跳少一半分量。

upstream.summary: 图标表演——attention-bounce 求关注弹跳（图标连跳递增+落地压扁+镜头被吸引）
upstream.use: 半屏级 icon 特写段落；新功能引出
upstream.energy: 蓄势引入

summary.en: A value too big for its chart shoots through the ceiling rule into the headline, hangs, then the y axis rescales under it, the history flattens and the point falls back to its true height with its value.
summary.zh: 新值大到图表装不下：折线顶破天花板规线冲进标题区、悬停半拍，随后 y 轴重标、旧数据被压扁，新值落回真实高度并弹出读数。

bricks.fits: One growth number that is the claim (a jump of several times), shown on the chart people already trust.
bricks.notFor: Ordinary growth (the drama then lies about the size); twice in a film; charts without a y axis.

intent.en: The growth is too big for the chart, so the viewer feels the size of the jump before reading the number; the rescale then keeps the chart honest.
intent.zh: 增长大到图表装不下，让观众先感到跳变有多大再读数；随后重标坐标，图表依旧说真话。

content.en: A time series of 6–12 points whose newest value is several times the old maximum, with the old and new y range, a unit, x labels (≤ 4 chars each), a title (≤ 30 chars) and a total label.
content.zh: 一条 6–12 个点的时间序列，最新值是旧最大值的好几倍；给出新旧 y 轴量程、单位、x 轴标签（每个 ≤ 3 字）、标题（≤ 14 字）和总量标签。

fits.zh: 一个本身就是主张的增长数字（翻了几倍），放在观众已经信任的图表上讲。

notFor.zh: 普通的增长（这场戏会夸大数字）；一支片用两次；没有 y 轴的图表。

pairs.note: the headline total can roll up after the point lands

en: The break and the rescale happen once a film; repeated, they cheapen the claim.
Use real axes, labels and copy at film size (labels ≥ 32 px); grey placeholder bars cannot carry a data story.
Only for a jump of several times: on ordinary growth the drama lies about the data.
zh: 爆表加重标一支片只发生一次，重复就廉价。
用真轴标、真标签、真文案，并按成片字号做（标签 ≥ 32 px）；灰色占位条撑不起数据叙事。
只配翻几倍的跳变；普通增长用它就是夸大数据。

upstream.summary: 冲出框 220px + 重标三联动（刻度换/网格密/旧线压扁）+ 震 8px
upstream.use: 数据叙事段落；分别讲"实时性"、"每个数字是一个人"、"增长装不下"
upstream.energy: 中高（数据即剧情）

summary.en: The block that ends one page crosses the cut changing only its rectangle and becomes the first block of the next page; the rest of the outgoing page rolls up under it.
summary.zh: 结束上一页的那个色块跨过剪辑点，只改变自己的矩形，变成下一页的第一个色块；上一页的其余内容在它下面从下往上卷走。

bricks.fits: A seam between two plakat pages where the outgoing page ends on a solid block the next page also needs: a command block to a bar, a pick to a node.
bricks.notFor: Pages with no solid block; outlined boxes (the block must be filled to read as the same object); seams that change colour meaning.

intent.en: Keep one solid shape across the cut so two pages read as one argument; the colour keeps its meaning (ink the system, accent the person).
intent.zh: 让一个实心形状跨过剪辑点，两页读起来是同一个论证；颜色的含义不变（墨色是系统，强调色是人）。

content.en: The block's rect on each page and its kind (ink or accent); the pages on either side.
content.zh: 色块在两页上的矩形与种类（墨色或强调色）；两侧的页面。

fits.zh: 两页 plakat 之间的接缝：上一页以实心色块结束、下一页也要用到它，如命令块变横条、选项变节点。

notFor.zh: 没有实心色块的页；只有描边的框（要填满才认得出是同一物体）；会改变颜色含义的接缝。

en: The incoming scene must be told (`enterBy: reblock`, `from`) or it draws its own block a second time.
zh: 要告诉下一场（enterBy: reblock、from），否则它会再画一遍自己的色块。

summary.en: A pair of brackets touching in the centre springs apart with one overshoot; the title is revealed between their inner edges like a curtain.
summary.zh: 一对紧贴的小括号在正中弹开、放大到标题级，标题像幕布一样从两只括号之间被拉开。

bricks.fits: A short name revealed as the thing itself: a product, an API or a defined term on a title card or a chapter opening; one sign doing the whole reveal.
bricks.notFor: Sentences, or names over about 14 characters (7 in Chinese); more than once a film (its one overshoot is the accent); products with nothing to do with code or naming.

intent.en: The name is "bracketed out" as the content itself, so the viewer reads it as the thing being defined, with a developer's accent.
intent.zh: 名字被一对括号“括出来”，让观众把它读成被定义的那个东西本身，自带开发者语感。

content.en: One short name or term, centred on one line (≤ 14 chars); nothing else.
content.zh: 一个短名字或术语，单行居中（≤ 7 字）；不需要别的。

fits.zh: 一个短名字被当作“东西本身”揭示：标题字卡或章节开场上的产品名、API 或术语；一个符号完成整个揭示。

notFor.zh: 句子，或超过约 14 个字符（中文 7 字）的名字；一支片用两次以上（唯一的过冲就是重音）；和代码、命名都不沾边的产品。

en: The word is clipped, not scaled: a longer name gets its ends cut by the braces unless the half-width grows too.
The word always shows from the middle out: keep it one short, centred line; lopsided lines reveal awkwardly.
Keep its overshoot the only one around it; other springs nearby cheapen it.
zh: 字是被裁出来的而不是缩放：名字一长两头就被括号切掉，除非同步加大半宽。
字总是从中间往两边露：用居中的单行短词，左右不对称的句子露得别扭。
让它的过冲是附近唯一的过冲，周围再叠弹簧就贬值了。

upstream.name: 括号拉幕
upstream.summary: 一对紧贴的小花括号先在正中出现，随即带一次过冲向左右弹开并放大到标题级，文字 clip 宽度严格绑括号内缘、像被拉开幕布般从中间揭示，落定后字距再细微松弛

summary.en: A star flash blinks at one point and a card is thrown out of it, spinning about its diagonal along an arc toward the camera; it stops dead face-on and a pulse rings out from its edge.
summary.zh: 一点星芒闪现，一张卡从光里被甩出：沿对角线自旋、走弧线飞向镜头，自旋随靠近衰减，到位硬定格正面朝前，卡边扩出一圈光脉冲。

bricks.fits: Producing the one hero object of an opening out of nothing: a product card, a cover, an invitation; dark grounds.
bricks.notFor: Several cards (it is a single production); light grounds where the flash does not read; informational cards read in motion.

intent.en: Make the one hero card feel conjured out of nothing: a flash marks where to look, the card is thrown from it and stops dead face-on, a magician's production that gives the object ceremony.
intent.zh: 让唯一的主角卡像被变出来：一道闪光先告诉观众看哪里，卡从光里被甩出、硬定格正对镜头，魔术师式的登场给这个物件仪式感。

content.en: One card face (a product card, a cover, an invitation) painted at 380 × 540 design size; its content is read only after the stop. No text of its own.
content.zh: 一张卡面（产品卡、封面、邀请函），按 380 × 540 的设计尺寸绘制；内容在定格后才读。积木本身不带文字。

fits.zh: 片头凭空变出唯一的主角物件：产品卡、封面、邀请函；暗底。

notFor.zh: 多张卡（这是一次只变一张的仪式）；闪光读不出来的浅色底；要在运动中读内容的信息卡。

pairs.note: a gloss across the card 8 frames after the stop

en: Keep the stop dead, with no rebound or slow tail; a bounce turns control into physics.
Render the flash outside any motion blur; blurred thin beams split into striped ghosts and look cheap.
One card per production; for several cards use a deal or a flip scene.
zh: 定格要硬，不回弹、不拖减速尾巴；一弹就从“掌控”变成了“物理”。
闪光层不要进运动模糊；细光束被模糊采样会拆成条纹分身，显廉价。
一次只变一张；多张卡用发牌或翻牌场景。

upstream.summary: 午夜蓝暗场上蓝色星芒闪现 0.3s（X 形针状光束旋转 90°+中心辉光放射小光芒），卡片从闪光点弹射而出——极速自旋弧线飞向镜头、自旋随靠近衰减、瞬间硬定格（卡高 86% 画高）、光脉冲 + sheen 扫光，右侧文案随后逐行揭示
upstream.use: 单张卡片/海报/封面的魔术性登场（片头主视觉、产品卡揭晓）；纯黑暗场；需要"变出来"仪式感的爆点
upstream.energy: 高（一次性爆点，定格后即静）

summary.en: A card lifts, then grows into a full-frame window; the next scene grows from inside it.
summary.zh: 画面里的一张卡先抬起，再放大成全屏窗口，下一场从窗里长出来接管。

bricks.fits: Overview → the detail of one item (open this card, enter its world).
bricks.notFor: Two scenes with no part-whole relation; it then reads as a decorative wipe.

intent.en: Clicking into one item of an overview: the viewer feels they have entered that card's own world, not watched a wipe.
intent.zh: 像点开总览里的一张卡走进它的世界：观众感到是“进入这一项”，而不是看了一次擦除。

content.en: Wraps two scenes: an overview with at least one card (its rect on screen) and the next scene, which should be that card's detail; no text of its own.
content.zh: 包住两场：一场带卡片的总览（给出那张卡在画面里的位置），下一场最好就是这张卡的详情；自身不带文字。

fits.zh: 总览 → 其中一项的详情（点开这张卡，进入它的世界）。

notFor.zh: 两场没有整体与局部关系（读成花哨擦除）；镜头锁死的风格（strip、split、scroll）。

pairs.note: an overview of cards to open one from
the card that grows into the window

en: The world inside the window must be the opened card's detail; an unrelated scene turns it into a decorative wipe.
One transition per seam: no white flash or blur stacked on the growth.
Let the next scene really stop (hold ≥ 1 s) after the window fills; drifting parallax steals the read.
zh: 窗里长出的必须是被点开那张卡的详情；塞无关场景就成了花哨擦除。
一个接缝只用一式：放大途中别再叠白闪或模糊。
窗铺满后让下一场真停住（≥ 1 秒）再读；视差一直飘会抢走阅读。

upstream.energy: n/a（技法卡，不占能量位）

summary.zh: 一张卡片压扁成它自己画出的那条线，精确落在下一个镜头起始的线上；英式线形下边压边鼓起。

summary.en: The next scene, ground and all, pushes the current one off the frame from one edge in one heavy ease-out.
summary.zh: 下一场连着底色从一条边整屏推进来，把当前这场顶出画面，快进慢停。

content.en: Wraps two full scenes, each on its own saturated ground colour; no text of its own (the chapter's title belongs to the incoming scene).
content.zh: 包住两整场，各自铺一块饱和底色；自身不带文字（章节标题属于推进来的那一场）。

fits.zh: 换章：同一份东西的下一节、编号的下一步、换底色的新话题；全片每章都从同一条边推，就成了翻页的节拍骨架。

notFor.zh: 进入当前画面的某一部分（用 card-portal 或 viewport-push）；每拍都切的快剪（长长的落停占掉大半时间）。

pairs.note: the incoming ground colour can carry the chapter tone
a chapter title once the push has landed

en: Keep one direction for the whole film; switching edges mid-film breaks the chapter rhythm.
Start the chapter's own animation only after the push has landed (≥ 95 %); two moving screens leave the eye no anchor.
Use saturated grounds; with pale grounds it reads as cards changing backgrounds, not chapters.
zh: 全片保持一个推入方向；中途换边，换章的节拍就散了。
章内动画等推入落定（≥ 95%）再开始；两屏同时在动，视线没有落点。
底色要饱和；底色太淡读成“卡片各自换背景”，不像换章。

upstream.name: 底推换章
upstream.summary: 底边上推换章——新场景连底色整屏从底边向上推入，把旧场景物理顶出画外，连推数章各配一种饱和底色，内容钉死在各自色底坐标系里随底色走
upstream.use: 多章节产品片的换章骨架（每章一个卖点一种底色）；需要"翻页节奏感"贯穿全片的段落切换
upstream.energy: 中

overlaps.note: the next card stacks on top; here the current scene is pushed away
a fast push with drag smear; this one is heavy and sharp-edged

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: One element copies itself into a file of translucent clones receding into depth, holds, then they all rush back into it and it bounces: one is many.
summary.zh: 一个元素瞬间复印出一列半透明分身，沿斜向纵深排开，停一拍让人数清，再全体加速吸回本体合一并弹一下：一个就是很多个。

bricks.fits: Scale from one: many copies, tenants, runs or outputs of the same thing (one prompt, eight shots; one config, every region); the moment a single object is shown to multiply.
bricks.notFor: Different items (use a stack or a wall: clones must be the same content); a static display of depth (the copy-and-return is the point); light grounds without an accent glow.

intent.en: Make 'one is many' visible: the viewer counts the copies of one thing, then watches them fold back into it, so scale reads as a property of a single product.
intent.zh: 把“一个就是很多个”变成看得见的事：观众先数清同一个东西有很多份，再看它们收回本体，规模感落在一个产品身上。

content.en: One element (a card, a render, a window) painted once; each clone repeats it with only the outline and one line. Optional ×N counter with a one-line label (≤ 24 chars).
content.zh: 一个元素（卡片、渲染图、窗口），克隆体只留它的轮廓和一行字；可选 ×N 计数器，配一行说明（≤ 12 字）。

fits.zh: 从一个到很多：同一个东西的多份副本、多租户、多次运行或批量产出（一个提示词出八个镜头、一份配置铺到所有区域）；单个对象被展示为会复制的那一刻。

notFor.zh: 内容各不相同的一组（用堆叠或墙，克隆体必须是同一内容）；静态展示纵深（要的是复制再收回）；没有强调色光晕的浅色底。

pairs.note: a headline count of the copies after the merge

en: Keep the copy-and-return: a file of clones that only sits there reads as a static depth display and loses the point.
The clones must repeat the same content; different items in the file read as a stack, not as scale.
Keep the vanishing point in a corner; in the centre the clones hide behind the element.
On a light ground without the accent glow the faded clones read as smudges.
zh: 必须有“排开再吸回”的动作，只摆一列克隆体就成了静态纵深陈列，意思没了。
克隆体必须是同一内容；放不同内容读作一摞卡片，不读作规模。
灭点放在角上；放在中间克隆体会躲到本体后面。
浅色底又没有强调色光晕时，淡掉的克隆体像污渍。

upstream.name: 克隆纵深回响
upstream.summary: 克隆纵队——主卡瞬间"复印"出 7 个半透明分身沿斜向纵深排开成队，停一拍后全体加速吸回本体合一+弹跳
upstream.use: "多副本/多租户/规模感/批量处理"卖点；一镜讲完"一个=很多"
upstream.energy: 中（陈列-收束型）

overlaps.note: different cards gathered into a set; clone-echo multiplies one
the optional ×N counter rolls one place per clone; digit-roll is the general odometer

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A cover rises from the bottom edge and fills the frame: a gradient (the next scene's ground) or a picture, over the scene it covers, which is drawn by the brick or left to the real picture under the canvas (`from: 'none'`).
summary.zh: 一块盖板从画面下沿升起盖满全屏：盖面是渐变（下一场的底色）或一张图；被盖住的那场由积木画，或留给画布下面的真实画面（`from: 'none'`）。

bricks.fits: The seam into an ending whose ground is a gradient or a picture (a lock-up), where a hard cut would jump.
bricks.notFor: A cut between two scenes on the same ground (nothing changes under the cover); more than once a film.

intent.en: Hide the last cut inside a rise: the next ground comes up over the frame.
intent.zh: 把最后一刀藏进一次上升：下一场的底色从下面升起盖满画面。

content.en: Nothing to read: the cover's gradient stops (or a picture) and the scenes either side (drawn, or the real ones under the canvas).
content.zh: 没有字：盖板的渐变色（或一张图），以及两边的场景（由积木画，或画布下面的真实画面）。

fits.zh: 进入以渐变或图片为底的结尾（落版）的接缝，硬切会跳的地方。

notFor.zh: 同一底色的两场之间（盖住前后没有变化）；一部片用不止一次。

pairs.note: or the stream's own lock-up after it

en: Give the cover the next scene's own ground (its stops or picture): the next clip must open on exactly what the cover shows, or the cut comes back.
With `from: 'none'` the canvas is transparent until the edge passes: put it above the previous clip in the host, overlapping its last beat.
`beats` sets the rise's length (0.25–2, default 1); under about 0.85 beat the edge is still moving on its last frame, so let the next clip's first frame land on it.
zh: 盖面要用下一场自己的底（同样的渐变或图）：下一段开场必须正好是盖板的样子，否则硬切又回来了。
`from: 'none'` 时边沿经过之前画布是透明的：在宿主里放在上一段之上，压住它的最后一拍。
`beats` 设上升的长度（0.25–2，默认 1 拍）；短于约 0.85 拍时最后一帧边沿还在动，让下一段的第一帧接在它上面。

source.path: the source film (the sweep before the lock-up)

waive.all: an own brick from the stream original K (the source film): no upstream shot; checked instead against K at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: The same picture jumps to tighter crops of itself on the beat, hard cuts with no tween, and holds on the subject.
summary.zh: 同一画面逐拍硬切到更紧的裁切，没有补间，最后停在主体上。

bricks.fits: Pointing at one thing inside a busy screen, on the beat; a highlight moment (flash).
bricks.notFor: Two different pictures (that is a cut, not a crop); slow, quiet passages.

intent.en: "Look here, closer, this one": hard cuts to ever tighter crops force the eye onto one thing; with flashes it becomes the film's loudest drumbeat.
intent.zh: “看这里、再近点、就是它”：一刀比一刀紧的硬切逼着观众盯住一个东西；加白闪时就是全片最响的一记鼓点。

content.en: Wraps one still picture (a screenshot or a scene) and the subject's rect inside it; 2–3 crops; the picture must stay sharp at about 2.6×.
content.zh: 包住一张静止画面（截图或一场），给出主体在画里的位置；2–3 级裁切；素材放大约 2.6 倍仍要清楚。

fits.zh: 在繁杂的画面里踩拍点名一个东西；高光时刻（flash 连闪定格）。

notFor.zh: 两张不同的画面（那是切，不是裁）；慢、安静的段落；从不硬切的 morph、thread 类风格。

pairs.note: marks the subject once the last crop holds

en: All crops share the subject's centre; reframing each step makes three shots, not a jump cut.
Put every cut on a beat with a click or shutter sound; silent, it reads as the picture glitching.
Once per film with flash, and hold long after the last cut; a cross-fade of even 2 frames kills the hard cut.
zh: 各级裁切钉同一个主体中心；每级重新构图就成了三个镜头，不是跳切。
每刀落在拍点上并配一声咔嚓或快门；无声时像画面乱跳。
flash 版一支片最多一次，切完要留足停顿；哪怕加 2 帧交叉淡化，硬切感就没了。

upstream.name: 跳切递进推近
upstream.summary: 打断节奏——jump-cut-punch-in 三级跳切推近：同构图三次无补间硬跳放大，逐级逼近目标
upstream.use: 用"打断连续性"本身当节奏器：顿挫推近（A）；与 beat-cut-moves（切点排布）互补
upstream.energy: A 中

upstream.name: 连闪定格
upstream.summary: 硬切当节拍乐器——连闪定格：三次白闪各硬切同一画面的一个裁切（全景→卡片→特写），快门余韵沉降后停在特写收束
upstream.use: 高光段落把"切"本身打成鼓点；颁奖连拍式的仪式感、关键信息的加冕
upstream.energy: 高

overlaps.note: one tweened push inside a window; this one cuts
cuts between two pictures on a shared value

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: Everything on screen is pulled into the block cursor, far pieces first so they arrive together, then the cursor shrinks to a glowing point at the frame's centre.
summary.zh: 屏幕上的一切被吸进块状光标，远的先走、一起到达；然后光标缩成画面中心一个发光的点。

bricks.fits: The end of a phosphor opening, into a burst or a cut to the claim.
bricks.notFor: Mid-film transitions (it is a T2 device: one every 8–12 s); frames without a cursor.

intent.en: Return the screen to its source: everything goes back into the cursor, which becomes the point the next shot grows from.
intent.zh: 让屏幕回到源头：一切回到光标里，光标变成下一个镜头长出来的点。

content.en: A line of type and a tag on screen with a cursor after the line.
content.zh: 屏幕上的一行字和一个标签，行尾有光标。

fits.zh: phosphor 开场的结尾，接爆发或切到主张。

notFor.zh: 片中转场（它是 T2 手法：8–12 秒一个）；没有光标的画面。

en: Pieces that arrive at different times read as a stutter: the delay must grow with the distance.
zh: 各块到达时间不一会显得卡顿：延迟要随距离增加。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A plain pointer glides in to a control, presses it about its tip and an accent ripple confirms the click; several stops make a tour.
summary.zh: 普通光标减速滑到控件上，绕箭头尖按下，强调色涟漪确认点击；多个停点就是一段巡游。

bricks.fits: A user action on an interface just before the interface responds: a segment, checkbox, button or card.
bricks.notFor: Pointing without clicking; a mascot acting for the user; tours of more than four or five stops.

intent.en: A visible hand arrives, slows and presses, so the change that follows reads as caused by the user, not autoplayed.
intent.zh: 一只看得见的手滑来、减速、按下，让接下来的变化读成用户点出来的，而不是自己在播。

content.en: The scene it plays over and 1–5 click targets (tip positions), each with travel and rest frames; no text.
content.zh: 它所在的场景，加 1–5 个点击目标（箭头尖的位置），各带移动和停留帧数；不需要文字。

fits.zh: 界面响应之前的一次用户操作：分段控件、复选框、按钮或卡片被点下。

notFor.zh: 只指不点（用箭头或高亮更清楚）；让吉祥物替用户操作；超过四五个停点的巡游（会变成录屏）。

pairs.note: the clicks pick the rows that then fly to the canvas
a click on the toggle starts the ripple from the pressed point

en: The brick draws only the pointer and its ripple; the control must answer in the same frame (another brick or the scene), or the click does nothing.
Keep the ripple centred on the click point, not on the moving part, or it reads as a trail.
One click is shown once: do not film the same click both as a page and as a close-up.
zh: 积木只画光标和涟漪；控件的响应要由场景或别的积木在同帧接上，否则点了等于没点。
涟漪圆心钉在点击点，不跟着被拨动的部件走，否则读成拖尾。
同一次点击只拍一遍：别既拍整页版又拍特写版。

upstream.name: 分段控件特写
upstream.summary: 分段控件 thumb 位移当主角特写——超大胶囊 segmented control 弹簧浮入，描边箭头光标画外滑入按下，白 thumb 8f ease-out 滑到另一段，到位瞬间新图标 spring 弹出、旧图标收起
upstream.use: "模式切换/二选一"功能的宣告镜头（demo 的 video-shotcraft Prompt→Film、Chat→Agent 式）；一个 UI 微交互撑一整镜的特写拍法
upstream.energy: 中（微交互特写，精致不轰）

upstream.name: 行倒卡上画布
upstream.summary: 复选框逐个自动打勾→按钮按下→三行沿上抛弧线错峰飞出，途中行形态与卡形态交叉淡化，落位带随机倾角；面板行槽塌陷成虚线留白
upstream.use: AI/协作工具"生成结果落到画布上"的叙事段落；A 式讲"已有内容换了个存在形态"，B 式讲"从一句话长出一棵结构"
upstream.energy: 中

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: Numbers round a huge dial sweep 96° and stop dead; the answer at the top flies down to become the first figure of the title while the others blur away.
summary.zh: 巨大纸面表盘上的一圈数字扫过 96° 后急停，停在弧顶的那个数字飞下来成为标题的首字，其余数字原地失焦散去。

bricks.fits: A small number that is the claim, reached by sweeping down from bigger ones (5 min to install, 2 steps, 1 click): a countdown that resolves into the title.
bricks.notFor: Numbers without a scale (an id, a version); dark grounds (the dial is tuned for paper and its blur greys on dark); more than once a film (it is a hard stop).

intent.en: The number is shown inside a range, sweeping from many down to few, so it argues for itself; then the same figure becomes the title.
intent.zh: 把数字放进一段量程里，从很多一路扫到很少，数字自己就是论证；停下后同一个数字变成标题。

content.en: 5–9 numbers of the same kind (≤ 3 chars each) with the answer among them, and the rest of the title after the figure (≤ 16 chars).
content.zh: 5–9 个同类数字（每个 ≤ 3 字符），答案在其中；再给数字后面的标题部分（≤ 6 字）。

fits.zh: 一个本身就是主张的小数字，由更大的数一路扫下来得到（5 分钟装好、2 步、1 次点击）：倒计时收成标题。

notFor.zh: 没有量程的数字（编号、版本号）；深色底（表盘按纸面调的，失焦在深底上发灰）；一支片用两次以上（它是急停）。

en: Numbers on the dial must share one size and weight; mixed sizes read as a chart, not a dial.
The answer must stop exactly at the top of the arc; changing the list changes which index lands there.
The stop and the landing are a few frames apart: give them two different short sounds, or they blur into one.
zh: 盘面数字必须等大同字重，大小不一就读成数据图而不是表盘。
答案必须正好停在弧顶；改了数列就要重新核对哪一个落在那里。
扫停和落位只隔几帧：配两记不同音色的短音，同音连发会糊成一声。

upstream.name: 表盘数字扫过
upstream.summary: 纸面表盘 9 个等大数字沿大弧切向排布，整盘扫过 96° 后减速急停，"5" 停在弧顶随即平移落位成标题首字符，其余数字带 blur 原地散去，标题逐词模糊淡入、末词转强调色
upstream.use: 倒计时/时长承诺类文案（"5 min to install"）；数据揭晓的一拍；需要"仪表盘"语汇的浅底短镜
upstream.energy: 高（96° 大幅扫动压进 ~20 帧，纯冲击）

overlaps.note: roulette-lock laps a row of candidates with a frame and locks on the answer; dial-sweep turns a dial of numbers and the answer becomes the title

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A number changes like an odometer: each digit column rolls a full lap and lands on its new digit, one column after another.
summary.zh: 数字像里程表一样变：每一位各自滚过一整圈再落到新数字上，从左到右一位接一位。

bricks.fits: A counted value arriving or changing in place: a KPI, a total, a score that the next line states.
bricks.notFor: Numbers that are not quantities (versions, ids, dates); more than one rolling number on screen at once.

intent.en: The value reads as counted, not typed: the wheels carry over like an odometer and the width never jitters, so the eye reads the change.
intent.zh: 数字读起来是数出来的而不是打出来的：每一位像里程表一样进位、宽度不抖，眼睛只看变化。

content.en: One number (old and new value, ≤ 9 digits with separators), an optional label (≤ 24 chars) and note.
content.zh: 一个数字（旧值和新值，≤ 9 位，可带分隔符），可选一个标签（≤ 10 字）和注释。

fits.zh: 一个计数值就地出现或变化：KPI、总数、下一句要说的分数。

notFor.zh: 不是数量的数字（版本号、编号、日期）；同屏不止一个滚动的数字。

pairs.note: the total rolls up once the new point lands

en: One rolling number on screen at a time; two rolls compete for the eye.
Only for quantities: a rolling version number or date reads as a slot machine.
zh: 同屏只滚一个数字，两个一起滚会抢视线。
只给数量用：版本号、日期滚起来像老虎机。

upstream.name: 列表堆叠压弹
upstream.summary: 列表卡从画面底部逐张飞上摞起，每张落地压弹整摞、计数器同步跳一格
upstream.use: feed/雷达/收件箱类"每天有新东西"的镜头；强调持续积累的资产列表
upstream.energy: 中

upstream.name: 纸张标题卡
upstream.summary: 一句话逐词压印上纸、一个词标强调色斜体、短划线收束
upstream.use: 章节转场/价值主张字卡；重要功能出场前的引导卡；全片呼吸位
upstream.energy: 低（呼吸位，隔开两段高能镜头）

overlaps.note: a frame-level flip of the whole frame on a count; digit-roll changes one number in place
letters scramble and resolve into a word; digit-roll keeps every digit on its own reel

compare.reason: adapts the library component assets/lib/DigitRoll.tsx, not a shot: no shot isolates the roll, so there is nothing frame-for-frame to compare with

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A pencil dimension draws between two points of a print, ticks at both ends, and lands with a chip of the computed difference while the rest of the print steps back.
summary.zh: 铅笔尺寸线在截图上两点之间画出，两端短刻线，落定时带出计算得到的差值标签，截图其余部分退后。

bricks.fits: The gap between two values on one chart or table, measured on the asset’s own axis.
bricks.notFor: Values on different prints; a gap that is not on an axis.

intent.en: Measure the gap on the evidence itself, so the difference is seen, not asserted.
intent.zh: 在证据本身上量出差距，让差值被看见，而不是被宣称。

content.en: Two points on the print (file px) and their two values; a label pattern (`{diff}`, `{ratio}`).
content.zh: 截图上的两个点（文件像素）和它们的两个值；标签模板（`{diff}`、`{ratio}`）。

fits.zh: 同一张图表或表格上两个值之间的差距，在素材自己的坐标轴上测量。

notFor.zh: 不在同一张截图上的值；不在坐标轴上的差距。

pairs.note: the scene that plays it as the climax

en: Compute the label from the two values; never type it.
zh: 标签由两个值计算，不手写。

fits: any launch argued from published evidence

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

summary.en: A front from the anchor turns halftone dots into square blocks, which re-sort inside out into the next field.
summary.zh: 从锚点跑出的波前把网点变成方块，方块再由内向外重排成下一个场。

bricks.fits: A picture becoming data: audio to text, a signal to a log, an image to tokens.
bricks.notFor: Films without a halftone field; any cut that should feel soft.

intent.en: A signal becomes data before the viewer's eyes: the same picture is reprinted as blocks and re-sorted into the next one.
intent.zh: 信号在观众眼前变成数据：同一张画面被重印成方块，再重排成下一张。

content.en: Two field kinds round the anchor (from, to) on paper or ink.
content.zh: 锚点周围的两种场（起、止），纸底或墨底。

fits.zh: 画面变成数据：声音到文字、信号到日志、图像到词元。

notFor.zh: 没有网点场的片；该柔和的切换。

en: Blocks that agree must not move; animating every block turns the re-sort into noise.
zh: 前后一致的方块不能动；每块都动，重排就成了噪点。

overlaps.note: field-morph changes a field’s parameters behind a front with the dots kept; dot-quantize reprints the field as binary blocks and re-sorts them

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

summary.en: The same dots sorted into piles: each dot crosses on its own (staggered left to right with jitter) to its group's pile, taking the group's colour on the way.
summary.zh: 同一批点分成几堆：每颗点各自穿过去（从左到右错开、带抖动）到所属堆，途中换成组色。

bricks.fits: Turning a heap into the answer: a share, a split, what needs a person.
bricks.notFor: Exact counts the viewer must read off; charts with axes.

intent.en: Make a share visible as the same items moving apart, so the proportion is felt before the figure is read.
intent.zh: 让比例看得见：同一批东西分开，先感到比例再读到数字。

content.en: Dots already on screen and 2–4 groups (count, colour, pile centre).
content.zh: 已在画面上的点和 2–4 组（数量、颜色、堆的中心）。

fits.zh: 把一堆变成答案：一个比例、一次拆分、哪些要人处理。

notFor.zh: 要观众精确读数的场合；带坐标轴的图表。

en: Keep every dot: none appear or vanish while sorting, or the count stops being evidence.
zh: 分的时候一颗都不能多也不能少，否则计数就不算证据了。

overlaps.note: squares on springs into clusters or a column (keynote, any look); here hand-drawn dots crossing on power3 to seeded piles in the ledger look

waive.all: an own brick split from terminal-ledger kit: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the kit's approved example film at the same moments (the style's recipe, card: Differs from upstream)

summary.en: A page lying at a three-quarter angle comes apart: its parts rise along the page's normal one after another, hang while the camera turns a little, then drop back in reverse and land with one thud.
summary.zh: 页面 3/4 斜躺，构件沿法线错峰升起、悬停一拍让镜头小绕、再逆序砸回，一次阻尼落锤收口。

bricks.fits: How a product is built (layers, modules, the stack); an architecture told as one object.
bricks.notFor: Pages whose parts overlap or have no clear blocks; text that must be read while it hangs (it is at an angle).

intent.en: "See what it is made of": the viewer sees a product's layers lift apart and click back, the Apple-style exploded view of its build.
intent.zh: “看看它由什么组成”：观众看到产品的各层升起分开再合回，苹果发布会式的爆炸图讲清构成。

content.en: Wraps one page with 3–6 clearly separate blocks (their rects, non-overlapping), ideally cut from real screenshots part by part; optional callouts are the scene's.
content.zh: 包住一张页面，带 3–6 个互不重叠的独立构件（给出各自位置），最好按构件分别截图；标注说明归场景。

fits.zh: 讲产品怎么搭起来的（分层、模块、技术栈）；把架构当一个实体来讲。

notFor.zh: 构件互相重叠或分不出块的页面；悬停时要读的文字（是斜着的）。

en: Needs the page as separate parts; one flat screenshot cannot come apart.
A big camera move: with dives and other 3D showpieces, at most two per film.
zh: 页面要按构件拆开给；一整张截图炸不开。
大动作：和俯冲等 3D 炫技合计一支片最多两次。

upstream.name: 爆炸分层视图
upstream.summary: 整页 3D 倾斜后构件沿 Z 轴错峰炸开悬停，一拍后逆序合体震屏收口
upstream.use: 把平面页面当 3D 实体拍的高光段落；两式都是"大动作"，一支片合计 ≤2 次
upstream.energy: 高

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: The text of a surface hovers above it with a soft same-shape shadow, then falls onto it piece by piece in reading order; the shadows close into contact shadows and go.
summary.zh: 界面上的文字先悬浮在表面上空、下面投着同形软影，再按阅读顺序逐条落贴回界面，影子收成贴地接触影后消失。

bricks.fits: Revealing a UI's text as the camera arrives; a list, a menu or a form settling into place.
bricks.notFor: Long paragraphs (each piece is one line); dark text on a dark ground (the shadow cannot be seen).

intent.en: The interface completes itself as you look: its words hover with shadows and settle into place, so the viewer feels the UI arrive rather than fade in.
intent.zh: 界面在观众眼前“自己完成”：文字带着影子悬在上空再逐条落定，读到的是界面到位，而不是淡入。

content.en: A surface with 3–8 one-line text pieces (a list, menu or form; each ≤ 24 chars, Chinese ≤ 10 characters); `lift`: three cards to name one by one.
content.zh: 一块界面加 3–8 条单行文字（列表、菜单、表单；每条 ≤ 24 字符、中文 ≤ 10 字）；`lift` 版：要逐张点名的三张卡。

fits.zh: 镜头到达时让界面上的文字落定；列表、菜单、表单就位。`lift`：逐个点名选项再选中一个。

notFor.zh: 长段落（每条只能一行）；深色底上的深色字（看不见影子）；终端风格。

pairs.note: the low camera over the page while its words land
words landing on the gliding page

en: The shadow is what makes it read; on a dark ground lift the hovering pieces' brightness (~1.3×) or it is just a slide-in.
Staggered landing is for a tour; a whole layout entering at once should land on one frame.
`lift`: lift one card at a time and at least 28 px; smaller is not felt.
zh: 影子是命门；暗底上悬空的字要提亮约 1.3 倍，否则就是普通位移入场。
错峰落定用于巡礼镜头；整体登场应全体同一帧落定。
`lift` 版一次只抬一张、抬高至少 28 px，再小就感觉不到。

upstream.name: 贴面游走
upstream.summary: 大倾角贴面游走特写——镜头贴着 UI 表面低飞掠过（侧栏树/顶栏/列表当地形），页面文字初始悬浮在界面上空带同形软影，随镜头行进先后加速贴落回界面
upstream.use: 功能区巡礼（把 UI 当地景飞掠）；配合暗场+霓虹缘光做产品"内里世界"段落；界面内容逐区登场
upstream.energy: 中高（运镜持续推进+元素连续落位，信息密度高）

upstream.name: 接触阴影抬升
upstream.summary: 元素身体感——contact-shadow-lift 接触阴影离面抬升：卡抬起时桌上的阴影同步放大变淡，纸片离桌被阴影证明
upstream.use: 给"位置在变"之外补"身体在变"：卡片点名给悬浮证据；配 2.5D 运镜与逐张点名
upstream.energy: A 低中

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A thick band of colour grows round the frame, then on one frame flips to the other colour of the pair; band, label and content change together with a short flash and a bounce.
summary.zh: 一圈粗色带先于内容长出包住全屏，再在同一帧翻成另一种颜色：色带、角标和框内画面一起换，带一下白闪和框厚回弹。

bricks.fits: A product with two modes (design and code, edit and preview, draft and review) when the film switches between them; a section frame that says the whole view is in one state.
bricks.notFor: Ordinary cuts between shots (the flip says mode, not next); more than one flip pair in a film; scenes whose own edges carry information (the band covers 60 px).

intent.en: The colour of the frame becomes the code for a mode, so one hard flip says "we switched modes" without touching the content.
intent.zh: 画框颜色成了模式的代号，一次硬翻色就说清“换模式了”，不用动内容本身。

content.en: The scenes before and after the flip (often two screen recordings), two short mode labels (≤ 12 chars each) and an optional right-hand mark.
content.zh: 翻色前后的两个场景（常是两段录屏），两个短的模式标签（每个 ≤ 6 字），右侧标记可选。

fits.zh: 有两种模式的产品（设计与代码、编辑与预览、草稿与审阅）在片中切换时；或用一圈框说明“整屏都处在某个状态”。

notFor.zh: 普通的镜头间切换（翻色说的是换模式，不是下一个）；一支片里不止一对翻色；边缘本身有信息的画面（色带盖住 60 px）。

pairs.note: a click on the mode toggle right before the flip makes it read as caused

en: Band, label and content must change on the same frame; even 2 frames apart it falls into three small animations.
Keep the colour code for the whole film: no UI in the other mode's colour inside a band.
The two band colours need opposed hue and a clear lightness gap; neighbours of one lightness look like no flip.
At most two flips a film; more reads as a neon sign.
zh: 色带、角标和内容必须同一帧换，差 2 帧就散成三个小动画。
颜色编码全片守约：某色框里不许出现另一模式颜色的主 UI。
两种框色要色相对冲、明度拉开；同明度邻近色翻了等于没翻。
全片翻色最多两次，多了像霓虹灯。

upstream.name: 品牌画框硬切
upstream.summary: 品牌色画框语法——一圈粗纯色画框先于内容长出包住全屏，录屏窗口落进框内；模式切换时整圈画框同帧硬翻色+窗内布局同帧换，一个 borderColor 干完章节导航/状态提示/品牌露出三件事
upstream.use: 双模式/双章节产品片的全片包装层（蓝=模式A、绿=模式B 颜色编码）；真实录屏素材的品牌化包裹
upstream.energy: 中（翻色瞬间高，其余时间是安静的包装层）

overlaps.note: a change of the whole ground with a build; frame-snap changes only the frame, at once

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: The frame tears into 16 uneven bands that jitter sideways; the hard cut to the next scene hides in the strongest jitter, then the bands settle.
summary.zh: 整屏切成 16 条不等高横条左右错位抖动，抖得最猛时硬切到下一场，再抖几下归位。

bricks.fits: A state jump of the same screen: deploying → live, before → after, off → on; two scenes on one grid.
bricks.notFor: Calm or warm films; two unrelated scenes (it then reads as a broken page); more than once a minute.

intent.en: The system switches state in one jolt: the page tears into bands but stays whole, so the viewer reads a digital jump, not a broken screen.
intent.zh: 系统一下子跳到新状态：页面撕成横条但每条完整，观众读到的是数字式跳变，而不是页面坏了。

content.en: Wraps two scenes of the same screen on one grid (before and after a state change); no text of its own; the scenes need an opaque ground.
content.zh: 包住同一界面的两个状态（同一网格的前后两场）；自身不带文字；两场都要有不透明的底。

fits.zh: 同一界面的状态跳变：部署中 → 已上线、前 → 后、关 → 开；同一网格上的两场。

notFor.zh: 安静或温暖的片子；两场毫不相关（读成页面坏了）；一分钟内用两次以上。

pairs.note: a status word landing right after the jump

en: Bands only, never blocks: once the page breaks into tiles it reads as destroyed.
The cut must hide in the strongest jitter; a cut on a still frame loses the cover.
High-energy seam: keep it away from other loud transitions (whip, crash) or they cancel out.
zh: 只做横条，不碎成方块；一碎块就读成页面被破坏。
硬切必须藏在抖得最猛的那几帧；切在静止帧上就失去掩护。
高能转场：别和甩镜、撞击等其他响的转场挤在一起，互相抵消。

upstream.name: 故障条带错位
upstream.summary: 撕裂转场——glitch-displace 噪声撕裂（16 横条错位抖动中硬切），数字故障语义的条带级撕裂
upstream.use: 高能换页：数字故障/断裂语义；页面完整性不破、能量拉满的条带级撕裂
upstream.energy: 高

overlaps.note: frame-level slices that smear the scenes into each other; this one keeps each band whole and cuts

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A line decodes in reading order: each cell flickers through the line's own alphabet and locks left to right; digits never flicker through other digits; Chinese cells flicker through Chinese characters.
summary.zh: 一行字按阅读顺序解码：每个字位在这一行自己的字母里闪动、从左到右锁定；数字不闪过别的数字；中文字位只在汉字里闪。

bricks.fits: Every title, claim and result in a phosphor film; any terminal-flavoured title.
bricks.notFor: Body text and long lines (the flicker costs reading time); numbers that must read at once.

intent.en: Let a line resolve the way a terminal draws it, so it is read as it locks.
intent.zh: 让一行字像终端那样“解”出来，边锁定边被读到。

content.en: One or two lines of ≤ 4 words.
content.zh: 一到两行，每行 ≤ 9 字。

fits.zh: phosphor 片子里的每个标题、主张和结果；任何带终端味的标题。

notFor.zh: 正文和长句（闪动耗阅读时间）；必须一眼读到的数字。

en: A Chinese line flickering through Latin letters reads as broken text: the pool is Chinese only.
zh: 中文行若闪过拉丁字母，看起来像乱码：字池只用汉字。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A word slams in glyph by glyph from one and a half times its size on a spring, a misregistered ghost flashing under it, the camera punching in on the landing.
summary.zh: 一个词逐字从 1.5 倍大小弹簧般砸下，下面闪过一道套印错位的残影，落地时镜头前推一下。

bricks.fits: Every word entrance of a beat-cut type film.
bricks.notFor: Calm films; body text; anything read while it moves.

intent.en: Each word is a hit you can see: big to small, blur to sharp, with a printing ghost.
intent.zh: 每个词都是看得见的一下重击：由大到小、由糊到清，带着印刷残影。

content.en: One word (≤ 10 chars).
content.zh: 一个词（≤ 4 字）。

fits.zh: 踩拍剪的文字片里每一个词的入场。

notFor.zh: 安静的片子；正文；边动边读的内容。

pairs.note: the full stop landing with it

en: Slam, never bounce: the spring overshoots under 8 %.
zh: 是砸，不是弹：弹簧过冲不到 8 %。

overlaps.note: general text entrances; this is ink's heavy per-glyph slam with the ghost and the punch

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: The ground drifts from a linear to a radial to a conic gradient, each kind moving its own parameters, with narrow cross-fades between kinds.
summary.zh: 底色在线性、径向、锥形三种渐变间缓慢漂移，每种只动自己的参数（角度、圆心与半径、起始角），换种类时窄窗交叉淡化。

bricks.fits: An ambient ground under a title sequence or a launch intro; three phases a three-line title can follow.
bricks.notFor: Behind dense content (it competes); looks with a flat or paper ground; a cut on the beat (it is slow by design).

intent.en: Keeps a still layout alive: a slow, ever-moving ground gives text-only passages a quiet pulse without pulling the eye.
intent.zh: 让静止排版“活着”：缓慢变化的底色给纯文字段落一层安静的生气，又不抢视线。

content.en: No material: it is the ground under a scene (titles, a wordmark); 1–3 short foreground lines laid over it with `over`, one per gradient phase.
content.zh: 不吃物料：它是一场的底色（标题、字标在上面）；前景 1–3 行短句经 `over` 叠上，可每种渐变配一行。

fits.zh: 片头或发布开场的氛围底；三段渐变正好托住三行标题。

notFor.zh: 密集内容的背后（会抢）；平底或纸面风格；卡点硬切（它故意慢）。

pairs.note: a line of title per gradient phase
one word held over the drifting ground

en: Darken the text side (it does by default); the conic phase's bright tones otherwise eat the foreground's contrast.
Three tones from the look only; a rainbow ring reads as a show, not a brand.
zh: 文字一侧要压暗（默认已做）；否则锥形段的亮色会吃掉前景对比。
只用风格里的三个色调；七彩色环像演出，不像品牌。

upstream.name: 渐变参数变奏
upstream.summary: 背景在 linear、radial、conic 三类 CSS 渐变间平滑过渡——角度、色标、中心、半径逐参数插值，段间交叉淡化换类型
upstream.use: 氛围底/章节底色的连续变奏；给静态排版段落提供"活着"的背景层
upstream.energy: 低（纯背景运动，为前景内容让路）

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A line of text boils into grain under a selection box and the cloud condenses into a larger mark that sets sharp and glowing.
summary.zh: 一行字在选区框里沸腾成颗粒，颗粒云急速凝聚成更大的短字标，位移归零后清晰发光定格。

bricks.fits: A long line that boils down to one word: a launch line into the product name, a sentence into its keyword, at the end of a film.
bricks.notFor: Text the viewer still has to read when it starts moving (the line is legible only in the first 0.26 s); two texts that do not name the same thing.

intent.en: A long line boils down to the one word that matters, so the viewer feels the message distilled into the name.
intent.zh: 一长句沸腾凝缩成最要紧的那个词，让观众感到信息被提纯成了名字。

content.en: Two texts that name the same thing: a line (≤ 40 chars) and a shorter mark (≤ 16 chars, usually the product name).
content.zh: 指同一件事的两段字：一句（≤ 18 字）和一个更短的字标（≤ 6 字，通常是产品名）。

fits.zh: 片尾把一句宣言收成产品名，或把一句话收成关键词。

notFor.zh: 起动时还得读的字（句子只有前 0.26 秒能读）；指的不是同一件事的两段字。

pairs.note: the condensed name can hand over to the full lock-up with its mark

en: Both texts must say the same thing; a swap between unrelated words reads as a glitch.
The line is unreadable once the boil starts: show it on screen before this move.
zh: 两段字必须是同一件事，不相干的字互换像故障。
一沸腾句子就读不了：让它在这一动之前先在画面上停够。

upstream.name: 文字砂化凝聚
upstream.summary: 整行字爆裂成沸腾颗粒噪点并浮现斜纹选区框，噪点云急速凝聚成更大号发光短字标，位移衰减归零定格
upstream.use: 收尾"XX. Now Live"式上线宣告；长句信息压缩成品牌短标的能量聚合拍
upstream.energy: 中高（短促、一次性的能量脉冲，天然的 outro 卡点）

overlaps.note: characters cycle in place to the next text; grain-condense dissolves the whole line into a cloud and condenses a different, larger word
dots that spell a number from the font; grain-condense is a displacement of the type itself, no particles to count
tiles of a poster gather and fly apart in 3D; grain-condense is fine grain in place

summary.en: An aurora rises slowly from the foot of a light frame, then the ground drops to near black in a third of a second and the aurora becomes an afterglow; the next line blurs in after a gap.
summary.zh: 浅底上极光从画框底部慢慢升起，随后整片底色在约 0.36 秒内压到近黑、极光压成余晖；旧句先虚化消失，空一拍后新句虚化入场。

bricks.fits: The turn of a story told by the ground itself: before / after, “for years …” → “now …”, the one accent of a calm film.
bricks.notFor: A film already dark, or with more than one change of ground; a turn that is not the story’s main one; fast films (the build is two thirds of it).

intent.en: The whole ground drops from light to dark after a long build, so the viewer feels the story turn before reading the next line.
intent.zh: 长长的铺垫之后整片底色由亮压暗，让观众在读到下一句之前先感到故事转了。

content.en: Two lines: the before line on the light ground and the after line on the dark (≤ 30 chars each), usually a "for years …" / "now …" pair.
content.zh: 两句话：亮底上的“之前”句和暗底上的“之后”句（每句 ≤ 14 字），通常是“多年以来……/现在……”一对。

fits.zh: 由底色本身讲的故事转折：之前与之后，“多年以来……”到“现在……”，安静片子里唯一的重音。

notFor.zh: 已经是深色的片子，或底色换不止一次；不是故事主转折的转折；快节奏的片子（三分之二时长在铺垫）。

pairs.note: the after line can enter with blur in the empty beat

en: Leave the gap: the new line comes after the flip with an empty beat, never cross-faded with the old one.
Once a film, as the main turn; never in the same film as whiteout-slam.
Recolour the aurora as a whole with the line colours; changing only the text colour detaches it from the ground.
zh: 留出空档：新句在反转之后、空一拍再入，不和旧句交叉淡化。
一支片只用一次，用在主转折；不和 whiteout-slam 同片。
要换极光颜色就连同文字色整组换，只换文字色会和底色脱节。

upstream.name: 极光升腾反黑
upstream.summary: 浅灰底从底部升起紫橙柔焦 blob，随后整个底色在约 0.36s 内压暗到近黑、blob 压成余晖；文案同步 blur-out 换句 blur-in，换句间留空档不 cross-fade
upstream.use: 叙事转折点（"多年以来…→一切都变了"）；品牌片从铺垫拉到重音的那一拍；深浅色系之间的段落切换
upstream.energy: 由低到高（前 2/3 是酝酿，压暗那一瞬是全片重音）

fits: any with a light and a dark preset

overlaps.note: a peak by exposing to white; ground-flip is a peak by dropping to dark; never both
batch 1: a slow drift between grounds (T0), no accent

summary.en: Two construction lines run across the sheet, then the title is traced in left to right over them; Chinese uses the em box as its guides.
summary.zh: 两条构造线先横穿图面，然后标题沿着它们从左到右写出；中文以字身框作构造线。

bricks.fits: Every title and claim line of a blueprint film; any drafted lettering.
bricks.notFor: Lettering that must read at once (a URL held still); body text under 50 px (guides crowd it).

intent.en: Letters are drafted, not placed: guide lines first, then the word traced in reading order.
intent.zh: 字是画出来的，不是摆上去的：先打构造线，再按阅读顺序写出。

content.en: A label and one or two title lines.
content.zh: 一个标签和一两行标题。

fits.zh: blueprint 片子的每个标题和主张行；任何“画出来”的字。

notFor.zh: 必须一眼读到的字（静止的网址）；50 px 以下的正文（构造线会挤）。

en: Chinese guides sit on the em box, not the cap line: a cap line through Chinese characters cuts them at 70 % and reads as a strike-through.
zh: 中文构造线放在字身框上，而不是大写线：大写线会在 70% 高处穿过汉字，看起来像删除线。

summary.en: The one hand-drawn emphasis: a smooth vermilion underline, ellipse or brace drawn in one go and never boiling; at most four a film.
summary.zh: 唯一的手画强调：一笔画成的朱红下划线、椭圆或大括号，画完不再抖；一部片至多四处。

bricks.fits: The sentence or group the viewer must look at: a rule, a decision, what a figure spans.
bricks.notFor: Decoration; more than four places a film.

intent.en: Point like a person at the one thing that matters, so the viewer knows where to look.
intent.zh: 像人用手指一样指向那一件要紧的事，让观众知道看哪里。

content.en: A target already on screen (a line of text or a group) and the kind: underline, circle or brace.
content.zh: 画面上已有的目标（一行字或一组东西）和种类：下划线、圈或大括号。

fits.zh: 观众必须看的那句话或那一组：一条规矩、一个决定、一个数字涵盖的范围。

notFor.zh: 装饰；一部片超过四处。

en: At most four a film; a fifth makes none of them stand out.
Draw it once and keep it still; a boiling line reads as noise.
zh: 一部片至多四处，第五处会让所有标记都不突出。
一笔画成后静止；抖动的线像噪声。

overlaps.note: a marker under one word of a title (keynote); here a smooth vermilion stroke whose geometry is measured from the target
a grease-pencil loop on a contact sheet (keynote)

summary.en: A block is hung on the thread: a point lights on the spine, a short light reaches right along the hook, and the block opens from its left edge along it (width 0 → full, content clipped as it widens). Played backwards, it folds back into the thread.
summary.zh: 一个块挂上线：主干上亮一个点，一道短光向右伸出成挂钩，块从左边沿挂钩展开（宽度从 0 到满，内容随宽度裁切）。倒放就是折回线里。

bricks.fits: Bringing an interface block in from the thread, or folding it back.
bricks.notFor: A block that should fly in from off-screen; a full-screen panel.

intent.en: Every piece of interface comes out of the thread and goes back into it.
intent.zh: 每块界面都从线里出来、又回到线里。

content.en: Nothing to read in the move: the block's rectangle (its content is the block's).
content.zh: 动作本身没有字：块的位置（内容属于块）。

fits.zh: 把界面块从线上带出来，或折回去。

notFor.zh: 要从画外飞进来的块；整屏面板。

pairs.note: the other way out: squashed into the line

en: Open from the hook's side only; a centred scale-up loses the sense of hanging.
Clip the content with the width: content that fades in after the box looks like a second step.
zh: 只从挂钩那一侧展开；居中放大就没了“挂着”的感觉。
内容随宽度裁切：盒子开完再淡入内容，看起来像多了一步。

source.path: assets/templates/stream/film.js renderChat (the hook: a point 64 px below the block's top, the reach); plan.js cardAt (0.45 s, ease-in-out cubic)

summary.en: The camera winds back and crashes into one card; three frames of negative with focus lines hit, then the clean close-up shakes still.
summary.zh: 镜头先往后收、再急推撞进一张卡；撞停的三帧画面翻成负片、炸出集中线，随后干净的特写抖几下停稳。

bricks.fits: The one hit of a film: a card, a number or a word that lands as the climax, on the drop.
bricks.notFor: Anything but the single peak; paper and ink styles (use plate-slip); calm or serious products.

intent.en: The film's one hit lands with force: three negative frames bite into time, so the viewer feels the blow rather than sees a picture.
intent.zh: 全片唯一的一拳打实：三帧负片把时间咬住，观众感到的是冲击力，而不是看到一张图。

content.en: The scene and one target card in it (its rect): a card, a number or a word that is the climax; no extra text.
content.zh: 场景和其中一张目标卡（给出位置框）：作为高潮的卡片、数字或词；不需要额外文字。

fits.zh: 全片唯一的那一击：作为高潮的卡片、数字或词，落在音乐的 drop 上。

notFor.zh: 除那一个高潮以外的任何地方；纸墨风格（用 plate-slip）；调性安静或严肃的产品。

en: Once a film, at the peak; a second one makes the punch a habit. Never with whiteout-slam or plate-slip in one film.
The negative frames must land with an impact sound on the same frame; silent, they read as a broken frame.
Do not stack it with another time remap (freeze, speed ramp) in the same shot.
zh: 一支片只用一次、用在高潮；第二次就成了习惯。不和 whiteout-slam、plate-slip 同片。
负片帧必须和撞击音效同帧落下，无声的负片读成坏帧。
同一镜头别再叠别的时间重映射（顿帧、变速）。

upstream.name: 动漫打击帧
upstream.summary: crash-zoom 撞停的 3f 整幅负片反色 + 放射集中线 + 红青色散，第 4f 全撤
upstream.use: 元素落位/撞击的"命中一瞬"——给砸入、撞停加游戏级手感；按强度阶梯选式
upstream.energy: 高（瞬时冲击）

overlaps.note: batch 1 adds punch: impact to it; impact-frame keeps its own crash so the hit has an approach, push: false hits in place
the film’s one peak by white exposure; never both in one film
the paper-and-ink hit; one of the two per film

summary.en: The camera pulls back from a close-up of one card while its neighbours go out one by one, nearest first, until the card hangs alone and lit in the dark.
summary.zh: 从一张卡的特写缓缓后拉，周围的卡按离它的远近由近到远逐张熄灭，最后暗场中央只剩这一张发光的卡。

bricks.fits: The one number or claim the film is for; an ending that narrows to a single item.
bricks.notFor: Showing how items relate (it removes them); bright, busy films that should stay open.

intent.en: "In the end, only this one thing": everything around one card goes dark as the camera pulls away, a quiet, heavy close on the point the film is for.
intent.zh: “最后只剩这一件事”：镜头后拉、周围逐张熄灭，安静而有分量地收在全片要说的那一点上。

content.en: One hero card (a number or a claim, ≤ 24 chars, Chinese ≤ 10 characters) among 4–8 neighbour cards whose content does not matter.
content.zh: 一张主卡（一个数字或一句主张，≤ 24 字符、中文 ≤ 10 字），周围 4–8 张邻卡，内容不重要。

fits.zh: 全片为之而来的那个数字或主张；收窄到一项的结尾。

notFor.zh: 要展示几项之间的关系（它把它们删掉了）；明亮热闹、应当保持开放的片子。

pairs.note: the claim landing on the lone card

en: At the end of a film, do not follow it with an opening move such as group-photo: one closes, the other opens.
Do not stack it with another time or camera trick in the same shot.
zh: 放在片尾时，别再接 group-photo 这类“放开”的收尾：一收一放会打架。
同一镜头别再叠别的时间或运镜手法。

upstream.name: 拉远孤立
upstream.summary: 从发光主卡特写后拉，兄弟卡按距离错峰熄灭、背景沉黑，孤卡悬在暗场中央
upstream.use: 情绪节点（震撼/收束）的运镜语言；与 space-camera-moves 的"炫技大动作"互补——这两式动作小、情绪重
upstream.energy: A 高 / B 低收

overlaps.note: pulls back to reveal a device bezel; nothing goes out
hops between cells of a grid
a band of light picks one item; the camera stays

summary.en: A scene in the dark is shown only where a lamp falls: a spot swings and opens like an iris, grows from a corner, or crosses and leaves the scene dark.
summary.zh: 黑场里只有灯照到的地方才看得见：光斑像钟摆一样摆动后光圈张开，或从角落匀速扩张点亮，或匀速扫过、照到即亮光走即暗。

bricks.fits: A dark opening or a dark section that introduces a title or a panel: the light decides what the viewer sees.
bricks.notFor: Light styles (a lamp on a light ground shows nothing); more than one dark section a film; more than two light effects in all.

intent.en: In the dark the viewer sees only what the light gives, so the lamp decides what appears and when: lighting as camera and edit.
intent.zh: 黑暗里观众只看得见光给的东西，由灯决定什么登场、何时登场：光就是运镜和剪辑。

content.en: One scene to light: a title (≤ 24 chars) or a UI panel; for pass and pan an edge for the light to run along.
content.zh: 一个要被照亮的场景：标题（≤ 10 字）或一块界面面板；pass、pan 两式还要给光贴着走的边。

fits.zh: 黑场开场或暗色段落里引出一个标题或一块面板：光决定观众看什么。

notFor.zh: 浅色风格（浅底上的灯什么也照不出）；一支片不止一个暗段；全片光效加起来超过两次。

en: Dark grounds only: on a light ground the light shows nothing.
All light effects together at most twice a film; light cheapens fastest.
grow, pass and pan must move at constant speed (an eased light looks intentional, not a searchlight), and a grow radius too large saturates in the first quarter.
pass and pan need the edge light running with them; a bare spot has no identity.
zh: 只用于深底：浅底上光照不出东西。
全片光效合计最多两次，光是最快掉价的手法。
grow、pass、pan 必须匀速（带缓动的光像有意图，不像探照灯）；grow 终值半径过大会在前四分之一就饱和。
pass、pan 要带贴边光线同行，裸聚光没有身份。

upstream.name: 聚光扫字
upstream.summary: 双层同文本：暗版 0.07 常驻，亮版 radial mask 随光斑走，锥形光摆两个来回后全亮定格
upstream.use: 把光当另一种笔触（扫/擦）：暗场标题揭示（A）、主角卡加冕（B）
upstream.energy: A 中 / B 低

upstream.name: 角落匀速显影
upstream.summary: 角落匀速显影：左上角径向聚光半径严格 linear 扩张，照到显影照不到沉黑，最终全屏亮起——光即转场
upstream.use: 暗色调品牌片里逐个介绍 UI 面板/功能区；黑场开场把界面"点亮"登场；段落间光转场
upstream.energy: 中低（克制、神秘感，爆点在"亮起"瞬间）

upstream.use: 暗色调品牌片里逐个介绍 UI 面板/功能区；黑场开场把界面"点亮"登场；段落间光转场

upstream.use: 暗色调品牌片里逐个介绍 UI 面板/功能区；黑场开场把界面"点亮"登场；段落间光转场
upstream.energy: 中低（克制、神秘感，爆点在"亮起"瞬间）

a hard band left lit on an asset, T0, light grounds too

summary.en: Into one layer of an overview: the other layers are pushed away and fade while the focus layer grows into its detail layout, a loop pill becoming a circle.
summary.zh: 放大总图的某一层：其他层被推开淡出，焦点层长成细节布局，循环药丸变成圆。

bricks.fits: Going from a system map into one part, and back.
bricks.notFor: Camera moves through a scene; zooming into a picture or a screenshot.

intent.en: Keep the viewer sure which overview cell became which detail part.
intent.zh: 让观众确定总图里的哪一格变成了细节里的哪个部件。

content.en: An overview with a focus layer, and the detail layout of its parts.
content.zh: 带焦点层的总图，以及它的部件在细节里的布局。

fits.zh: 从系统总图进入某一部分，再回来。

notFor.zh: 镜头在场景里移动；放大图片或截图。

en: Keep the overview's left-to-right order in the detail so no part crosses another.
The layers below the focus fade at once (0.3 s), or they cross the presenter reserve as they grow.
zh: 细节里保持总图的左右顺序，部件不交叉。
焦点下面的层要马上淡出（0.3 秒），否则放大时会压到主讲人预留区。

summary.en: A set of tiles moves from one layout to another, tile after tile: each one lifts off the page, travels to its new place, takes its new size and settles into its turn.
summary.zh: 一组瓦片从一种排版逐片换到另一种：每片先抬起、走到新位置，再长成新尺寸、落定到新角度。

bricks.fits: Re-sorting a gallery, a storyboard or a set of screenshots; showing one set of items in a second arrangement (archive, feature, fan).
bricks.notFor: Content that changes while it moves (use a scene); one or two tiles (use card-portal or a push); text-heavy tiles (the lift and the turn blur small text).

intent.en: The layout itself is thinking: the same set of items re-sorts into a new arrangement while the eye follows each one, so the viewer sees one collection read another way.
intent.zh: 让观众看见“布局在思考”：同一批内容换一种排法，每一片都能被眼睛跟到新位置，读到“同样的东西，另一种看法”。

content.en: 8–12 tiles of pictures or screenshots (little or no text) and two layouts among grid, mosaic and cascade; pictures with their subject near the centre (cascade crops to portrait).
content.zh: 8–12 张图片或截图瓦片（少字或无字），在 grid、mosaic、cascade 中选两种排法；主体放在画面中部（cascade 会裁成竖幅）。

fits.zh: 重排图库、分镜板或一组截图；把同一批内容换一种排法给观众看（档案 → 精选 → 摊开）。

notFor.zh: 移动时内容也在变（用场景）；只有一两片（用 card-portal 或推）；满是小字的瓦片（抬起和旋转会糊）。

pairs.note: the full screen around it: switch, caption and headline

en: Put the subject of each picture near its centre; portrait prints crop landscape pictures to a strip.
zh: 每张图的主体放在中部；竖幅相纸会把横图裁成中间一条。

upstream.name: 三段布局重排
upstream.summary: 12 张瓦片在规则网格、feature mosaic、对角瀑布串三种排版间连续变形，位置宽高各自插值、逐片微错峰，段间留 hold
upstream.use: "同一批内容多种看法"的陈列转场：作品集/模板库/相册产品的布局能力展示
upstream.energy: 中（连续流动的重排，无爆点，气质从容）

summary.en: The first word fills the screen and drifts closer, then shrinks into its place as the line slides home; the other words are pushed in after it.
summary.zh: 首词先以 2.3 倍占满画面并继续推近，再沿同一条曲线缩回、整行滑回原位，后面的词从右侧依次推入成句。

bricks.fits: A line whose first word or phrase is the subject (a product name, "Introducing", "Weekly review,"): the lead alone first, then the sentence it belongs to; a launch-style opening.
bricks.notFor: Lines whose key word is not first; lines over about 32 characters (14 in Chinese), or a lead over about 14 characters (at 2.3× it leaves the frame).

intent.en: Reading order becomes physical order: the viewer is made to read the lead word alone first, then sees the sentence grow round it, and has read the subject twice.
intent.zh: 把阅读顺序做成物理顺序：观众被迫先单独读首词，再看整句围绕它长出来，落定时主词已经读了两遍。

content.en: One line (≤ 32 chars) whose first word or phrase (≤ 14 chars) is the subject; optional sub line (≤ 50 chars).
content.zh: 一句话（≤ 14 字），首词或首个词组（≤ 6 字，或一个拉丁字母产品名）就是主语；副行可选（≤ 22 字）。

fits.zh: 首词或首个词组就是主语的一句话（产品名、“Introducing”、“每周回顾，”）：先单独给首词，再补出整句；发布会式开场。

notFor.zh: 关键词不在句首的句子；超过约 32 个字符（中文 14 字）的句子，或超过约 14 个字符的首词（放大 2.3 倍会出画）。

pairs.note: a crash zoom after the line is set hands over to the next scene

en: Only one word in the accent; two coloured words leave the viewer unsure which to remember.
The lead must be short: over about 14 characters the 2.3× word overflows and its end is lost.
A crash zoom after it is the first half of a transition; to end on it, hold still or fade instead.
zh: 强调色只给一个词，两个词都上色观众不知道记哪个。
首词要短：超过约 14 个字符，放大 2.3 倍就溢出画面，词尾读不到。
接在后面的急推是转场的前半式；要在这里收尾就改成静止停留或淡出。

upstream.name: 首词推近组句
upstream.summary: 首词以 2.3 倍字号占据画面中央、hold 期间继续推近 6%，随后一条曲线同时完成「缩回终字号」与「整行左滑归位」，后续词各自从槽位右侧 0.5em 被推进来；支点横向钉首词中心、纵向钉基线（挂载时实测），整行上移的同一时窗副行浮出，停一拍后整幕 crash-zoom 推近失焦交棒
upstream.use: 品牌名/产品名的 Introducing 字卡；发布会式开场第二镜；一句话主张需要"先让一个词占满画面、再把整句补齐"的场合
upstream.energy: 中高（起手就是满画面的大字，但全程只有一次运动，没有二次冲击）

overlaps.note: the closing crash zoom of the upstream shot is viewport-push or whip-push after this brick
type-enter gives every unit of a title the same short way in; lead-word shows the first word alone at 2.3× and builds the line round it

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: The margin’s copy block slides on the hop’s ease to stay level with the region in play, the level tick with it.
summary.zh: 页边文案块沿光带跳动的缓动滑到新高度，始终与当前区域齐平，刻度随之移动。

bricks.fits: A light or a push that moves the region in play while its words stay beside it.
bricks.notFor: Copy that does not belong to a region; a block that would leave the safe area.

intent.en: Word and evidence are read across one horizontal, even when the evidence moves.
intent.zh: 文字和证据始终在同一水平线上读，即使证据移动了。

content.en: A copy block (value, line, note) and the heights of two regions.
content.zh: 一组文案（数值、说明、注释）和两个区域的高度。

fits.zh: 光带或推近移动了当前区域、而文字要留在它旁边时。

notFor.zh: 不属于某个区域的文案；会移出安全区的文案块。

pairs.note: the band hops and the block rides with it

en: Clamp the block to the safe area; a region near the edge leaves the block at the clamp.
zh: 文案块要夹在安全区内；区域贴边时文案块停在边界。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A soft light leak sweeps in from a corner and burns most of the frame at its peak; the cut hides in the peak and the light drains away along the diagonal.
summary.zh: 一团柔光从画角斜扫进来，峰值时把画面烧白七成，硬切藏在光峰里，光再沿对角线退散，新画面已在光下就位。

bricks.fits: A change of time or mood (night → dusk, before → launch); warm, cinematic films; a softer, directional alternative to a white flash.
bricks.notFor: Technical or diagram films that want a crisp cut; more than once a film.

intent.en: A warm, invisible cut: the eye is blinded by a sweep of film light and when it clears the scene has changed, which reads as time passing.
intent.zh: 温暖、看不见剪刀的切换：一团胶片漏光晃住眼睛，光退去时景已经换了，读作时间流过。

content.en: Wraps two scenes (before and after a change of time or mood) and the corner the light comes from; no text of its own.
content.zh: 包住两场（时间或情绪变化的前后），指定光从哪个角进来；自身不带文字。

fits.zh: 时间或情绪的变化（夜 → 黄昏、发布前 → 发布）；温暖、电影感的片子；比白闪更柔、带方向的藏切。

notFor.zh: 要利落硬切的技术片或图解片；一支片用两次以上。

en: Once per film, and it counts as the film's light-hidden cut: do not also use a white flash cut.
The light serves the cut, not decoration; check it at normal speed before keeping it.
zh: 一支片一处；它就是全片那次“光效藏切”，别再另用白闪切。
光为切点服务，不当装饰；正常速度回放看着好才留。

upstream.name: 琥珀漏光烧切
upstream.summary: 三团琥珀柔光沿对角线斜扫，光峰帧吞掉旧页约七成时硬切新页，光退散时新页已就位
upstream.use: 两镜衔接处需要"无痕换景"或"仪式感开屏"时（技法卡，与 shot-transitions 三式同层选型）
upstream.energy: n/a（技法卡，不占能量位）

overlaps.note: a hard exposure to white; this one is a soft, coloured, directional leak

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A line fills its bar, runs out of the scene, the camera follows it one frame to the right, and it turns its corners to draw the frame the next picture appears in; one line, no cut.
summary.zh: 进度条走满，线冲出卡缘，镜头跟着线横移一屏，线在移动中直角拐弯围出下一场的画框，框闭合后画面在框里出现；全程一条线、没有切。

bricks.fits: Process → result (render → film, plan → shipped); a title sequence in a graphic, poster style; one continuous gesture between two places.
bricks.notFor: Scenes with no line or rule to start from; fast films (it takes about 9 beats); vertical layouts.

intent.en: No cut at all: one line, born from something finishing, leads the eye across to the next place and draws its frame, so two scenes read as one gesture.
intent.zh: 根本不切：一条从“走完了”的东西里长出的线牵着视线走到下一处，并画出它的框，两场读作一笔。

content.en: Wraps two scenes: the first must have a line to start from (a progress bar, an underline, a rule) and its position; the second picture goes inside the frame the line draws.
content.zh: 包住两场：第一场要有能起线的图形（进度条、下划线、分隔线）并给出位置；第二场的画面放进线画出的框里。

fits.zh: 过程 → 结果（渲染 → 成片、计划 → 上线）；平面海报风的片头；两处之间一气呵成的动作。

notFor.zh: 没有现成线条可起的场景；快节奏的片子（约 9 拍）；竖版构图。

pairs.note: keep the same line weight if both appear

en: The line must grow out of something already on screen (a bar finishing, an underline drawn); a line from nowhere reads as a screensaver.
A signature move: once per film.
Keep one line language across the film (same weight and feel as other drawn lines).
zh: 线必须从画面里已有的东西长出来（进度条走满、下划线画完）；凭空起线像屏保。
全片线条语言一致（和其他描线同粗细同手感）。

upstream.name: 线条接力转场
upstream.summary: 线条接力横移转场——场景 A 的进度条延伸出画，镜头跟线横移，线在移动中拐角围出场景 B 的卡框，全程无剪切
upstream.use: 两个有图形亲缘的场景之间（进度条→卡框、下划线→图表轴）；一支片子的招牌转场位，Catch Me If You Can 片头的图形接力
upstream.energy: 中

overlaps.note: a rail that presses the next card in; no camera move
a line linking two things on one screen
text running along a path

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A live chart streams past a pinned write head; once, a burst writes through in the accent and is marked on its peak, then the stream brakes to a dead stop.
summary.zh: 实时曲线从钉在右侧的写入头流过；中途一次突发尖峰用强调色写入并在峰顶钉上事件标记，随后流速刹停成真静止。

bricks.fits: A system that is live and has one event worth naming: a spike, an incident, the moment a change shipped.
bricks.notFor: Comparing values (there is no axis to read exactly); more than one event (a second burst cheapens the first).

intent.en: The system reads as alive without saying so, and the one event in it is noticed and named.
intent.zh: 系统“活着”不用说出口就看得出，其中唯一的事件被看见、被点名。

content.en: A title and unit (≤ 24 chars), one event tag (≤ 20 chars) with its value, six time labels and three level labels; the series itself is illustrative.
content.zh: 标题与单位（≤ 10 字），一个事件标签（≤ 8 字）和它的数值，六个时间标签、三个刻度标签；曲线本身是示意数据。

fits.zh: 一个实时运行、有一个值得点名的事件的系统：尖峰、故障、上线的那一刻。

notFor.zh: 比较数值（没有可精读的坐标轴）；不止一个事件（第二次尖峰让第一次贬值）。

pairs.note: another chart move for a different point; keep them in different sections

en: The burst happens once; a second one cheapens it.
Set readings and labels at film size (≥ 32 px, the main reading 120–176 px) and let the chart fill the frame, not a small card.
With another live-chart move in the same film, use each once and in different sections.
zh: 尖峰只发生一次，第二次就廉价了。
读数和标签按成片字号（≥ 32 px，主读数 120–176 px），图表撑满画面，别缩在小卡里。
同片还有别的活体图表手法时，各用一次并错开段落。

upstream.name: 示波流线
upstream.summary: 采样窗平移 8px/f + 余弦包络尖峰 + 刹停真静止
upstream.use: 数据叙事段落；分别讲"实时性"、"每个数字是一个人"、"增长装不下"
upstream.energy: 中高（数据即剧情）

overlaps.note: a frame-level transition along a traced path; live-trace is a chart that streams in place

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A marker underlines one word of a title at rest in one quick stroke; or a highlighter fills its lower half, or a ruled line draws under it.
summary.zh: 标题落定后，一支马克笔在一个词下面快速划一道；或荧光笔铺满词的下半身，或一条直线从词下画出。

bricks.fits: Pointing at the one word of a settled title that carries the claim (new, faster, the product).
bricks.notFor: More than one word per title; a title still moving or still entering (mark it after it lands, e.g. after type-enter); long phrases that wrap.

intent.en: One hand-drawn stroke lifts a word out of the type, like someone circling the point on a poster, so the viewer knows which word is the claim.
intent.zh: 一笔手绘把一个词从排版里拎出来，像有人拿笔在海报上圈重点，观众知道主张落在哪个词上。

content.en: A title already on screen and the one word or short phrase in it to mark (≤ 12 chars, on one line).
content.zh: 一行已在画面上的标题，以及其中要划的那个词或短词组（≤ 5 字，不跨行）。

fits.zh: 指出已落定标题里承载主张的那一个词（new、更快、产品名）。

notFor.zh: 一个标题里标不止一个词；还在动或还在入场的标题（等它落定再划，比如接在 type-enter 之后）；会折行的长词组。

pairs.note: set the title first, then mark its key word

en: Fast: one stroke in 8–12 frames; slower it reads as a progress bar.
Keep it close under the letters; set apart it reads as a divider, not emphasis.
Follow the slant of the type: under an italic word the stroke rises left to right; slanted the wrong way it looks fake at once.
zh: 要快：8–12 帧一笔划完，慢了读作进度条。
贴着字底，离远了读作分隔线而不是强调。
跟着字势：斜体词下的划线左低右高，斜反了一眼假。

upstream.name: 马克笔下划线
upstream.summary: 大标题落定后，关键词下方马克笔下划线从左到右快速描画——变宽笔形、毛糙边缘、微上斜跟随斜体字势，贴着字底
upstream.use: 标题里强调单个关键词（new/free/AI…）；手写感/人味的品牌调性；正文标注式强调
upstream.energy: 低（一笔点睛，不抢标题的戏）

upstream.name: 误删重打
upstream.summary: 打字机 error-retype——误删重打的"改口"三幕剧：打出平庸词 → 犹豫 → 退格删掉 → 更快打出卖点词
upstream.use: slogan/卖点字卡、否定式文案；文字自带时间性的入场
upstream.energy: 中低

upstream.name: 纸张标题卡
upstream.summary: 一句话逐词压印上纸、一个词标强调色斜体、短划线收束
upstream.use: 章节转场/价值主张字卡；重要功能出场前的引导卡；全片呼吸位
upstream.energy: 低（呼吸位，隔开两段高能镜头）

overlaps.note: type-retype ends with the same highlighter bar under the retyped words
the loud peak on one word (a charge of light, or hollow lit solid); marker-stroke is a quiet hand mark under a settled title

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A message travels one connector: it slides out from under one part, rests whole in the gap, slides under the next; its colour says who wrote it.
summary.zh: 消息走过一条连线：从一个部件下面滑出，在空隙里完整停一下，再滑进下一个部件下面；颜色表示谁写的。

bricks.fits: One hop of a message between two parts; the steps of a request.
bricks.notFor: Flows of many packets at once (use path-flow).

intent.en: Give the eye one still, whole label per hop, so the viewer reads what moved before it moves on.
intent.zh: 每一跳给眼睛一个静止、完整的标签，观众读到是什么在动再继续。

content.en: Two parts, the connector between them and one message chip.
content.zh: 两个部件、它们之间的连线和一条消息签。

fits.zh: 消息在两个部件之间的一跳；一次请求的各步。

notFor.zh: 同时很多数据包的流动（用 path-flow）。

en: Every hop between two parts gets a hold, or the chip is whole for only a few frames.
First rounds slow (0.6–1 s a hop), repeated rounds about 0.5 s.
zh: 每一跳都要有停顿，否则消息签只有几帧是完整的。
第一轮慢（每跳 0.6–1 秒），重复的轮次约 0.5 秒。

overlaps.note: many glowing packets into one sink (keynote); here one labelled chip that rests in the gap

waive.all: an own brick split from blueprint-zoom kit: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the kit's approved example film at the same moments (the style's recipe, card: Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

endsMoving.reason: the chip slides under the receiving part at speed (power2.in) and is hidden there once 35 % covered, as the kit's travel does; the part takes over on that frame

summary.en: Gauges self-test: each needle flings round the full arc lighting its ticks, springs back past its value and settles, the gauges a few frames apart; each value pops as its needle lands.
summary.zh: 仪表点火自检：每根指针先甩满整条弧、扫过的刻度依次点亮，再弹簧回落、过冲一下停在读数上；几块表错峰几帧，指针落定同帧数值弹出。

bricks.fits: Opening a dashboard section or revealing several readings at once: the scale first, then the values.
bricks.notFor: A single headline number (use digit-roll or tape-run); values that are not shares of a known scale.

intent.en: Show the full scale before the reading, so the viewer feels how big the number is; a ceremony of systems coming online.
intent.zh: 先亮量程再报数，让观众感到数字有多大；系统就绪的开场仪式感。

content.en: 2–4 readings that are shares of a known scale, each with a short name (≤ 12 chars); optional title and status.
content.zh: 2–4 个有明确量程的读数，各带一个短名称（≤ 6 字）；标题与状态可选。

fits.zh: 仪表盘开场、一次揭晓几项指标：先量程、后数值。

notFor.zh: 单个大数字（用 digit-roll 或 tape-run）；没有量程的数值。

pairs.note: a headline number after the gauges settle

en: Hold every needle dead still ≥ 1 s after it settles; drift reads as a bug.
Stagger the gauges a few frames; launched together they read as copies, not a wave.
zh: 指针落定后至少锁死 1 秒，尾漂像 bug。
几块表错开几帧起动；同时起动读成复制，不是一道波。

upstream.name: 满弧扫针自检
upstream.summary: 指针去程 ~12f ease-out 甩满弧，回程 ~20f 带 5-8° 过冲回摆落真值；多表错峰 3-5f；落定同帧盘下数值弹出
upstream.use: dashboard 开场仪式/性能指标揭晓；A 多表盘开机感，B 单指标大跳变
upstream.energy: 中高（机械仪式型）

overlaps.note: a ring of numbers sweeps and its answer flies into the title; needle-sweep keeps the dial and moves a needle over it

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: Runs any motion brick on threes (each pose held three frames) until a switch, marks the switch with two inverted impact frames, then lets the rest run smooth on ones.
summary.zh: 套在任一部件外：开头一拍三（每个姿势停三帧，像手绘作画），到切换点闪两帧反相冲击帧，之后一拍一逐帧丝滑。

bricks.fits: A climax that should feel faster than what came before; hand-drawn, anime or zine styles; one moment per film.
bricks.notFor: Calm, continuous films (the steps read as dropped frames); dom bricks (canvas only for now).

intent.en: The climax feels faster than anything before it: a hand-drawn, stepping move suddenly runs smooth, and the switch itself is the high point.
intent.zh: 高潮显得比之前任何时候都快：先是手绘式一顿一顿，突然变成逐帧丝滑，换拍这一下本身就是看点。

content.en: Wraps one canvas motion brick with a large move (each 3-frame step ≥ 30 px) and the moment to switch; no text of its own.
content.zh: 套在一块位移够大的 canvas 部件外（每 3 帧一步至少 30 px），给出切换时刻；自身不带文字。

fits.zh: 要比前面更快的高潮；手绘、动画、zine 风格；一支片一次。

notFor.zh: 安静连续的片子（顿挫读成掉帧）；dom 部件（目前只支持 canvas）。

en: Each step on threes must move ≥ 30 px; small steps read as dropped frames.
Mark the switch (a hit sound or a label); otherwise viewers only feel "it got faster".
One time-manipulator per shot: not with time-freeze or hit-stop.
zh: 一拍三时每步位移要 ≥ 30 px；小步读成渲染掉帧。
切换点要有标记（一声打点或角标）；否则观众只觉得“变快了”。
一个镜头只能有一个时间操纵者：别和 time-freeze、顿帧叠用。

upstream.name: 作画式节奏变拍
upstream.summary: 一拍三转一拍一——元素先以每 3 帧一步的手翻书顿挫移动，高潮瞬间切成逐帧丝滑冲刺，帧率量化的突变本身就是看点
upstream.use: 单元素的强调性位移（卡片入场、指标冲线）；需要"手工感→高潮爆发"反差的段落
upstream.energy: 中高

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: One ink shape morphs into another, point for point at equal arc length (480 points), so a card becomes a hexagon without a cut.
summary.zh: 一块墨色形状按等弧长逐点（480 点）变成另一种形状，卡片不经剪切地变成六边形。

bricks.fits: A promotion between two closed forms of the same object: card to hexagon, point to circle, pill to card.
bricks.notFor: Shapes with holes or several parts (split them first); text.

intent.en: The viewer sees one thing change form, not a cut to another thing, so the new form inherits the old one's meaning.
intent.zh: 观众看到的是一样东西换了形状，而不是切到另一样东西，新形状继承了旧形状的意义。

content.en: Two closed shapes of the same object (card, pill, point, hexagon, circle, or a rect).
content.zh: 同一对象的两个闭合形状（卡片、胶囊、点、六边形、圆，或任意矩形）。

fits.zh: 同一对象两种闭合形态之间的升级：卡片到六边形、点到圆、胶囊到卡片。

notFor.zh: 带洞或多块的形状（先拆开）；文字。

pairs.note: uses it for the card → hexagon

en: Let the old content leave first (0.1 s); morphing an outline with text inside smears the text.
zh: 先让旧内容离开（0.1 秒）；带着文字变形会把字抹花。

overlaps.note: container-morph springs a rect’s width, height and radius; outline-morph blends any two closed outlines point for point (card → hexagon)

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

summary.en: A line runs round one element and names it; when it closes the content arrives inside and the line becomes the element's edge.
summary.zh: 一条线沿元素轮廓跑一圈把它点名，闭合时内容进场，线交棒成元素自己的边。

bricks.fits: Naming one card, chart, panel or frame before its content is read: the first appearance of a key result, one cell of a wall lighting up, a frame closing round a page.
bricks.notFor: Several elements at once (the eye follows one line); elements without a clear rectangular edge; styles whose lines must stay still.

intent.en: Point at one element before its content is read: a line drawn in front of the eye picks it out, and the content arriving as the line closes says 'this is what we talk about next'.
intent.zh: 在内容被读之前先点名一个元素：一条当场画出的线把它圈出来，线闭合时内容进场，等于说“接下来讲它”。

content.en: One element with a clear rectangular or rounded edge (a card, a chart, a panel, a page frame) whose content blocks fade in after the close; the brick has no text of its own.
content.zh: 一个有清楚矩形或圆角边的元素（卡片、图表、面板、页框），它的内容块在线闭合后进场；积木本身不带文字。

fits.zh: 内容被读之前先点名一张卡、一张图表、一个面板或一个页框：关键结果第一次露面、墙上某一格亮起、一个框合拢圈住一页。

notFor.zh: 同时点名几个元素（眼睛只跟得住一条线）；没有清楚矩形边的元素；线条必须静止的风格。

pairs.note: the comet head lights each cell of the wall
the split head is the frame that runs ahead of the page

en: Outline one element per call-out; several outlines queued on one screen read as a loading animation.
The line's path must match the element's real corner radius, or the hand-over to its edge visibly jumps.
Do not fade the content in before the line closes; the cause, drawn then filled, breaks.
Use one whole-wall outline light-up per film (this or a blueprint wireframe draw, not both).
zh: 一次只点名一个元素；同屏排队各画一圈读作加载动画。
描边路径的圆角必须和元素真实圆角一致，否则交棒成边的瞬间错型穿帮。
内容别抢在线闭合之前出来，“先画再填”的因果会断。
一支片整墙描边点亮只用一次（本积木或蓝图描线二选一）。

upstream.name: SVG 描线追踪
upstream.summary: 描边生长圈注——一条带笔头的墨线沿元素轮廓跑一圈把它"画"出来，闭合瞬间闪黑交棒、内容淡入；同套路可给标题画下划线
upstream.use: 单个卡片/图表/标题的被点名入场；元素级手法（整页级蓝图描线归 wall-reveal-moves B 式）
upstream.energy: 中

upstream.name: 逐格点亮
upstream.summary: 暗场 3×2 bento 墙压暗待命，琥珀流光逐格描边一圈、内容随即提亮上浮，全亮后镜头缓推收住
upstream.use: 功能墙/卡片墙/整页界面的整体亮相；内容已在原位、要"显形"而非"涌入"的段落
upstream.energy: 中

upstream.name: 霓虹框先行
upstream.summary: 强透视直角霓虹框自左缘两头奔画先行成型，页面在框内由暗转亮，同时框内组件/文字从 3D 上空带同形软影错峰贴落、随页面点亮同步完成贴合，背景霓虹群（demo 为同形框纵深回声隧道）终段熄灭让位
upstream.use: 暗场品牌片里给 UI 面板做"登场仪式"（框先到、内容后落）；功能区首次亮相；霓虹/赛博调性的段落开场
upstream.energy: 中高（三层动作叠进，但都服务同一次登场）

overlaps.note: redraws a reading path in phosphor; outline-trace draws one element's edge
four corners lock on a target; outline-trace runs the whole outline
a marker line under words (typography batch); draw-svg-trace's underline goes there

summary.en: A widely spaced wordmark writes itself: every letter's outline starts on the same frame, grows as one continuous line and closes on the same frame, with a brief glow.
summary.zh: 大字距字标自己写出来：每个字的轮廓同一帧起笔、连续生长、同一帧收笔，收笔时轻轻一亮。

bricks.fits: A quiet wordmark or chapter title at the start or the end of a film: a name that should feel composed, not announced.
bricks.notFor: Body text or anything read for content; a busy ground behind the line; energetic openings (it is one slow breath).

intent.en: Let a name feel composed rather than announced: one invisible hand writes every letter at once, so the word arrives as one calm act.
intent.zh: 让一个名字像被从容写成，而不是被喊出来：一只看不见的手同时写所有字，整个词作为一次安静的动作出现。

content.en: One wordmark or chapter title, a short word or name (en about 4–12 letters, zh 2–6 chars) set with wide tracking; optional solid fill at the close.
content.zh: 一个字标或章节标题，一个短词或名字（英文约 4–12 个字母，中文 2–6 字），大字距排；收笔时可选填实。

fits.zh: 片头或片尾安静的字标或章节标题：要显得从容写成、而不是被宣布出来的名字。

notFor.zh: 正文或任何要读内容的文字；线后面背景很花；有冲劲的开场（它是一次缓慢的呼吸）。

pairs.note: the written name settles into the brand lockup

en: Every letter must start and finish on the same frame; staggering them turns the ceremony into a typewriter.
The line must grow continuously; a mask uncovering it in pieces is seen through.
Keep the ground behind the line quiet; a 3 px line is lost over a busy picture.
zh: 所有字必须同帧起笔、同帧收笔；逐字错开就成了打字机。
笔画必须连续生长；用遮罩分段揭开会被看穿。
线背后的底要安静；3 px 的线在花的画面上会丢。

upstream.name: 字距结晶字标
upstream.summary: 大字距字标全字符并行连续描画结晶——所有字母同帧起笔、笔画像手写一样连续生长、同帧齐收成词；氛围底景上的品牌字标显影
upstream.use: 片尾/片头品牌字标登场（大字距细骨架字标；demo 为 video-shotcraft 全小写）；章节题字；needs 静谧/高级感的收束帧
upstream.energy: 低（静谧仪式感，一次呼吸完成）

overlaps.note: withholds meaning in discrete pieces; outline-write writes the whole word continuously
type laid along a path; outline-write draws the glyphs themselves

summary.en: The sheet on top turns away over its top or left edge, darkening as it tilts, onto the page that lay underneath.
summary.zh: 最上面那张纸绕上边或左边翻走，越翻越暗，露出压在下面的那页。

bricks.fits: A page change between two exhibits of one file.
bricks.notFor: Frame-level cuts; sheets that should stay in view.

intent.en: The next evidence was under this one all along: the change is paper being handled, not a cut.
intent.zh: 下一份证据一直压在这份下面：换页是翻纸，不是剪辑。

content.en: Two exhibits (specs as the scenes take them).
content.zh: 两份证物（与场景同样的参数）。

fits.zh: 同一卷宗里两份证物之间的换页。

notFor.zh: 整帧切换；需要留在画面里的纸。

en: The page underneath is still and whole from the first frame; only the top sheet moves.
zh: 下面那页从第一帧起就完整、静止；只有上面那张在动。

overlaps.note: runtime: a device turned about its centre in 3D; here a paper sheet hinged on an edge, drawn in perspective strips

endsMoving.reason: the template's turn ends edge-on at its fastest on the downbeat; the page underneath (or the next cut) takes over on that frame

summary.en: A lit pair of chips slides together and closes into one learned chip; every row fuses the same pair, the token bar shrinks.
summary.zh: 一对亮起的字块滑到一起，合成一个“学到的”字块；每一行同时合并同一对，下面的词元条随之缩短。

bricks.fits: Any process whose step joins two neighbours into one unit: merging, compressing, bundling; the run decides which pair.
bricks.notFor: Reassignment or routing (items move from owner to owner and nothing fuses): fusing chips would say the wrong thing.

intent.en: Two neighbours visibly become one unit, so the viewer sees what a merge step does rather than being told.
intent.zh: 两个相邻单元看得见地合成一个，观众看到合并这一步做了什么，而不是听人说。

content.en: A board of rows of chips (a run: corpus of 2–6 words with weights); which pair fuses comes from the run.
content.zh: 一块由芯片行组成的板（一次运行：2–6 个带权重的词）；哪一对合并由运行决定。

fits.zh: 任何把两个相邻单元合成一个的过程：合并、压缩、打包；由运行决定合哪一对。

notFor.zh: 重新分配或路由（东西换主人、没有合并）：芯片融合会讲错。

pairs.note: the scene that names the rule

en: Every row must fuse the same pair in the same step; a row skipped reads as a bug.
zh: 每一行在同一步都要合并同一对；漏一行就像 bug。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: The one pairing mark on the input side slides to the next item or token while the result beside the seam cuts on the same beat.
summary.zh: 输入侧唯一的配对标记滑到下一项或下一个词，同一拍上接缝另一侧的结果切换。

bricks.fits: Pairing items of a list or tokens of code with the results they make, one a beat.
bricks.notFor: Several marks at once; a mark that fades between places.

intent.en: Pair one input with one result at a time, on the beat the result changes.
intent.zh: 每次把一个输入和一个结果配对，就在结果切换的那一拍。

content.en: A list and the item to move to, or quoted lines and the next token.
content.zh: 一个列表和要移到的项，或引用的代码行和下一个词。

fits.zh: 把列表项或代码里的词与它们做出的结果一拍一个地配对。

notFor.zh: 同时多个标记；在两处之间淡入淡出的标记。

fits: any film whose input maps line by line to an output

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
