summary.en: Slanted comic seams carve the frame into three panels on three beats, each popping in with its own framing of one subject; after a hold the last panel's slanted edge sweeps across and eats the frame.
summary.zh: 漫画斜缝踩着三拍把画面劈成三格，每格硬切弹入，是同一主体的不同取景；定格片刻后，末格的斜边扫过全屏把画面吃掉。

bricks.fits: Showing one subject from three angles (whole, part, detail); a beat-driven reveal of a product, a chart or a page; a poster ending.
bricks.notFor: Three different subjects that need their own captions to make sense (use a split or a grid scene); calm or minimal films (the cuts are hard and loud).

intent.en: One subject seen from three angles at once, cut in on the beat like comic panels; the layout itself becomes the drum, then resolves into one poster.
intent.zh: 像漫画分格一样踩拍劈出同一主体的三个机位，格子本身成了鼓点，最后合成一张海报。

content.en: Wraps one subject (vector or high-resolution, it is enlarged up to about 2.5×) and three framings of it: whole, closer, one detail; no text of its own (captions are three-angles).
content.zh: 包住一个主体（矢量或高清素材，最多放大约 2.5 倍），给出三个取景：全貌、近一点、一个细节；自身不带文字（旁白框归 three-angles）。

fits.zh: 同一主体的三个角度（全貌、局部、细节）；踩拍揭示一个产品、一张图表或一页界面；引向海报收尾。

notFor.zh: 三个不同主体、靠说明才看得懂（用网格或分屏场景）；安静或极简的片子（硬切很响）。

pairs.note: adds the captions and the headline poster

en: All three panels must show the same subject; three different contents read as a bento layout.
On the beat, with a click per panel; off the beat it is just a layout animation.
Once per film: the panel language is too recognisable to repeat.
zh: 三格必须是同一主体的不同机位；放三种内容读成 bento 排版。
要踩拍，每格一声咔；不踩拍只是布局动画。
一支片一段：分格语言辨识度太高，两段就撞。

upstream.name: 漫画分镜切屏
upstream.summary: 分格节奏——comic-panel-split 漫画斜格劈出同一主体的三个机位，咔咔咔三格定格后末格斜边吃屏成海报
upstream.use: 把"格子"当节奏器：同主体多机位定格并列，逐格踩拍劈出；吃拍点
upstream.energy: 中高

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: Paths draw on one after another and packets of light run along them into one sink; the paths can erase from the source end.
summary.zh: 几条路径依次画出，光点沿路径流向同一个汇点；路径可以从源头一端擦除。

bricks.fits: Showing that several things feed one: integrations, data sources, inputs of a pipeline, links in an architecture diagram.
bricks.notFor: A single connection (use tether-link); paths that cross each other many times (the packets stop reading as flow).

intent.en: Turn 'these sources feed one place' into a visible process: paths connect, then packets travel toward the sink, so the direction of flow reads without a label.
intent.zh: 把“几个来源汇到一处”这句抽象话变成看得见的过程：通路先接上，光点再流向汇点，不用标注也读得出流向。

content.en: 2–6 sources and one sink placed by the scene (nodes, icons and labels belong to the scene); the brick draws only the paths and the packets.
content.zh: 2–6 个来源和 1 个汇点，位置由场景给（节点、图标、标签归场景）；积木只画路径和光点。

fits.zh: 表现几样东西汇入一处：集成、数据来源、流水线的输入、架构图里的连线。

notFor.zh: 只有一条连线（用 tether-link）；互相交叉很多次的路径（光点不再读作流动）。

pairs.note: the hub scene that draws its links with the tube look

en: Keep the accent for the packets; colouring the source nodes takes the subject away from the sink.
In the tube look connect all tubes at once; one-by-one connections read as separate negotiations.
A sink with an open-shaped mark needs an opaque disc behind it, or line ends show through the gap.
Paths that cross many times stop reading as flow.
zh: 强调色只给光点；给来源节点上色会把视觉主体从汇点抢走。
光管式要所有管同时接上；逐个接读作一个个谈判。
汇点的标志若是开口形，要托在不透明圆片上，否则线头从缺口露出来。
路径交叉太多就不再读作流动。

upstream.name: 曲线汇流吞并
upstream.summary: 左侧四个来源节点各有一条细贝塞尔曲线连向右侧同一汇聚点，曲线先错峰由左向右 draw-on，节点沿自己的曲线滑向汇聚点并三段式加速缩小到消失，强调色数据包全程沿路径滑行，吞并完成后曲线从左端反向擦除只留品牌标志（demo：白瓷圆片托 video-shotcraft 镜刻标志）
upstream.use: "多源整合/统一接入/数据汇聚"的核心机制镜头；集成、聚合、单一入口类产品的说明段落
upstream.energy: 中（长镜慢速推进，靠数据包滑行维持活性；吞并瞬间是唯一小高点）

upstream.name: 集成星图
upstream.summary: 旧页面一次性快翻 180°（侧棱瞬间亮闪）落成新中枢页，五个集成 app 图标同帧弹现、随即五条彩虹光管同帧齐连，光管内输送脉冲持续流动——"翻开新一页，生态一齐接入"
upstream.use: 集成/生态能力段（一个产品连一切）；版本翻新叙事（旧页翻成新页）；暗场霓虹调性的功能高潮
upstream.energy: 中高（翻面是爆点，输送段是余韵）

overlaps.note: a card collapses into a node and one pulse carries it to the next card (a hand-off); path-flow keeps several paths flowing inside one scene
one accent line from a claim to its source

summary.en: A grease-pencil loop is drawn by hand round one cell of a contact sheet while the other rows step back; or an underline under the address.
summary.zh: 用蜡笔手绘一圈圈住印样上的一格，其他行退后；或在网址下画一道线。

bricks.fits: A choice made by a person: the pick among many, the address to remember.
bricks.notFor: Marking several things; anything on a dark frame.

intent.en: A hand mark that reads as a choice, not as the system’s highlight.
intent.zh: 一道手迹，读起来是人的选择，而不是系统的高亮。

content.en: The cell to loop (row, cell) or the address to underline.
content.zh: 要圈的格（行、格）或要画线的网址。

fits.zh: 人做的选择：从许多里挑一个，要记住的网址。

notFor.zh: 同时标多处；画在深色画格上。

fits: any film about films, frames or renders

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A card is flung in from the side in a fish-eye perspective that flattens as it brakes, then snaps flat with an overshoot and focus lines.
summary.zh: 卡片带着鱼眼般的夸张透视从侧面甩进来，减速时透视收平，落定时过冲一下“啪”地拍平，周围炸一圈集中线。

bricks.fits: One hero card arriving with flair: the launch card, the release, the feature everyone came for.
bricks.notFor: Serious or editorial films; more than one per film; cards that must be read while they fly (the text lands with the card).

intent.en: The hero card arrives with flair: the bent lens says speed and nearness, and the snap flat says "it's here".
intent.zh: 主角卡潇洒登场：夸张透视说的是快和近，“啪”地拍平说的是“它来了”。

content.en: One card in the scene (its rect), e.g. a launch or KPI card; its text is read only after it lands.
content.zh: 场景里的一张卡（给出位置框），如发布卡、KPI 卡；卡上的字落定后才读。

fits.zh: 一张主角卡潇洒登场：发布卡、新版本、大家等着看的那个功能。

notFor.zh: 严肃或编辑感的片子；一支片用两次以上；飞行途中就要读字的卡（字随卡一起落定）。

en: Its shake counts as the shot's one source of shake: no other slam or impact in the same shot.
At most two slams a film counting slam-drop; more and none of them hit.
The snap wants a "pak" on the same frame; silent, it loses its accent.
zh: 它的震屏算这一镜唯一的震源：同镜头不再叠别的砸入或冲击。
连同 slam-drop 全片砸入最多两次，多了每次都不响。
拍平那一帧要同帧配一声“啪”，无声就丢了重音。

upstream.name: 金田式透视甩正
upstream.summary: perspective 300→1500px + rotate3d 58°→0 + scale 1.7→1 甩入 18f，末 4f 过冲 +5° 弹平，长斜影收正
upstream.use: 主角卡/KPI 卡的重拳入场；impact-feedback 管落位后的反馈，本卡管入场本身就是冲击
upstream.energy: 高

bricks.notFor: Screen styles (use impact-frame); small text; every title of a film (two at most).

intent.en: A hit in the language of print: the plates slip out of register and snap back, so the landing feels like ink stamped on paper, not a screen glitch.
intent.zh: 用印刷的语言打一拳：两块印版错位再“啪”地套准，命中像在纸上盖了一枚油墨章，而不是屏幕故障。

content.zh: 一行大标题或一个词（≤ 8 字，字号 200–300 px），可叠在场景上。

fits.zh: 纸张、印刷或海报风格里标题或词的那一下命中：观众该感到的落点，一支片一两次。

en: The slip must be large enough to see: about 20 px per plate (40 px apart) on a 200–300 px title; ±5 px is invisible at speed.

方向一横一纵混合，以横为主、纵向少量；纯横向读作左右晃动。
纸墨调性用它、屏幕调性用 impact-frame，同片不并用。

途中行内容和卡内容不能同时出现：一个淡完另一个才亮。

upstream.name: 行倒卡上画布
upstream.summary: 复选框逐个自动打勾→按钮按下→三行沿上抛弧线错峰飞出，途中行形态与卡形态交叉淡化，落位带随机倾角；面板行槽塌陷成虚线留白
upstream.use: AI/协作工具"生成结果落到画布上"的叙事段落；A 式讲"已有内容换了个存在形态"，B 式讲"从一句话长出一棵结构"
upstream.energy: 中

overlaps.note: tiles re-laid out in one container; row-to-card moves objects between containers and changes their form

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A machine reads a still picture: a band of light sweeps it back and forth with a speed-stretched tail, or one line crosses it at constant speed with a wash behind.
summary.zh: 机器在读一张静止的画面：一道光带来回扫过、拖尾随速度伸缩，或一条线匀速从上扫到下、身后留一片已读的淡色。

bricks.fits: A product reading, checking or indexing a document or a page; the beat before annotations appear where the line has passed (scenes take crossAt(y)).
bricks.notFor: Loading or progress (use a bar); a light that wanders with intent (lamp-reveal); more than one scan in a film; dark scenes in band mode (the multiply tail vanishes on dark).

intent.en: The viewer sees a machine reading: the document holds still and only the light moves over it, so it reads as "being examined", not loading.
intent.zh: 让观众看到机器在读：文档纹丝不动，只有光在上面走，读成“正在被检查”，而不是在加载。

content.en: Wraps one still document, page or screenshot and its rect; `line`: the regions to annotate after the line passes (from the scene); `develop`: a wireframe and the real picture behind it.
content.zh: 包住一份静止的文档、页面或截图并给出位置；`line` 版：线扫过后要标注的区块（场景给）；`develop` 版：一张线框图和它背后的真实画面。

fits.zh: 产品在读、校验或索引一份文档或页面；线扫过之处再出标注的前一拍（场景读 crossAt(y)）；`develop`：线框显影成真实界面。

notFor.zh: 加载或进度（用进度条）；带意图游走的光（lamp-reveal）；一支片扫两次以上；`band` 版的暗场（相乘拖尾在暗底上看不见）。

pairs.note: brackets frame the document before the scan
the scene that annotates where the line passed

en: The document must stay perfectly still; if it moves, scanning reads as loading.
Clip the light to the document's box and corner radius; a leak loses "scanning this".
Anything that reacts must come strictly after the line passes; before reads as pre-staged.
On light pages use a deep, saturated scan colour; a pale glow vanishes.
zh: 文档必须完全静止；一动就读成加载。
光带裁在文档框内并跟随圆角；漏出去就丢了“在扫这份”的语义。
被触发的反应必须严格晚于线经过；提前就像预先排好的动画。
亮底页面上用深而饱和的扫描色；浅色辉光看不见。

upstream.name: 取景括号扫描
upstream.summary: 文档弹到中央，四角落下 L 形取景括号，一条扫描光带拖着渐变尾迹在文档上往复扫 5 趟——文档全程静止，只有光在读它
upstream.use: "正在解析/校验这份内容"的过程镜头；文档类产品的能力演示；上传→分析链路的中段
upstream.energy: 中低（机械、克制，节奏全在往复扫掠的呼吸上）

upstream.name: 扫描取景标注
upstream.summary: 一条扫描线自上而下匀速掠过已存在的页面，越过哪块区块的下缘，哪块就被四角取景框从外扩处弹簧收拢对准（一次过冲），随后贴出一枚逐字打出的机器标签，顶部状态行同步计数 00/06→06/06
upstream.use: "AI 正在读你的页面/品牌"的分析镜头；设计系统/品牌规范的拆解介绍；产品能力的自我说明段
upstream.energy: 中（机械冷静，节奏由扫描线匀速推动，标注是节拍点）

upstream.name: 扫描装配飞入
upstream.summary: 页面开场是一张只有网格与虚线槽位的蓝图画板，一条亮扫描线自上而下掠过；扫到每个槽位，该处组件就从画外飞入过冲贴合，带方向性残影模糊与落位咬合角标——扫完整页恰好装配完成
upstream.use: "页面自己生成"的开场；AI 建站/自动排版类产品的核心演示；从空白到成品的能力叙事
upstream.energy: 中高（扫描线是稳的，但每次组件飞入都是一个爆点，密度递进）

upstream.name: 蓝图描线成形
upstream.summary: 界面先以 SVG 细线蓝图分组描画，再一条琥珀发光竖线左→右扫过，扫过处线框实体化成真实界面
upstream.use: 功能墙/卡片墙/整页界面的整体亮相；内容已在原位、要"显形"而非"涌入"的段落
upstream.energy: 中

overlaps.note: a light that shows the scene; scan-line leaves the scene visible and only reads it
the brackets that frame the scanned document are reticle-lock (collapse variant)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: The lock-up’s second move: the seam and the page beside it slide off the frame’s right edge on the last bar; the caret blinks after the install line.
summary.zh: 落版的第二个动作：接缝连同旁边的页面在最后一小节滑出画面右缘；光标在安装命令后闪烁。

bricks.fits: Closing a film whose through-line is the seam.
bricks.notFor: Films without a seam; a mid-film change.

intent.en: End where the film began: the seam leaves, the caret waits.
intent.zh: 结束在开头的地方：接缝离开，光标等待。

content.en: The lock-up’s name, install line and address.
content.zh: 落版的名字、安装命令和网址。

fits.zh: 以接缝为主线的片子收尾。

notFor.zh: 没有接缝的片子；片中的切换。

fits: any film whose input maps line by line to an output

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A word is cut into separate pieces that light up in a shuffled order; it reads only when the last key pieces land, and then the whole word surges to full light.
summary.zh: 一个词被切成十几段互不相连的碎片，乱序逐段点亮；最后几段钥匙段落位才读得出来，随即整词通电满亮。

bricks.fits: The hook of an opening: a product name, one word or a big number whose recognition is the moment; once a film.
bricks.notFor: Text that must be read at once (a claim, a label); more than one word line; a light, busy ground where half-lit pieces do not glow.

intent.en: Hold back recognition to make a hook: the viewer sees only mysterious pieces until the key ones land, and the moment the word is recognised is the payoff.
intent.zh: 把“认出来”压到最后做成钩子：观众前大半时间只看到神秘的碎段，钥匙段落位的那一刻认出是什么字，这一下就是回报。

content.en: One short word the viewer already knows (a product name, SHIP, LIVE, a big number): en 4–6 letters best, zh 2–4 chars; no other text.
content.zh: 一个观众本来就认识的短词（产品名、SHIP、LIVE、大数字）：英文 4–6 个字母最好，中文 2–4 字；不带其他文字。

fits.zh: 开场的钩子：认出这个词就是那一刻的产品名、单个词或大数字；一支片一次。

notFor.zh: 必须立刻读懂的文字（主张、标签）；超过一行字；浅色或花的底，半亮的碎段不发光。

pairs.note: a claim after the word is recognised

en: The word must be one the viewer already knows; a made-up word has no moment of recognition.
Keep it short; long words make the unreadable stretch hard to control and the pieces explode in number.
For the reveal let the lettering's own glow surge; a separate radial glow makes a dirty spot in the middle of the word.
zh: 必须是观众认识的词；生造词没有“认出”可言。
词要短；长词的不可读期难控制，碎段数量爆炸。
揭晓时让字形自己的泛光涌起；另画一团径向光会在字中间留下脏亮点。

upstream.name: 描边分段构建
upstream.summary: 断笔成字——标题拆成十几段互不相连的笔画乱序逐段点亮，前 70% 不可读，末段落位瞬间语义"啪"地成立
upstream.use: 开场吊悬念的产品名/大数字揭晓；一支片 ≤1 次；与 type-assembly/draw-svg-trace 分工：那些是"看着字被组装/描画"，本卡是"意义延迟揭晓"
upstream.energy: 低起中收（悬念型，落位帧是能量点）

overlaps.note: glyphs cycle through other glyphs and resolve; segment-reveal keeps every glyph and withholds parts of it
the word is written whole and continuously; segment-reveal withholds meaning, in discrete pieces

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A picture assembles from shards that fly in from scattered 3D poses and click into place from the centre out; or it shatters and flies off the frame.
summary.zh: 一张画面切成 5×5 碎片，从三维散乱姿态按中心向外的波纹逐圈飞回原位、咔哒入槽；或整面碎开飞出画面。

bricks.fits: Chaos to form: the first shot of an opening revealing a poster or product picture; reversed (out), a hard exit from a held picture.
bricks.notFor: Pictures whose detail must be read while moving; light, flat styles with no depth; more than once a film.

intent.en: Film 'the product takes shape' as a physical event: a whole picture grows out of disorder before the viewer's eyes; reversed, it clears the screen by flying apart, not fading.
intent.zh: 把“产品成形”拍成一件物理事件：观众看着一整面画面从无序中长出来；反着用时，画面是被炸飞出画，而不是淡掉。

content.en: One picture (a poster, a product picture or a title card) painted into a rect, split into 5 × 5 tiles; keep any logo inside one tile.
content.zh: 一张画面（海报、产品图或标题卡），画进一个矩形、切成 5 × 5 块；标志要整个落在一块里。

fits.zh: 从混沌到成形：开场第一镜揭示一张海报或产品图；反向（out）作为一张定格画面的硬退场。

notFor.zh: 运动中就要读清细节的画面；没有纵深的浅色平面风格；一支片用两次以上。

pairs.note: a claim landing on the assembled poster

en: Exit by flying out, not by fading; a fade reads as vanishing and the physics is lost.
Do not let a logo or key word straddle a tile seam; the seam cuts a hairline through it and reads as a broken picture.
In through, the hold is the only reading window; longer copy needs a longer hold before the shards leave.
zh: 退场靠位移飞出，不要淡出；淡出读作“消失”而非“飞走”，物理感尽失。
标志或关键字别跨拼缝；拼缝会切出一条细缝，读作坏图。
through 式里停顿段是唯一的读字窗口；文案更长要先拉长停顿再让碎片起飞。

upstream.name: 碎片聚合飞散
upstream.summary: 5×5 瓦片从 3D 碎片态按中心波纹逐圈聚合成整面海报，停一拍亮字，随后全部碎片背离中心加速旋转飞出画面
upstream.use: 开场第一镜"从混沌到成形"的品牌/海报揭示；倒放或只取后半可作硬转场
upstream.energy: 高（两头高能、中段静止，适合压 BGM 重音起收）

overlaps.note: tiles grow in place from points (2D); shard-gather flies 3D shards in from scattered poses
a page's parts rise along its normal and return; shard-gather scatters a picture's grid of tiles in every axis

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: One diagonal highlight crosses a dark card once, clipped to its corners, and its top edge catches the light.
summary.zh: 一道斜向高光带在深色主角卡上缓缓扫过一次，被圆角裁住，卡的上沿跟着亮一下。

bricks.fits: Crowning the one hero card while it holds still: the plan, the product card, the result.
bricks.notFor: Light grounds or light cards (screened light is invisible there); more than one card; more than twice a film counting all light effects.

intent.en: A silent crowning: one pass of light over the hero card says "this is the one" without decorating anything else.
intent.zh: 一次无声的加冕：一道光扫过主角卡一次，说“就是它”，别的都不装饰。

content.en: One dark hero card in the scene (its rect), holding still; no text.
content.zh: 场景里一张静止的深色主角卡（给出位置框）；不需要文字。

fits.zh: 主角卡静止时给它加冕：方案卡、产品卡、结果卡。

notFor.zh: 浅色底或浅色卡（叠加的光在上面看不见）；不止一张卡；连同其他光效全片超过两次。

en: Four rules or it looks cheap: one sweep, one hero card, clipped to its corners, once only.
Dark card or dark ground only; on light it is invisible.
All light effects together at most twice a film.
zh: 四条约束缺一就廉价：单点、主角卡、圆角裁剪、只扫一次。
只用于深色卡或深底，浅色上看不见。
全片光效合计最多两次。

upstream.name: 单点扫光
upstream.summary: 深墨卡上 45° 高光带 translateX 扫一次，overflow hidden 圆角裁剪
upstream.use: 把光当另一种笔触（扫/擦）：暗场标题揭示（A）、主角卡加冕（B）
upstream.energy: A 中 / B 低

overlaps.note: the light as camera and edit (reveals and hides a scene); sheen-sweep is a gloss on one object

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: The sheet slides off the mat downward and the next is dealt on from below, square to the reading position.
summary.zh: 这张纸向下滑出垫板，下一张从下方发上来，端正停在阅读位置。

bricks.fits: The ordinary page change of an evidence film; an index card arriving.
bricks.notFor: Sheets that stay; frame-level cuts.

intent.en: Change the evidence without moving the camera: one sheet out, the next dealt on where the eye already is.
intent.zh: 不动镜头换证据：一张出去，下一张发到视线已经在的地方。

content.en: Two exhibits.
content.zh: 两份证物。

fits.zh: 证据片里普通的换页；索引卡的到来。

notFor.zh: 要留下的纸；整帧切换。

en: The out-move is faster than the in-move; never both sheets square at once.
zh: 出去比进来快；两张纸不会同时端正停着。

source.path: the dossier source film dealY, exitY; choreo.js deal

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A card hangs near the camera, drops with an accelerating ease-in and lands with a ring, shards, a flash and a shake.
summary.zh: 卡片悬在镜头前，加速砸进自己的位置；落点那一帧冲击环、碎片、白闪和震屏同时起。

bricks.fits: A heavy card landing: the headline number, the result, the one feature that matters; the slot drop when the page already has neighbours.
bricks.notFor: More than two landings a film; calm, editorial or paper styles; text that must be read while it falls.

intent.en: The card lands with weight: the viewer feels it is heavy, and in the slot drop sees the force travel to its neighbours.
intent.zh: 卡片带着重量砸下：观众感到它很重；slot 式还能看见冲击力传到邻居身上。

content.en: One card in the scene (its rect), usually a headline number or result; for slot, the rects of its neighbours already on the page.
content.zh: 场景里的一张卡（给出位置框），通常是大数字或结果；slot 式还要给出页面上已在场的邻卡位置。

fits.zh: 一张有分量的卡落地：大数字、结果、最要紧的那个功能；页面上已有邻卡时用 slot 落位。

notFor.zh: 一支片超过两次落地；安静、编辑感或纸墨风格（用 plate-slip）；下落途中就要读的字。

pairs.note: the number on the landed card can roll to its value

en: At most two slams a film counting perspective-fling; one source of shake per shot.
In slot, the neighbours must have been still for at least 15 frames before they are knocked, or the cause is lost.
The ring needs contrast: a saturated ring over a white pressure disc on light grounds, a white core with a coloured glow on dark (set dark).
The landing wants a boom on the same frame; silent, the burst reads as a twitch.
zh: 连同 perspective-fling 全片砸入最多两次；一个镜头只有一个震源。
slot 式的邻卡要先静止至少 15 帧再被撞开，否则看不出因果。
冲击环要有反差：浅底上用饱和色环配白色压力盘，深底上用白芯加色辉（开 dark）。
落地帧要同帧配音爆，无声的三件套读作抽搐。

upstream.name: 比分砸入
upstream.summary: 卡从 scale 2.5/rotate 5° 六帧 Easing.in(quad) 砸落，落点帧圆环扩散+尘点飞散+震屏同帧
upstream.use: 主角卡/KPI 卡的重拳入场；impact-feedback 管落位后的反馈，本卡管入场本身就是冲击
upstream.energy: 高

upstream.name: 冲击爆点套件
upstream.summary: B 三件套 + 冲击波前沿按半径-距离精算扫过邻卡帧，邻卡外推 30px + rotate ±3° 阻尼弹回
upstream.use: 主角卡/KPI 卡的重拳入场；impact-feedback 管落位后的反馈，本卡管入场本身就是冲击
upstream.energy: 高

upstream.name: 连招计数
upstream.summary: 三卡接连砸入，每命中 = 顿帧 2f + 伤害数字上浮 + ×N 计数跳字逐次加码
upstream.use: 元素落位/撞击的"命中一瞬"——给砸入、撞停加游戏级手感；按强度阶梯选式
upstream.energy: 高（瞬时冲击）

overlaps.note: the same weight class on another axis: flung in from the side with a perspective snap
cards set down on a stack, no impact
the hit after a crash zoom; a film takes one of the two as its peak

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A figure shown as its two parts, then fused: from the whole (split) or from two edges (converge) the parts hold apart, then slam together into the whole under a flash, a shock and a shake.
summary.zh: 把一个形象拆成两半给人看，再合回去：从整体一闪拆开（split），或两半从画面两端进场（converge），停住让人认，然后扣合成整体，配闪白、冲击和震屏。

bricks.fits: A product, mascot or mark that is made of two recognisable things (a brand and a character, a model and a tool): its debut or its closing reveal.
bricks.notFor: Two sides of a comparison that collide (versus); one thing becoming many (clone-echo); shapes melting into one (sphere-merge); parts that are not recognisable alone; more than once or twice a film.

intent.en: Show what the thing is made of, then make it one: each part is recognised on its own before the slam makes them the whole.
intent.zh: 先让人看清它由什么组成，再合成一个：两半各自被认出来，扣合那一下让它们成为整体。

content.en: Three pictures: the whole figure and its two parts (cut-outs, transparent PNG), at most about 480 px high; no text (a film may set names as glance text over it). Without pictures, a drawn badge and its two halves.
content.zh: 三张图：完整形象和它的两半（透明底抠图），高约 480 px 以内；不带字（要名字时由片子另配扫一眼的字）。不给图时画一个示意徽章和它的两半。

fits.zh: 由两个认得出的东西组成的产品、吉祥物或标志（品牌加角色、模型加工具）：它的登场，或片尾的揭晓。

notFor.zh: 两方对比相撞（用 versus）；一个变很多（用 clone-echo）；形状融成一个（用 sphere-merge）；单看认不出的部件；一部片用超过一两次。

pairs.note: in stream, over the night after the close, as the film's own ending
converge as the mascot's debut over the opening, its slam on the drop's landing

en: Hold the parts apart long enough to be recognised (about two beats from apart to the wind back): rushed, the slam merges two unread blurs.
The slam is the hit: give it the film's heaviest sound and let the music drop on it; the flash hides the cut to the whole, so the parts need not fit pixel for pixel.
In stream the shock is the line shooting across (`line`); on another look keep `impact` and let the roles reskin it, or turn the shake off on calm films.
zh: 两半分开后要停够让人认出来（从分开到蓄力约两拍）：太快的话扣合的是两团没看清的影子。
扣合是重拍：给它全片最重的声音，配乐在这里落下；闪白藏住切到整体那一下，两半不必逐像素拼准。
stream 里冲击就是线横穿画面（`line`）；别的样式保留 `impact`，靠颜色角色换皮，安静的片子把震屏关掉。

summary.en: A set of items arrives one after another, each with a small landing; values can grade across the set and a second wave can pulse back through it.
summary.zh: 一组元素依次入场、各自轻落定；数值可沿顺序铺成梯度，第二道波可从另一个原点脉冲回来。

bricks.fits: A set that should read in order inside one scene: a menu or feature list, the bars of a spectrum or a ranking, a coverage grid, the power-on beat of an opening.
bricks.notFor: Items the viewer must compare at once (use a still layout); a single hero object (use a landing or a reveal); more than about 20 items with text (the stagger outlasts reading).

intent.en: Let a set be read in order while the screen stays alive; in the bars and dots sets the order itself becomes visible, as a gradient or as a wave of power coming on.
intent.zh: 让一组东西按顺序被读到，同时画面一直是活的；柱和点阵两式里，顺序本身也看得见：一道梯度，或一次从源头扩散开的通电。

content.en: list: 4–8 rows, each an icon, a short label (≤ 24 chars) and an optional key or badge; bars: 8–24 values; dots: a grid with an origin, no text. Or the film's own items as painters with rects.
content.zh: 列表式：4–8 行，每行一个图标、一个短标签（≤ 12 字）、可选快捷键或徽标；柱式：8–24 个数值；点阵式：一张网格加波源，无文字。也可传入影片自己的元素（位置加绘制函数）。

fits.zh: 一屏之内按顺序读的一组：菜单或功能列表、频谱或排名柱、覆盖范围网格、开场“系统上电”的一拍。

notFor.zh: 要观众一眼同时比较的几项（用静止布局）；单个主角对象（用落定或揭示）；带文字且超过约 20 项（错峰比阅读还长）。

en: The list's drift never returns to zero; to loop or match the next shot, ease the drift out.
Recompute the stagger when the count changes and leave ≥ 1 s after the last item; in bars, more items push the entry into the centre pulse and the two beats blur.
Keep the drift an order of magnitude slower than the items' landing, or the list reads as floating up as one.
The bars' glow and the dots' wave need a dark ground; on white they barely show.
zh: 列表的整体漂移末帧不回零；要循环或对齐下一镜，把漂移改成收束。
项数一变就重算错峰，末项后留 ≥ 1 秒；柱式加柱会把入场吃进中心脉冲，两拍糊成一件事。
整体漂移要比逐项落定慢一个数量级，否则读作整列一起往上飘。
柱的光晕和点阵的波要暗底；白底上几乎看不见。

bricks.fits: Each task the product takes; a count that should be felt as a sky filling up.
bricks.notFor: Tasks that must stay readable after they finish; a single big reveal.

intent.en: Every task handed off is not lost: it becomes a star the product keeps watching.
intent.zh: 交出去的每件事都没丢：它变成一颗产品一直看着的星。

content.zh: 没有字：任务行（占位）和星最后停的位置。

Leave from the ring, not from the row's centre, or the row reads as exploding.
zh: 星要留下：它在之后每一帧都在（收尾的扫掠会接住它）。
从环里飞出，不要从行的中心飞出，否则看起来像整行炸开。

summary.en: One thread gathers every star: the spine retracts into the mascot, the thread's head sweeps the sky in three passes along one smooth path catching each star it passes, the line straightens into a tether, and the caught stars flow along it into its end, which glows as one point.

bricks.notFor: Fewer than about eight stars; a film that has not sent stars out before.

路径不能在星附近自交，否则接住会看起来发生了两次。

summary.en: The world moves, the pointer does not: a scale tape crawls up to the old cap, the cap breaks, the tape sprints and brakes on a spring onto the new value under a fixed reading window.
summary.zh: 世界动、针不动：刻度带顶着旧上限慢爬，上限线断开，刻度带冲刺、弹簧刹车过冲回摆，停在新数值上，读数窗钉在画面中线不动。

bricks.fits: One metric that jumps (a limit raised, throughput multiplied): the size of the jump becomes distance and speed.
bricks.notFor: Small changes (the sprint has nothing to cover); several metrics at once (use needle-sweep).

intent.en: The size of the jump becomes distance and speed: the viewer feels how far the value went before reading the new number.
intent.zh: 跳变的大小变成路程和速度：观众先感到数值跑了多远，再读新数字。

content.en: One metric with its start, old cap and new value (the new several times the cap), a unit, a title (≤ 30 chars) and two cap labels (≤ 16 chars each); the claim is computed.
content.zh: 一个指标的起始值、旧上限和新值（新值是旧上限的几倍），单位、标题（≤ 14 字）和两个上限标签（每个 ≤ 7 字）；倍数自动算出。

fits.zh: 一个跳变的指标（上限提高、吞吐翻倍）：跳变大小变成路程和速度。

notFor.zh: 小幅变化（冲刺没有路可跑）；同时讲几个指标（用 needle-sweep）。

pairs.note: the several readings first, then the one that jumped

en: Only for a jump of several times; a small change has nothing for the sprint to cover.
Hold the tape dead still after the spring settles; any drift reads as a bug.
zh: 只配翻几倍的跳变，小变化让冲刺无路可跑。
弹簧停稳后刻度带锁死不动，尾漂像 bug。

真实产品用两个主题各自的真截图，不做滤镜假深色。
一支片最多一次：它是功能叙事不是转场，反复切像演示事故。

summary.en: One thread gathers a scattered pile: from the mascot its white-hot head runs one smooth path through the centre of every item (each lights with a ring as it is pierced), then the whole thread goes taut once and relaxes.
summary.zh: 一根线收拢散乱的一堆：线头从吉祥物出发，沿一条平滑路径穿过每件东西的中心（被穿过的亮一圈），然后整根线绷紧一次再放松。

bricks.notFor: Every scene change of a film (it is a T2 move, a few a film); styles whose camera is locked.

intent.en: The camera's pitch tells the story: a page lifted from the table into view, a pick from a desk of pages, or a dive from above onto the hero, each landing on one upright page.
intent.zh: 用俯仰角讲故事：像掀开桌上的图纸把一页抬到眼前，或在一桌页面里巡一圈挑中一张，或从高空俯冲落到主角上，最后都落在一张正立的页面。

content.en: Wraps one page (`rise`), three pages and the target (`drop`), or an overview page and the region to land on (`dive`); high-resolution, since the end is a close-up.
content.zh: 包住一张页面（`rise`）、三张页面加选中哪张（`drop`），或一张总览页加落点区域（`dive`）；终点是特写，素材要高清。

fits.zh: 压住开场后揭示一页（rise）；在几页里选中一页（drop）；从总览落到其中一处（dive）。

notFor.zh: 每次换场都用（T2 大动作，一支片几次）；镜头锁死的风格（strip、split、scroll、dossier）。

en: `rise` is an opening reveal: not with another reveal opener (crane-reveal) in the same film.
`drop`: keep the pan at a fixed angle and only then dive; mixing them leaves the camera's intent unclear.
One camera holder per section: not with other big camera moves; `dive` counts towards at most two 3D showpieces a film.
zh: `rise` 是开场揭示：同一支片别再用另一个揭示开场（crane-reveal）。
`drop`：巡视时角度锁死，之后再扎入；混着动观众不知道相机想干嘛。
一段只有一个持镜人：别和别的大运镜同段；`dive` 计入一支片最多两次的 3D 炫技。

upstream.name: 俯仰揭示
upstream.summary: perspective 容器内整页 rotateX -80° 平躺，~43f 抬正，rotateX/scale/translateY 共用 out-cubic，末端轻过冲
upstream.use: 用"俯仰角"讲故事的开场/转场：单页 establishing 用 A，多页巡视择一扎入用 B
upstream.energy: A 中 / B 中高

upstream.name: 俯视桌面扎落
upstream.summary: 卡阵平躺 rotateX 62°，pan 段只动 translateX 横滑掠过，drop 段角度/缩放/位移三通道同跑扎入落版
upstream.use: 用"俯仰角"讲故事的开场/转场：单页 establishing 用 A，多页巡视择一扎入用 B
upstream.energy: A 中 / B 中高

upstream.name: 无人机俯冲落点
upstream.summary: 近垂直俯角悬停 → 猛扎俯冲 → 气垫减速停在 hero 卡特写
upstream.use: 把平面页面当 3D 实体拍的高光段落；两式都是"大动作"，一支片合计 ≤2 次
upstream.energy: 高

overlaps.note: pulls back over a flat grid and dives into one tile, in the plane (no tilt)
travels along a row in the plane

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: Time stops inside the picture while the camera keeps moving: the content brakes into a freeze, the camera orbits the frozen moment (or it is marked up, or each hit holds two frames), then time comes back and the content finishes.
summary.zh: 画面里的时间停住、镜头还在动：内容急刹进冻结，相机绕着冻住的瞬间转一圈（或在定格上圈注点题，或每次命中顿两帧），再恢复时间让内容长完。

bricks.fits: The one moment of a process worth looking at from the side (a spike, a peak); review and explain films that point at one thing (annotate); the weight of each landing in a combo (hit-stop).
bricks.notFor: Content with no motion of its own (nothing to freeze); films without a 3D camera (use mode annotate).

intent.en: "This moment is worth stopping time for": the content freezes while we look at it from the side or mark it up, so one instant of a process lands with weight.
intent.zh: “这一刻值得停下时间看”：内容冻住，镜头绕到侧面看或在上面圈注，过程中的一瞬被郑重点出来。

content.en: Wraps one time-driven painter (a chart growing, a list moving) and the moment to freeze; `annotate`: the focus point and a note ≤ 24 chars (Chinese ≤ 10 characters); `hit-stop`: the hit frames.
content.zh: 包住一块随时间变化的内容（生长的图表、移动的列表）并给出冻结时刻；`annotate` 版：焦点位置和一句 ≤ 24 字符（中文 ≤ 10 字）的批注；`hit-stop` 版：各次命中帧。

fits.zh: 过程中值得从侧面看一眼的那一刻（尖峰、峰值）；指着一件事讲的评审与讲解片（annotate）；连招里每次落地的分量（hit-stop）。

notFor.zh: 本身不动的内容（没东西可冻）；strip、split 风格（orbit 要动镜头，改用 annotate）。

en: One time-manipulator per shot: not with on-threes or another speed ramp; two remaps fight and read as a fault.
`hit-stop` must freeze the whole picture, background included; otherwise only that card seems to drop frames.
Pick by meaning: orbit is "stop to look", annotate is "stop to explain".
zh: 一个镜头只能有一个时间操纵者：别和 on-threes 或其他变速叠用，两套重映射打架读作故障。
`hit-stop` 要整个画面连背景一起停；否则只像那张卡掉帧。
按语义选：orbit 是“停下来看”，annotate 是“停下来讲”。

upstream.name: 冻结环绕
upstream.summary: 图表生长到一半全冻住，相机绕悬停的 UI 平面 rotateY 扫 55° 再回，时间恢复接着长完
upstream.use: 情绪节点（震撼/收束）的运镜语言；与 space-camera-moves 的"炫技大动作"互补——这两式动作小、情绪重
upstream.energy: A 高 / B 低收

upstream.name: 连招计数
upstream.summary: 三卡接连砸入，每命中 = 顿帧 2f + 伤害数字上浮 + ×N 计数跳字逐次加码
upstream.use: 元素落位/撞击的"命中一瞬"——给砸入、撞停加游戏级手感；按强度阶梯选式
upstream.energy: 高（瞬时冲击）

upstream.name: 定格圈注
upstream.summary: 帧号非线性 remap 的节奏手法——定格标注（流动→定格圈注→解冻）
upstream.use: 卡片流/长横移中把一个重点"停下给人看"；教学解说、评审语境
upstream.energy: 中高（速度反差本身即energy beat）

overlaps.note: its ring marks a thing without stopping time

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A centred hero title shrinks in one move into the section label at the top left while the section's content grows in under it; optionally a text selection sweeps over it first.
summary.zh: 居中的大标题一口气缩小、飞到左上角落成小节标签，下面的内容在它落地的同时长出来；可选先扫过一道文本选区。

bricks.fits: Opening a chapter: the title is the subject for a beat, then becomes the signpost of the content that grows under it; with select, a menu item becoming the heading of what it opens.
bricks.notFor: A title that should stay the figure; sections without content to grow (it then reads as a title shrinking for nothing); titles over about three words; styles that never rescale type.

intent.en: The title steps down instead of leaving, so the viewer keeps a free spatial memory: the big word from a moment ago is the small label up there, and this section is about it.
intent.zh: 标题降格而不退场，观众白得一份空间记忆：刚才的大字就是左上角那个小标签，这一节讲的就是它。

content.en: A section title of up to three words (≤ 20 chars), an optional number ("01") and eyebrow, and the section content to grow under it (blocks in reading order).
content.zh: 一个不超过三个词的小节标题（≤ 6 字），可选编号（“01”）和眉题，以及要在下面长出来的本节内容（按阅读顺序的块）。

fits.zh: 章节开场：标题先当一拍主角，再变成下面长出的内容的门牌；select 式让菜单项变成它打开那一页的标题。

notFor.zh: 应该一直当主角的标题；下面没有内容可长的小节（就成了标题无故缩小）；超过约三个词的标题；从不缩放文字的风格。

pairs.note: the title enters first, holds a beat, then steps down

en: Nothing else may move on the title's path; a popup or pointer entering on the same frame steals the eye.
Used in several sections, the new label replaces the old one; stacked labels make the corner a graveyard.
The select highlight says "this text can be selected": use it only for editing or document products.
zh: 标题飞行路径上不许有别的东西动；同帧入场的弹窗或光标会抢走视线。
多节连用时新标签替换旧标签，叠放会让左上角变成标签坟场。
select 的选中高亮暗示“文字可被选中”，只给编辑器或文档类产品用。

upstream.name: 标题降格标签
upstream.summary: 大标题降格为节标签两式——A 大标题居中显影站稳一拍后连续缩小 0.3x 平移到左上角落成小节标签、内容区在其下生长；B 同套路但登场时带文本选中态高亮块扫入再撤掉
upstream.use: 章节开场（标题先当主角再让位给内容）；教程/功能演示片的小节交接；B 式给"文字/编辑"类产品加身份暗示
upstream.energy: 低中（版式变换型，氛围镜头）

overlaps.note: card-portal opens a part into the whole; title-demote turns the whole title into the label of its part

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: Three cards stand edge-on, then tumble in 3D along one smooth path into a staggered stair, sharp all the way, and keep turning slowly once they stand.
summary.zh: 三张页卡先侧棱朝前、几乎看不见，再沿一条平滑路径在 3D 里翻飞成错落的阶梯，全程清晰，站定后仍缓慢转动。

bricks.fits: Revealing a set of pages, screens or features at once; the opening of a product film; a finale that gathers the cards before they collapse.
bricks.notFor: One card (use card-portal or pose-fly); reading the cards' text (they are large but turned); flat or print styles that avoid 3D.

intent.en: A set of pages appears out of nothing and lines up with energy: cards flip in from their thin edges into a stair, showing "many capabilities" at a glance.
intent.zh: 一组页面从无到有、带着冲劲列队：卡片从薄边翻飞成阶梯，一眼看到“好多能力”。

content.en: Wraps exactly three card painters (pages, screens or feature cards); their text is decorative, not read.
content.zh: 包住正好三张卡（页面、屏幕或功能卡）；卡上的字只作装饰，不需要读。

fits.zh: 一次亮出一组页面、屏幕或功能；产品片开场；收尾前把卡片聚拢（flock-finale 接着收束）。

notFor.zh: 只有一张卡（用 pose-fly 或 card-portal）；卡上的字要读（大但斜着）；回避 3D 的平面或印刷风格。

pairs.note: pulls the stair into the title with a smoke ring

en: Never let the cards stop once standing; a still stair at the climax was rejected (keep the slow turn).
No motion blur or defocus: it must stay sharp all the way.
zh: 站定后不许停住；高潮段静止被判不行（保持慢转）。
不加运动模糊或景深糊：全程清晰。

upstream.name: 卡片翻飞收束
upstream.summary: 三张 UI 页卡从侧棱薄边 3D 翻飞成阶梯站定（全程清晰、样条连续丝滑），站定后保持慢转不停，快速收束吸入中心，炸出单个湍流烟雾环扩散，巨字横贯收场
upstream.use: 能量高潮段（功能页群→品牌口号的爆点转场）；霓虹/极光暗场调性；"多页面能力"收束成一句话的段落
upstream.energy: 极高（全片能量顶点用）

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A title enters unit by unit — words, Chinese phrases or characters — each unit travelling the same short way, staggered; seven ways to travel.
summary.zh: 标题按单位逐个入场（英文按词或字母，中文按词组或单字），每个单位走同一段短路、错峰；七种走法。

bricks.fits: The first appearance of a title, a claim or a section heading on a still ground: blur is the quiet default for most titles, rise, press, drift, drop, path and tumble are livelier ways (tumble: the words of a page assembling after its shapes).
bricks.notFor: Text already on screen or already read (re-entering reads as a stutter); more than two lines; more than two kinds of title entrance in a film, and drift, drop or path more than once.

intent.en: The title arrives piece by piece in reading order, so the viewer reads it as it lands; blur stays out of the way, the other ways make the arrival an event.
intent.zh: 标题按阅读顺序一块块到位，观众边落边读；blur 不抢戏，其余几种把入场本身做成一件事。

content.en: One or two lines of title (≤ 40 chars a line), an optional accent word and an optional sub line; for path, a curve that means something (a growth line).
content.zh: 一到两行标题（每行 ≤ 18 字），可选一个强调词和一行副标题；path 式还要一条有含义的曲线（如增长线）。

fits.zh: 标题、主张或小节标题在安静画面上第一次出现：blur 是多数标题的安静默认，rise、press、drift、drop、path、tumble 更活泼（tumble 适合页面拼好形状后文字落位）。

notFor.zh: 已经在画面上或已读过的字（再入场像口吃）；超过两行；一支片超过两种标题入场，drift、drop、path 各超过一次。

pairs.note: mark the key word once the title has landed

en: At most two kinds of title entrance per film, counting type-retype and write-on; use blur for every title but the hero.
Chinese must be split by meaning into 3–5 phrases, not into single characters.
Over about 8 words, shorten the gap between words or the last one enters during the hold.
Keep the camera still while drift, drop or path is flying; drop wants words without descenders (g, j, p, q, y).
zh: 连同 type-retype、write-on，一支片标题入场最多两种；主角以外的标题一律用 blur。
中文按语义切成 3–5 个词组，别退化成逐字。
超过约 8 个词就压短词间隔，否则末词挤到收尾停留里才进。
drift、drop、path 飞行时镜头必须稳；drop 避开带下行笔画的字母（g、j、p、q、y）。

upstream.name: 逐词模糊入场
upstream.summary: 标题逐词入场，y 0.38em→0 + blur 18→0 + opacity 0→1 三通道走同一条 ease-out 同步收敛，词间隔约 4f；副标题在标题收完前就错峰跟进
upstream.use: 几乎所有标题/副标题成对出现的场合；产品页首屏文案、章节小标题；需要"专业但不抢戏"的默认文字 reveal
upstream.energy: 低（一次性收敛，无峰值无循环）

upstream.name: 逐字裂升
upstream.summary: 每字 overflow 盒内 translateY(115%→0) 带 10% 过冲，delay i×2f，基线同步生长
upstream.use: 大标题/标语的入场；与 type-entrance-moves、document-typewriter-reveal 同属标题入场大品类，全片 ≤2 种
upstream.energy: A 中 / B 中高 / C 中

upstream.name: 纸张标题卡
upstream.summary: 一句话逐词压印上纸、一个词标强调色斜体、短划线收束
upstream.use: 章节转场/价值主张字卡；重要功能出场前的引导卡；全片呼吸位
upstream.energy: 低（呼吸位，隔开两段高能镜头）

upstream.name: 漂移合拢
upstream.summary: 字符 seed 方向 ±300px + blur 8px 漂入错峰归位，锁定帧加深脉冲，合体后整词呼吸 1.04
upstream.use: 大标题/标语的入场；与 type-entrance-moves、document-typewriter-reveal 同属标题入场大品类，全片 ≤2 种
upstream.energy: A 中 / B 中高 / C 中

upstream.name: 字符坠落
upstream.summary: 标题文字入场一式——letter-drop-physics 字符坠落（重力砸落、弹跳、歪斜站定，最后一拍集体立正归位）
upstream.use: 大标题/章节字卡的入场；与 type-assembly-moves（集结系）、document-typewriter-reveal（打字机）同品类互斥选用
upstream.energy: 中高（物理趣味）

upstream.name: 沿线流入
upstream.summary: 字符沿贝塞尔曲线鱼贯滑入（切线角旋转），到达后 12f 摆正水平
upstream.use: 大标题/标语的入场；与 type-entrance-moves、document-typewriter-reveal 同属标题入场大品类，全片 ≤2 种
upstream.energy: A 中 / B 中高 / C 中

upstream.name: 骨架装配落字
upstream.summary: 空的暗底网格上，无文字的组件骨架先从四面八方飞入贴合；随后各处文字逐字从 3D 空间旋转着飞来落位，先大标题后小标注，全部落位后页面成形
upstream.use: 页面/海报"自己长出来"的开场；排版类产品的能力展示；从骨架到成稿的两段式叙事
upstream.energy: 中高（骨架段稀疏、文字段密集，能量单调上升到收尾）

overlaps.note: path-type swaps two sentences through a loop of the line; type-enter path brings one title in along a curve
a line resolving in reading order through scrambled glyphs, for ids and hashes
lead-word shows the first word alone at 2.3× and builds the line round it; type-enter gives every unit the same short way
a line typed with a visible correction; type-enter has no correction to make

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A line is typed, the typist hesitates and deletes the tail, then types the real words faster; a highlighter bar settles under them.
summary.zh: 先打出一句平庸的话，犹豫、退格删掉后半句，再更快地打出真正的说法，底下铺一道荧光笔。

bricks.fits: A claim made by correcting a plainer one ("not a draft, the cut you meant"); a search or command being refined; copy built on a negation.
bricks.notFor: Plain titles with nothing to correct (use type-enter); lines over about 30 characters (16 in Chinese); more than once a film (a second correction reads as a stammer).

intent.en: A small drama of hesitate, reject, declare: the viewer sees the plain word thrown out and the real claim typed faster, so the claim reads as a decision.
intent.zh: 一出“犹豫、否定、宣言”的小戏：观众看着平庸的说法被删掉、真正的卖点被更快地打出来，主张读成一个决定。

content.en: Three slots on one line: the start that stays, the wrong ending (typed then deleted) and the right ending; ≤ 30 chars in all.
content.zh: 同一行的三个槽：保留的开头、打出又删掉的错误结尾、正确结尾；合计 ≤ 16 字。

fits.zh: 用改掉一个平庸说法来亮出主张（“不是草稿，是你想要的那一版”）；一条搜索或命令被改准；否定式文案。

notFor.zh: 没什么可改的普通标题（用 type-enter）；超过约 30 个字符（中文 16 字）的句子；一支片两次以上（改两次口是口吃）。

pairs.note: already ends with a highlighter bar; do not add another mark

en: It depends on sound: key clicks on every character and a lower backspace; silent, it is just a subtitle machine.
Keep the monospace face (or one cell per character), or the line reflows as it types.
zh: 强依赖声音：键击声逐字对齐、退格音更低；无声就只剩字幕机。
保持等宽字体（或每字一个格），否则边打边重排、像抽搐。

upstream.name: 误删重打
upstream.summary: 打字机 error-retype——误删重打的"改口"三幕剧：打出平庸词 → 犹豫 → 退格删掉 → 更快打出卖点词
upstream.use: slogan/卖点字卡、否定式文案；文字自带时间性的入场
upstream.energy: 中低

overlaps.note: also reveals a line character by character, through scrambled glyphs and without a correction
a plain title entrance; use it unless the correction is the point

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A line bound to a time track: each word fills with the accent as it is read, a reading bar under it; or every character swells bold on the beat and springs back thin.
summary.zh: 文字绑在时间轴上：读到哪个词，哪个词就从左到右填亮、下面跟一条读指；或每个字在鼓点上笔画撑粗再弹回，最后一拍落成粗体。

bricks.fits: Text that keeps time with the sound: fill for a line said by the voice-over or sung, read at its pace; pump for one short word on the beat of the music before a drop.
bricks.notFor: Silent passages (fill then reads as a random colour change, pump as a twitch); fill on more than two rows or six words a screen; pump on a word over about 8 characters (4 in Chinese), or more than one pump passage a film.

intent.en: The text keeps time with the sound: fill leads the eye word by word with the voice, pump makes the beat visible in the strokes.
intent.zh: 文字跟着声音走：fill 随旁白一个词一个词牵着视线，pump 让鼓点在笔画上看得见。

content.en: fill: a line of up to six words (two rows at most) and its reading times, or a voice-over track to time it from; pump: one short word (≤ 8 chars) and the beats.
content.zh: fill：一句话，最多六个词、两行，加上每个词的朗读时间（或据以计时的旁白音轨）；pump：一个短词（≤ 4 字）和拍点。

fits.zh: 跟着声音走的字：fill 用在旁白念出或唱出的一句话上，按语速填色；pump 用在 drop 前随鼓点跳动的一个短词上。

notFor.zh: 无声段落（fill 读作莫名变色，pump 读作抽风）；fill 超过两行或一屏六个词；pump 用在超过约 8 个字符（中文 4 字）的词上，或一支片不止一段 pump。

pairs.note: bring the line on with blur, then let it read along

en: Both ways depend on sound: pump hits must land on the drum frame, fill windows must follow the voice's word boundaries.
pump needs a variable font; without one the weight jumps in steps.
One pump passage a film; it steals every scene it is in.
zh: 两式都强依赖声音：pump 命中帧要和鼓点同帧，fill 的填色区间要跟旁白的词边界。
pump 需要可变字体，没有就退成几档跳变。
pump 一支片只用一段，它抢戏。

upstream.name: 填色随读
upstream.summary: 每词深色从左到右填亮，进度跟语速，读完保持；活跃词下带读指下划线
upstream.use: 标题/标语与音轨强绑定的段落；A 绑节拍（鼓点），B 绑语音（旁白逐词）
upstream.energy: A 高（蹦迪感）/ B 中（跟读引导）

upstream.name: 字重脉冲
upstream.summary: 命中帧笔画瞬间变粗（stroke+字重跳变），~10f 衰减弹回；重音拍额外撑宽 8%
upstream.use: 标题/标语与音轨强绑定的段落；A 绑节拍（鼓点），B 绑语音（旁白逐词）
upstream.energy: A 高（蹦迪感）/ B 中（跟读引导）

overlaps.note: one word lit once at the peak, not tied to a voice or a beat
brings text on; type-sync acts on text already on screen, in time with the sound

summary.en: The same squares move from one chart into the next: they change colour in place, then fly group by group on arcs and land with one pulse.
summary.zh: 同一批方块从一张图走进下一张：先原地变色，再按组沿弧线飞过去，落地轻轻一胀。

bricks.fits: Any change of chart over the same counted items: grid to bands, bands to a sorted grid, bands to period columns, to an axis, to a closing rule.
bricks.notFor: Charts of different items, or of measures that are not counts (a square must stay one item).

intent.en: The same items move from one chart into the next, so the viewer trusts that every chapter counts the same things.
intent.zh: 同一批方块从一张图飞进下一张图，观众因此相信每一章数的都是同一批东西。

content.en: A counted set as groups (2–9, name ≤ 14 chars / 6 字, count) and the two layouts it flies between (grid, sorted, bands, share, periods, axis, rule).
content.zh: 一个分组的计数集合（2–9 组，名称 ≤ 14 字符 / 6 字，带数量），以及它在两种布局之间飞（网格、排序、分带、占比、时期、轴、尺）。

fits.zh: 同一批被计数的东西换一张图：网格到分带、分带到排序网格、分带到时期柱、到轴、到收尾尺。

notFor.zh: 不同东西的图，或不是计数的量（一个方块必须始终是一件东西）。

pairs.note: the layout it most often flies into
the closing light once the squares have landed

en: Never add or drop a square between layouts.
Over about 2,000 squares the flight turns to noise; count a larger unit.
zh: 换布局时一个方块都不能增减。
超过约 2000 个方块，飞行就成了噪点；改数更大的单位。

overlaps.note: unit-regroup migrates dots on springs through clusters, columns and the digits of the total; unit-flight marks rounded squares in place, then flies them group by group on arcs between the tally layouts (bands, periods, axis, rule)

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: One dot is one unit: the same dots migrate on staggered springs from a crowd into a cluster per group, a column per group and the digits of the total.
summary.zh: 一个点就是一份：同一批点按错峰弹簧迁徙，从散布聚成每组一簇、列成每组一柱，最后拼成总数的数字。

bricks.fits: A count whose parts matter (who, which kind) told as one continuous picture: crowd, groups, comparison, total.
bricks.notFor: Quantities that are not counts of items (money, time, percentages); more than about 400 units (one dot then stops being one thing).

intent.en: Every dot is one real item, so the viewer can follow one dot from the crowd into its group and into the total, and believes the chart and the number are the same things.
intent.zh: 每个点就是一个真实的个体，观众能跟着某一颗从人群走进分组、再走进总数，于是相信图表和数字是同一批东西。

content.en: 2–4 groups, each with a count and a name (≤ 14 chars); what one dot stands for; a headline per layout (≤ 30 chars); the total is computed.
content.zh: 2–4 个分组，各带数量和名称（≤ 6 字）；一个点代表多少；每一幕一行标题（≤ 14 字）；总数自动算出。

fits.zh: 组成部分有意义的计数（谁、哪一类），用一幅连续的画面讲：人群、分组、对比、总数。

notFor.zh: 不是“个数”的量（金额、时长、百分比）；超过约 400 个单位（一个点就不再是一个东西）。

pairs.note: a precise figure after the dots spell the rounded total

en: Use real labels and axes at film size; placeholder data cannot carry the story.
Never add or drop a dot between layouts, or the "same items" promise breaks.
With another live-chart move in the same film, use each once and in different sections.
zh: 用真标签、真轴标并按成片字号做，占位数据撑不起叙事。
换布局时一个点都不能增减，否则“同一批东西”的承诺就破了。
同片还有别的活体图表手法时，各用一次并错开段落。

upstream.name: 点阵重组
upstream.summary: 三幕 spring 错峰迁徙（stiffness 150、错峰 8f），终幕点阵拼数字
upstream.use: 数据叙事段落；分别讲"实时性"、"每个数字是一个人"、"增长装不下"
upstream.energy: 中高（数据即剧情）

overlaps.note: the tally style regroups squares between its own charts inside its template; unit-regroup is the same idea as a brick any style can use, with dots and a total spelled in them
tiles assemble one picture; unit-regroup keeps one mark per item through several layouts

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: While a page holds, a 3 px ink frame hops over its items in reading order, one hop a beat, landing on the beat.
summary.zh: 页面停留时，一个 3 px 墨框按阅读顺序在条目间跳，每拍一跳，正好落在拍点上。

bricks.fits: The hold of any plakat page with two or more items: rows, options, nodes.
bricks.notFor: Pages still landing (it starts once settled); single-item pages; dark films where a frame reads as a selection UI.

intent.en: Keep the beat on a still page without rewriting it: one small frame moves, the content stays readable.
intent.zh: 在静止的页面上保持节拍而不重写画面：只有一个小框在动，内容照样好读。

content.en: The page's item rects in reading order.
content.zh: 页面上各条目的矩形，按阅读顺序。

fits.zh: 任何有两项以上的 plakat 页的停留段：行、选项、节点。

notFor.zh: 还在落定中的页面（它从静止后才开始）；只有一项的页；框会被读成选中界面的暗色片。

en: Above about 140 BPM a hop each beat reads as nervous; walk every second beat there.
zh: 约 140 BPM 以上每拍一跳显得急，改成每两拍一跳。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A big word springs in letter by letter and its weight swings 780 → 200 → 800 → 430 on the beats; its full stop is the line colour.
summary.zh: 大字逐字弹入，字重在拍点上 780 → 200 → 800 → 430 摆动；句号是线色。

bricks.fits: A one-word hook in a variable display face.
bricks.notFor: Faces without a weight axis; long words or sentences.

intent.en: Make the beat visible in a word that stays in place and keeps reading.
intent.zh: 让节拍体现在一个原地不动、始终可读的词上。

content.en: One word of 4–7 letters.
content.zh: 四个汉字加句号。

fits.zh: 可变字体的一词钩子。

notFor.zh: 没有字重轴的字体；长词或整句。

en: Centre by the width at the current weight, or the word slides sideways as it swings.
zh: 按当前字重的宽度居中，否则摆动时整个词会左右滑。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A name snaps through the face's widths once a beat, condensed to normal, with a small punch-in on each step: the type breathes with the bar.
summary.zh: 名字每拍在字体的宽度之间跳一次，从窄到正常，每次轻推一下镜头：字跟着小节呼吸。

bricks.fits: A name or one word held over a bar on a drop.
bricks.notFor: Body text; words read while they change; faces without a width axis in English.

intent.en: The name moves with the music without moving at all: same place, same letters, a new width on every beat.
intent.zh: 名字跟着音乐动却没挪位置：同一位置、同样的字，每拍换一个宽度。

content.en: One word (≤ 10 chars) set in a variable face with a width axis.
content.zh: 一个词（≤ 4 字）。

fits.zh: 在 drop 上停留一个小节的名字或单词。

notFor.zh: 正文；变化中要读的词。

en: Fit the word at its widest step so no jump leaves the margins.
Steps, not tweens: a slide between widths reads as a rubber effect.
zh: 按最宽一步定字号，跳宽时不出边距。
是跳，不是渐变：宽度之间滑过去会像橡皮效果。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: One word of a line takes the beat: a charge of light sweeps through it and leaves it glowing, or it lands hollow inside a closing aiming ring and is lit solid on one frame.
summary.zh: 一句话里的一个词接住这一拍：一道光从左到右给它充能后持续泛光；或空心字落进收拢的瞄准圈，一帧内点亮成实心。

bricks.fits: The one payoff word of a slogan at the film's peak (faster, yours, the product name), on the drop of the music.
bricks.notFor: More than once a film; light grounds (both ways glow and are tuned for a dark ground); a word that is not the selling point of its line; dossier and blueprint styles (too loud).

intent.en: Only the selling word gets the charge, so the viewer knows which word the line is for; outline nails it down in two landings, size then substance.
intent.zh: 整句里只有卖点词被“通电”，观众知道这句话为哪个词而说；outline 式用两次落定（先尺寸、后质感）把它钉死。

content.en: A line (≤ 30 chars) and the one word in it to light (≤ 8 chars); outline works best on a single short word alone (≤ 6 letters, 4 Chinese).
content.zh: 一句话（≤ 14 字）和其中要点亮的那个词（≤ 4 字）；outline 式最适合单独一个短词（≤ 6 个字母，中文 4 字）。

fits.zh: 全片高潮处口号里那一个卖点词（更快、你的、产品名），落在音乐的 drop 上。

notFor.zh: 一支片用两次以上；浅色底（两式都靠发光，按深底调的）；不是句中卖点的词；dossier、blueprint 风格（太吵）。

en: The rest of the line stays still and plain; if everything moves, nothing is "the one word lit".
sweep must be fast (15–20 frames) and brightest at the front; slower it reads as a progress bar.
outline fills on one frame, never a fade, and wants a short hard sound on that frame.
zh: 关键词以外的字保持静止、不上色；全句都动就没有“只有它通电”的戏。
sweep 要快（15–20 帧）且波前最亮，慢了读作进度条。
outline 的填充必须一帧硬切、不能渐变，并在那一帧配一记短促重音。

upstream.name: 渐变充能词
upstream.summary: 黑底标语里关键词被渐变彩光从左到右快速扫过"充能"——波前字符辉光最强向后衰减，填满后字符间勾连细紫红闪电、整词稳态泛光呼吸
upstream.use: 标语里给单个动词/卖点词充能（Supercharged/faster/AI…）；能量高潮段的文字戏；黑场品牌片的口号帧
upstream.energy: 高（一词爆点，前后都该让位）

upstream.name: 空心字点亮
upstream.summary: 空心词（细暖灰描边、500 字重）从 3.2 倍急缓收缩落位，虚线大圆随后从 2.8 倍收到字周围并缓慢自转，左右水平虚线从画框边缘内伸；描边先微微增亮，实心白热字在一帧内硬切点亮，一闪辉光即定格
upstream.use: 单词式利益点/口号的重锤一拍；节奏卡点上的"钉子"镜；深底品牌片的强调帧
upstream.energy: 高（3.2 倍收缩 + 瞬时点亮，短时高冲击）

overlaps.note: whiteout-slam flashes the whole frame on the peak; word-ignite keeps the peak on one word
a quiet hand-drawn mark under the key word; word-ignite is the loud peak
words lit in time with a voice or a beat; word-ignite lights one word once

summary.en: A typed tag becomes a chip in one frame, glides small into its slot on a page, and a second cut reveals the finished page.
summary.zh: 打出的话题词一帧变成实体标签，缩小滑进页面里的槽位，再一刀切出完成的页面。

bricks.fits: Text turning into structure: a tag, mention, keyword or command becoming an object the product understands.
bricks.notFor: Long phrases; slow, gentle passages.

intent.en: Text becomes a thing the product understands: a hard cut gives a sure "done", and the one glide between two cuts makes it feel quick and certain.
intent.zh: 文字变成产品认得的实体：硬切给出“啪、成了”的确定感，两次硬切夹一次滑动显得又快又稳。

content.en: One tag, mention, keyword or command (≤ 14 chars), the finished page it lands on and its slot there.
content.zh: 一个标签、@提及、关键词或命令（≤ 6 字），它落进的成品页和页上的槽位。

fits.zh: 文字变成结构：标签、提及、关键词或命令变成产品认得的对象。

notFor.zh: 长词组（超过约 14 个字符就不像一个标记）；缓慢、温和的段落（切得很硬）。

pairs.note: a typed command can be refined first, then become a chip

en: The change to a chip is a one-frame hard cut; if you want a morph or a fade, use another brick, not a softened version of this one.
Do not add a flight or bounce: two cuts around one glide is the whole rhythm.
zh: 变成标签是一帧硬切；想要渐变或变形就换别的积木，别把这块改软。
别加飞行段或回弹：两次硬切夹一次滑动就是它的全部节奏。

upstream.name: 话题词实体化
upstream.summary: 话题词打字实体化——居中打出 "#word"（红实心光标恒亮），1 帧硬切变成宽大胶囊标签，hold 后缩小左移落到页面标签位，再 1 帧硬切揭示成品页；"两次硬切一次滑动"的节奏骨架
upstream.use: 标签/分类/关键词功能的演示段（笔记 app 打 tag、话题聚合）；"输入 → 变成 UI 实体 → 归位到成品"的三段式叙事
upstream.energy: 中（干脆利落，靠硬切给劲，不靠弹跳）

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A page writes itself: its blocks are uncovered left to right two at a time, an accent nib riding the front of the newest one.
summary.zh: 一页文档自己“写”出来：内容块两个一组按节拍从左到右揭开，强调色笔尖骑在最新一块的揭示前沿上。

bricks.fits: The first appearance of a document, report or dashboard page, the densest page of a film, uncovered in reading order at the pace it can be read.
bricks.notFor: A page already seen; pages with little text (it reads as a slow wipe) or blocks not in reading order; real screenshots shown as evidence (uncover them whole).

intent.en: A static page becomes a document being written, so the viewer reads along at the pace it appears and believes the document is real.
intent.zh: 静态页面变成“正在被写出来的文档”，观众跟着出现的速度读下去，并相信这份文档是真的。

content.en: One full page (a document, report or dashboard) with 4–20 blocks in reading order; real, publication-grade copy.
content.zh: 一整页（文档、报告或仪表盘），4–20 个按阅读顺序排列的内容块；文字要真实、达到发布水准。

fits.zh: 文档、报告或仪表盘页面第一次出现，是片中信息最密的一页，按阅读顺序、以读得过来的速度揭开。

notFor.zh: 已经看过的页面；字很少的页面（读成慢速擦除）或块不按阅读顺序的页面；作为证据的真截图（整张亮出）。

pairs.note: the camera pulls back from a tilted close-up while the page writes

en: The page must look published: native layout, filled with text; a token page with a slogan sinks the shot.
No real customer or member names in the mock content.
One nib at a time; two writing fronts split the eye.
zh: 页面要像发布过的：产品原生排版、文字铺满；敷衍的“贴图加标语”页会让整镜重做。
示意内容里绝不出现客户或成员的真名。
同一时间只有一个笔尖，两处同时写会分散视线。

upstream.name: 文档打字揭示
upstream.summary: 悬浮在暗场里的整页真排版文档窗口在光标后自己"写"出来、侧栏跟进、历史条目逐个落入轨道，相机从斜侧标题特写一路后撤到全窗
upstream.use: 文档/报告/笔记类功能镜头；信息密度最高的一拍
upstream.energy: 低中（信息密度最高，节奏放稳让观众读字）

overlaps.note: type-retype types one line character by character; write-on uncovers a whole page block by block
the upstream camera pull-back from a tilted close-up is tilt-camera or viewport-push run over this brick
a title entering; write-on is for a whole page of blocks

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: A question asked one word per beat at one fixed anchor; each word opens on the next ground of a lightness ramp through an aperture while its machine form types into the query line.
summary.zh: 问题一拍一个词落在同一个锚点上；每个词通过一个几何开口换到明度阶梯的下一级底色，同时它的机器写法打进下方查询行。

bricks.fits: The question of a film that answers it: the hook (the first word slams on beat 1) or the turn after an invert.
bricks.notFor: Copy over five words a state; statements that are not a question or a query; long words that would need to move the anchor.

intent.en: The eye never moves: one word per beat on the same spot, the ground flipping under it, so the question lands as rhythm and the query under it says it is real.
intent.zh: 视线不用移动：同一位置一拍一个词，底色在下面翻，问题变成节奏；下方的查询行说明它是真的。

content.en: 2–6 words or short phrases (≤ 14 chars, ≤ 5 words a state), each with an optional machine form (≤ 34 chars of code).
content.zh: 2–6 个词或短语（每个 ≤ 5 字，一个状态 ≤ 5 个词），每个可带一段机器写法（≤ 34 个字符的代码）。

fits.zh: 要回答一个问题的片子里的提问：钩子（第一个词在第 1 拍砸下）或反转后的提问。

notFor.zh: 一个状态超过五个词；不是问题或查询的陈述；长到要挪动锚点的词。

pairs.note: the question run over the candidates

en: Never move the anchor for a long word: split the question into two asks.
Do not crossfade grounds: every change is an aperture or an invert.
zh: 不要为长词挪锚点：把问题拆成两段提问。
底色不许淡入淡出：每次换底都是开口或反白。

intent.en: The peak is marked by being the only flash: the answer arrives on the hit, in the one colour that means "answer", and is given time to sink in.

notFor.zh: 同一支片里的第二个高潮；不是测量值的答案；开场。

en: One per film: a second flash makes the first ordinary.
Keep the answer in the normal-width Bold: the portal needs its counter.
zh: 一支片只用一次：第二次闪白会让第一次变平常。

summary.en: One ask becomes one task and one star: the user's message (with a file) and the product's reply arrive in the chat block, a chip says a task was created, the task row unfolds on a beam, runs, turns done, then shrinks into its ring and leaves as a star that stays in the sky.
summary.zh: 一个请求变成一件任务和一颗星：用户的消息（带一个文件）和产品的回复出现在对话块里，一个小标签说任务已创建，任务行沿光束展开、运行、完成，然后缩进状态环、化作一颗星飞上夜空留在那里。

bricks.fits: The first demo: the smallest whole loop of handing one thing off.
bricks.notFor: Tasks that need a screen to show their result; a product with no task list.

intent.en: Show the whole loop once, small: ask, task, done, kept.
intent.zh: 把整个循环小小地走一遍：请求、任务、完成、留下。

content.en: A caption, an optional file name, an ask and a reply (bubbles), a chip, a task title with running and done lines; optional: the picture the ask is about (it flies in and shrinks into the ask) and a decision asked with a recommendation (a question card with 2–4 options drawn in the canvas, the cursor picks the recommended one, the answer goes into the chat).
content.zh: 一句字幕、可选的文件名、请求和回复（气泡）、一个小标签、任务标题以及进行中和完成两行；可选：请求附带的图片（飞进来、缩进对话成缩略图），和带推荐的一问（画布里画的问卷卡，2–4 个选项，光标点推荐项，回答回填进对话）。

fits.zh: 第一段演示：交出一件事的最小完整循环。

notFor.zh: 结果要用一整屏才能展示的任务；没有任务列表的产品。

en: The done line is a glance (0.8 s): keep it to a few words of what came back ("3 icons"), not "Done"; the caption is the scene's one read sentence.
Pass the film's whole content as `film`: the scene draws its window of that film (the stars sent before it, the chat feed, the block's place), and its length is fitted with it.
The questionnaire is drawn by the engine, not a DOM brick: prop/choice-chip cannot be hung inside the stream canvas (see the card).
zh: 完成那行是扫一眼的（0.8 秒）：几个字写回来了什么（“3 个图标”），而不是“已完成”；这一屏要读的只有字幕。
把整片的 content 作为 `film` 传进来：场景画的是那部片在它这段的画面（之前派出的星、对话记录、块的位置），长度也按它拟合。
问卷由引擎在画布里画，不挂 DOM 积木：prop/choice-chip 挂不进 stream 的画布（见卡片）。

summary.en: A list steps up one row per beat; the word in the lens changes tone and face, and the ground follows it, all on the beat.
summary.zh: 一列词每拍上移一行，取景框里的词换色调换字形，背景跟着变，全都踩在拍上。

bricks.fits: A run of five to ten names the film wants felt rather than read: features, formats, users (hook, demo, rest).
bricks.notFor: Items that need a line each; fewer than five items; films without a steady beat.

intent.en: A run of names felt rather than read: one word a beat, each catching the lens and retinting the whole frame, so the list becomes a metronome.
intent.zh: 一串名字用来“感受”而不是读：每拍一个词进取景框，整屏跟着换色调，清单成了节拍器。

content.en: A lead of 1–3 words (Chinese ≤ 4 characters), 5–10 one-word items (≤ 10 chars, Chinese ≤ 3 characters), a counter label and an optional tagline (≤ 28 chars, Chinese ≤ 12 characters).
content.zh: 引导词 1–3 个词（中文 ≤ 4 字），5–10 个单词条目（≤ 10 字符、中文 ≤ 3 字），一个计数标签，收尾标语可选（≤ 28 字符、中文 ≤ 12 字）。

fits.zh: 想让观众“感受到”而不是逐条读的五到十个名字：功能、格式、用户。

notFor.zh: 每项要配一行说明；不到五项；没有稳定节拍的片子。

en: Sound-dependent: put every jump on a kick of the bed; without the beat it reads as the UI twitching.
Jump in the first frames of the beat and hold still for the rest; a smooth scroll is just a list.
Give more words than jumps (beats + 2), or the list visibly runs out at the end.
zh: 强依赖声音：每次跳都对齐配乐的鼓点；没有节拍读成界面抽风。
跳只占拍头几帧，其余时间静止；匀速滚动就只是列表。
词数要比跳数多（拍数 + 2），否则最后露出“下面没了”。

upstream.name: 节拍列表换色
upstream.summary: 三通道节拍器——深色场形容词列表逐拍上移一行，视口中央固定胶囊"接住"下一个词并换色，整场底色同拍跟换；行、色、场三通道锁死同一拍点
upstream.use: "同一产品多种气质/多主题展示"段落（modern/playful/expressive 式形容词连打）；全片节奏最密的一段；音乐段对拍
upstream.energy: 高（0.6s 一拍三通道齐跳，密度型高能）

overlaps.note: stagger-in brings a list in; beat-list steps through a list that is already there, one row a beat

summary.en: A dimmed bento wall lights up cell by cell: a comet runs once round each edge and the content brightens and floats up; then the camera eases in.
summary.zh: 压暗待命的 bento 墙逐格点亮：一道彗星流光沿格边跑一圈，格内内容随即提亮上浮；全亮后镜头缓推收住。

bricks.fits: A feature overview or a wall of capabilities that is already in place and should switch on rather than pour in; a calm, dark brand passage.
bricks.notFor: Light grounds (the dimmed state reads as faded, not waiting); a wall that should arrive with energy (fly-in decks); a second whole-wall light effect in the same film.

intent.en: Show that a whole set of capabilities is already there and simply switches on, so the viewer reads a calm, complete overview instead of things pouring in.
intent.zh: 表现一整面功能本来就在原位、只是被逐一点亮，观众读到的是一份沉稳、完整的总览，而不是一堆东西涌进来。

content.en: 3 or 6 cells, each a label and a title (en ≤ 16 chars, zh ≤ 7) with an optional number, image or figure; an eyebrow (en ≤ 24 chars, zh ≤ 10) and a title line (en ≤ 34 chars, zh ≤ 14).
content.zh: 3 或 6 格，每格一个标签和一个标题（英文 ≤ 16 字符，中文 ≤ 7 字），可带数字、图片或图形；一行眉标（英文 ≤ 24，中文 ≤ 10）和一行标题（英文 ≤ 34，中文 ≤ 14）。

fits.zh: 已经在原位、要“亮起来”而不是“涌进来”的功能总览或能力墙；沉稳的暗场品牌段。

notFor.zh: 浅色底（压暗态读作褪色而不是待命）；要带着冲劲进场的墙（用 deck-deal 飞入）；同一支片里第二次整墙光效。

pairs.note: the wall settles into a brand lockup

en: Use at most one whole-wall light effect per film; this and a blueprint wireframe draw together count as two.
Do not mix a fly-in into the light-up; a wall that should move belongs to deck-deal.
The dimmed state needs a dark ground; on light grounds it reads as a fault.
zh: 一支片整墙光效最多一次；本场景和蓝图描线同片用就算两次。
点亮时别再叠飞入位移；要动的墙去用 deck-deal。
压暗待命态依赖暗底；亮底上读作褪色故障。

upstream.name: 逐格点亮
upstream.summary: 暗场 3×2 bento 墙压暗待命，琥珀流光逐格描边一圈、内容随即提亮上浮，全亮后镜头缓推收住
upstream.use: 功能墙/卡片墙/整页界面的整体亮相；内容已在原位、要"显形"而非"涌入"的段落
upstream.energy: 中

summary.en: A page builds itself on a blueprint board: a line crosses it and each block flies in and snaps into its slot as the line passes; variant type docks bare shells first, then every character tumbles in through depth.
summary.zh: 页面在蓝图画板上自己长出来：扫描线掠过，扫到哪个槽位，那块就从画外飞入过冲贴合并被角标咬住；变体 type 先让无字骨架落位，再让每个字从纵深翻滚落定。

bricks.fits: A product that generates or builds a page (sites, apps, documents): the result assembling itself in seconds.
bricks.notFor: Products whose output is not a page; layouts the film must show in its real proportions (the board is fixed to seven blocks).

intent.en: The page builds itself in seconds, so the viewer feels the product generate the result, not draw it by hand.
intent.zh: 页面几秒内自己长出来，让观众感到结果是产品生成的，不是手画的。

content.en: A landing-page set: headline ≤ 24 chars, body ≤ 70 chars, badge, three nav items, two buttons, three stats (value + label), an optional picture; seven slot tags and three status words.
content.zh: 一套落地页内容：标题 ≤ 10 字、正文 ≤ 26 字、徽章、三个导航项、两个按钮、三项数据（数值加标签）、可选配图；七个槽位标签和三个状态词。

fits.zh: 生成或搭建页面的产品（网站、应用、文档）：结果几秒内自己装配起来。

notFor.zh: 产出不是页面的产品；必须按真实比例展示的版式（画板固定七块）。

pairs.note: build the page, then read it back

en: Seven blocks on a fixed board: a page with another structure needs its own scene, not squeezed copy.
The type variant's characters are unreadable while they tumble; the page reads only after frame 128.
zh: 画板固定七块：结构不同的页面要另做场景，不要硬塞文字。
type 变体翻滚中的字读不了；第 128 帧以后页面才可读。

upstream.name: 扫描装配飞入
upstream.summary: 页面开场是一张只有网格与虚线槽位的蓝图画板，一条亮扫描线自上而下掠过；扫到每个槽位，该处组件就从画外飞入过冲贴合，带方向性残影模糊与落位咬合角标——扫完整页恰好装配完成
upstream.use: "页面自己生成"的开场；AI 建站/自动排版类产品的核心演示；从空白到成品的能力叙事
upstream.energy: 中高（扫描线是稳的，但每次组件飞入都是一个爆点，密度递进）

upstream.name: 骨架装配落字
upstream.summary: 空的暗底网格上，无文字的组件骨架先从四面八方飞入贴合；随后各处文字逐字从 3D 空间旋转着飞来落位，先大标题后小标注，全部落位后页面成形
upstream.use: 页面/海报"自己长出来"的开场；排版类产品的能力展示；从骨架到成稿的两段式叙事
upstream.energy: 中高（骨架段稀疏、文字段密集，能量单调上升到收尾）

summary.en: The open: a line draws and becomes the caret, which types the brief and falls flat under it; with a second phrase the line rolls up a loop that carries the first phrase round and brings the second; the line tightens, contracts into the caret, and the caret takes the letters back.
summary.zh: 开场：一条线拉开、变成光标，敲出需求后平躺到字下面；有第二句时线卷起一个环，把第一句带走、把第二句带进来；线收紧、缩回光标，光标把字一个个收回去。

bricks.fits: The open of a video tool's reel: the request it starts from, and its revision going round the loop.
bricks.notFor: A brief that is not a request; two phrases that are not a request and its revision; more than five words a phrase.

intent.en: Start from the one sentence the tool is given, typed by the line that will make everything else.
intent.zh: 从交给工具的那一句话开始，由那条之后会变成一切的线敲出来。

content.en: One or two phrases of ≤ 5 words (≤ 24 characters); a second phrase is the first one revised.
content.zh: 一到两句，每句 ≤ 12 字；第二句是第一句改过之后的样子。

fits.zh: 视频工具作品集的开场：它接到的需求，以及需求绕一圈回来被改写。

notFor.zh: 不是需求的开场句；两句不是“需求和改写”；一句超过 12 字。

pairs.note: the word springs in after the caret closes

en: Text is read only while the line is straight: the loop carries the phrase unreadable for its middle beat by design.
Pass the film's chain as `before` / `after`: the hand-offs read the neighbours, and the link's length is fitted with them (a link alone fits differently).
zh: 只有线是直的时候字才可读：绕环中间那一拍看不清是设计如此。
把整片的链作为 before / after 传进来：交接读的是相邻环节，长度也和它们一起拟合（单独一环拟合出的长度不同）。

summary.en: The last world shrinks into the anchor, which squashes and strikes on the bar line; a ring runs out and a burst of dots condenses onto the claim letters.
summary.zh: 上一屏整体缩进锚点，锚点压扁后在小节线上击出；一道圆环扩散，一阵网点飞出凝成主张的字。

bricks.fits: The climax of a print film: one claim in one or two lines.
bricks.notFor: Claims longer than two short lines; quiet films.

intent.en: Everything the film showed collapses into the one brand piece and bursts out as the claim, so the claim reads as what it all adds up to.
intent.zh: 片里展示的一切塌进那块品牌件，再爆成主张，主张读起来就是一切的总和。

content.en: One or two claim lines (≤ 15 chars / 8 字 each); the field kind of the world that collapses.
content.zh: 一到两行主张（每行 ≤ 15 字符 / 8 字）；塌缩前那一屏的场种类。

fits.zh: 印刷风格片的高潮：一两行主张。

notFor.zh: 超过两行的主张；安静的片。

en: The strike must sit on a bar line; the anticipation squash only works if it holds still.
zh: 击出必须落在小节线上；预备的压扁只有静止才成立。

summary.en: A set of cards lands one by one on a pile, then fans out with one card drawn, or keeps arriving while older cards step back.
summary.zh: 一组卡逐张落成一摞，再展成扇面抽出一张；或者源源不断地压上来，旧卡后退、变虚、变暗。

bricks.fits: Telling the viewer there is a set (templates, results, documents): fan for a set with one pick, stream for a quantity read or processed.
bricks.notFor: Reading what is on the cards (only the drawn or newest card is legible); fewer than five items; a set whose members must be compared side by side.

intent.en: Say 'there is a whole set of these' in one image: the pile gives weight (how many), then either the fan shows they differ and picks one, or the stream shows a steady throughput being read.
intent.zh: 一个画面讲清“有一整套这种东西”：先用一摞给出分量（数量感），再要么展成扇面看出各不相同并抽出主角，要么源源不断压上来，读出持续的吞吐量。

content.en: 5–13 cards (odd for the fan), each a title and a label (en ≤ 16 chars, zh ≤ 7) with an image or figure; a title (en ≤ 30, zh ≤ 13), optional subtitle (en ≤ 48, zh ≤ 22) and eyebrow (en ≤ 24, zh ≤ 10).
content.zh: 5–13 张卡（扇面用奇数），每张一个标题和一个标签（英文 ≤ 16 字符，中文 ≤ 7 字），配图或图形；一行标题（英文 ≤ 30，中文 ≤ 13），可选副标题（英文 ≤ 48，中文 ≤ 22）和眉标（英文 ≤ 24，中文 ≤ 10）。

fits.zh: 告诉观众“有一组这样的东西”（模板、结果、文档）：扇面式用于一组里挑出一个，流水式用于交代读过或处理过的数量。

notFor.zh: 要读卡上写了什么（只有被抽出或最新的一张看得清）；少于五项；需要并排比较的一组。

pairs.note: the drawn card becomes the one product in focus

en: More cards or a wider stagger push the landing into the fan, so cards turn while still flying; move the fan later when adding cards.
Use an odd count for the fan; with an even count there is no centre card to draw.
Keep one card as the lead in the real material; a fan of equals has no answer.
In stream, more cards than the length allows leave the last ones mid-flight; ten or so at the default pace.
zh: 加卡或加大错峰会把落摞吃进展开段，卡“还在飞就开始转”；加卡要把展开往后推。
扇面用奇数张；偶数张没有中心卡可抽。
真实素材里也要留一张主角；全是平等的卡，扇面没有落点。

summary.en: Done means checked: a gate (a vertical stroke of the thread) rises from its middle; the item, hung on a beam, slides up to it, is stopped with a white flash and sent back ("not passed" in grey), is reworked, slides through and is ringed in the accent ("checked"); then the chat block folds back into the spine.
summary.zh: 完成是核对过的完成：一道关卡（线的一段竖笔）从中间升起；挂在光束上的那件东西滑到关卡前，白光一闪被拦下、退回（灰色的“没通过”），返工后滑过关卡、被强调色圈住（“核对通过”）；然后对话块折回主干。

bricks.fits: The proof of an agent's result: it was checked before it came back.
bricks.notFor: A product without a check step; several items at once.

intent.en: Show that a result is not "done" until it has passed a check, failing once first.
intent.zh: 让人看到结果在通过核对之前不算“完成”，而且先失败一次。

content.en: A caption, a gate word (≤ 10 characters / 4 Chinese characters), an item label, a fail line and a pass line; optional: the product's explanation in the chat after the stop, and a relation graph (3–6 named arcs to one node, one thick arc back, two captions).
content.zh: 一句字幕、关卡上的词（≤ 10 字符 / 4 个汉字）、一件东西的名字、没通过一行和通过一行；可选：挡回后产品在对话里的解释，和关系图（3–6 道带名字的弧射向一个节点、一道粗弧回传、两句字幕）。

fits.zh: agent 结果的证明：它是核对过才回来的。

notFor.zh: 没有核对步骤的产品；同时多件东西。

pairs.note: the chat block's fold back into the line

把整片的 content 作为 `film` 传进来：场景画的是那部片在它这段的画面（之前派出的星、对话记录、块的位置），长度也按它拟合。

summary.en: A question and its options as chips; a pointer presses one, the rest fade, the choice rises and the result it caused appears: the old value struck, the new one, a note.

intent.en: Show one choice as cause and effect: the options, the press, the chosen one standing alone, then what it changed, so the viewer sees what choosing this does.
intent.zh: 把一次选择演成因果：几个选项、按下、选中项独自留下，然后是它带来的改变，观众看到“选了它会怎样”。

content.zh: 一个问题（英文 ≤ 30 字符，中文 ≤ 12 字），3–6 个短选项（英文 ≤ 18，中文 ≤ 7），一旧一新两个数值（≤ 8 / 6 字符）可带单位，一句说明（英文 ≤ 28，中文 ≤ 12）；眉标可选。

fits.zh: 演示中段的一个决定和它可量化的效果：选了某个套餐、档位或选项，以及它改变的那个数字。

notFor.zh: 超过六个选项；没有结果可展示的选择；多选。

没有可量化的结果，按下就没有回报；不改变任何可见东西的选择换别的场景。

summary.en: From one row to the whole wall: the camera starts tight on one tracked row and cranes up and out until the whole window sits on the stage, rows washing with light as the frame passes them.

intent.en: Start on one concrete item, then widen to the system around it, so the viewer understands 'the row you just saw is one cell of a whole wall, and it is done'.
intent.zh: 从一个具体条目起，再拉开到它所在的整个系统，观众读出“刚才那一行，只是这一整面墙的一格，而且已经完成了”。

content.en: A table of 8–12 rows, each a name (en ≤ 16 chars, zh ≤ 6) and a state (en ≤ 9, zh ≤ 4), one row tracked; an eyebrow, a title (en ≤ 18, zh ≤ 8), a caption (en ≤ 34, zh ≤ 14) and a counting number (≤ 8 chars) with its label.

fits.zh: 表现一个团队在共享空间里一起干活：同一块白板上的具名光标，一人在写，其余人围过来。

漂移的光标要避开正在读的区域；群演是氛围，要让戏。
换打字标题后保持自然的停顿（空格多停），并核对“就绪”在最后一个字之后才出现。

content.zh: 一页产品界面上的四块面板，每块一个标题（≤ 16 字符、中文 ≤ 6 字）和点一下就有的回应（切换区间、悬停提示、开关、表格行）；外加产品名和导航。

content.zh: 一句字幕和可选的副句，2–5 天（每天一个分隔、一问一答，扫一眼）、今天的一问一答、三张卡各一句（≤ 34 字符 / 14 个汉字）；可选：一张汇总卡的标题，代替三张卡，卡里可带自己的行，三句可用大字。

summary.en: A pile of cards on a dark table is dealt into a page board with hard-accelerating cues while the camera chases the deal into a runway view of the full board.
summary.zh: 暗色桌面上的一摞实体卡，像发牌一样硬加速甩进页面网格；相机追着发牌升起后仰，落在整块满板的跑道式俯瞰上定格。

bricks.notFor: The opening shot of a film (it needs a lead-in); fewer than ten distinct cards; reading any one card; calm passages.

intent.en: Build the first impression of volume with suspense: a pile raises 'what is it?', then dozens of items fly into place faster and faster, so the viewer feels content pouring in.
intent.zh: 带着悬念建立“量很大”的第一印象：先是一摞牌（这是什么？），再是几十项越甩越快地飞进页面各就各位，观众感到东西源源不断涌进来。

content.en: 10 distinct card crops from the film (real page or item slices; 16 more are dealt from the same ten), a two-line title (en ≤ 26 chars, zh ≤ 10), a count label (en ≤ 22, zh ≤ 9) and the board's page title (en ≤ 14, zh ≤ 6).
content.zh: 10 张影片自己的卡面切图（真实页面或条目切片；另 16 张由这十张复用），两行标题（英文 ≤ 26 字符，中文 ≤ 10 字）、计数说明（英文 ≤ 22，中文 ≤ 9）、页面板标题（英文 ≤ 14，中文 ≤ 6）。

fits.zh: “量很大”的第一印象：一个很快被填满的列表页或卡片墙，“源源不断涌进来”，放在片子节奏爬升的段落。

notFor.zh: 全片第一镜（需要前面有铺垫）；少于十张不同的卡；要读某一张卡；安静的段落。

pairs.note: after the board fills, a standing wall in flow carries the volume on

en: Use real page or item slices for the cards; hand-made fake cards read as fake at once.
Keep the accelerating stagger; all cards flying at once reads as an explosion.
Compute the anticipation in pixels, not as a share of the move; at the far camera a textbook ratio is too small to see.
Do not open the film with it; it needs a lead-in to tell where the pile comes from.
zh: 卡面要用真实页面或条目切片；手搓的假卡一眼假。
保留错峰递加速；所有卡同时飞读作爆炸。
预备动作先按像素算再算比例；拉远机位下教科书比例的位移小到看不见。
别当全片第一镜；要有前戏交代牌堆从哪来。

summary.en: The stream opening: a desk piles up (windows, alerts, a sticky note, fourteen dialog copies, a cursor that never gets to click), freezes on one line, the mascot drops in, one glowing thread pierces every item, goes taut and reels them in, and the emptied desk sinks into the night as the thread straightens into the spine. `opening: 'night'` shows the pile as dark cards over the night.
summary.zh: stream 的开场：桌面越堆越多（窗口、弹窗、便签、十四个对话框副本、一直没点下去的光标），定格在一句话上；吉祥物落下，一根发光的线穿过每件东西、绷紧、一口收走；空了的桌面沉进夜空，线拉直成主干。`opening: 'night'` 把这堆东西换成夜空里的暗色卡片。

bricks.fits: The open of a product that takes work off people: the overload, then the one thread that takes it.
bricks.notFor: A calm opening; a product that does not take work off people; a pile that must be read item by item.

intent.en: Start from the overload everyone recognises, then let one thread take all of it in one move.
intent.zh: 从人人认得的“太多了”开始，然后让一根线一下子全部接走。

content.en: Three sessions, four alerts, a two-line note (≤ 36 characters / 16 Chinese characters each), one freeze line (≤ 24 / 12); optional: how many dialog copies cascade (4–30), 1–6 alerts, and the mascot's size (`mascotSize`).
content.zh: 三个会话、四个弹窗、两行便签（每行 ≤ 36 字符 / 16 个汉字）、一句定格（≤ 24 / 12）；可选：层叠的弹窗副本数（4–30）、1–6 条通知、吉祥物尺寸（`mascotSize`）。

fits.zh: 帮人接活的产品的开场：先是过载，再是一根线接走一切。

notFor.zh: 安静的开场；不是替人接活的产品；要一条条读的堆。

pairs.note: next: the product names itself from the thread

en: Only the note and the freeze line are read: keep everything else short; the freeze line holds while the bed breaks.
Pass the film's whole content as `film`: the scene draws its window of that film (the stars sent before it, the chat feed, the block's place), and its length is fitted with it.
A film's own mascot (`mascot`) is drawn in the 60 px box unless `mascotSize` gives its own: about 90 px sitting and 240 px dropped keep it the hero of the threading.
zh: 只有便签和定格那句要读：其余都要短；定格那句停住时音乐床断开。
把整片的 content 作为 `film` 传进来：场景画的是那部片在它这段的画面（之前派出的星、对话记录、块的位置），长度也按它拟合。
影片自己的吉祥物（`mascot`）默认塞进 60 px 的框，要用 `mascotSize` 给尺寸：坐着约 90 px、掉进桌面约 240 px，串联时它才是主角。

summary.en: The source document parks at the left, still being read, while findings are dealt one by one on the right, each tied to its evidence line.
summary.zh: 来源文档退到左边只露一截、还在慢慢往下读，右边一条条发出结论药丸，每条都连回文档里划出的依据句。

bricks.fits: A narrated passage that gives conclusions one at a time and must keep their source in view: analysis results, review findings, reasons for a recommendation.
bricks.notFor: More than three findings (a caption needs about 1.2 s to be read); conclusions without a source line; a loud beat (the scene has no peak, its life is the slow scroll).

intent.en: Give conclusions one at a time without losing their source: the document stays on screen and is still being read, and every finding is visibly pulled out of one of its lines.
intent.zh: 一条条给出结论又不丢出处：文档留在画面里、还在被读，每条结论都看得出是从它的某一行里长出来的。

content.en: A source document (10–40 lines; 1–3 real evidence lines, en ≤ 64 chars, zh ≤ 28) and 2–3 findings, each a name (en ≤ 18, zh ≤ 7), an optional value and a caption (en ≤ 40, zh ≤ 16), paced to one narrated sentence each.
content.zh: 一份来源文档（10–40 行，其中 1–3 行是真实证据句，英文 ≤ 64 字符，中文 ≤ 28 字）和 2–3 条结论，每条一个名称（英文 ≤ 18，中文 ≤ 7）、可选数值和一句说明（英文 ≤ 40，中文 ≤ 16），每条配一句旁白的时间。

fits.zh: 旁白一条条给出结论、又必须让出处一直在画面里的段落：分析结果、审阅意见、推荐理由。

notFor.zh: 超过三条结论（每句说明要约 1.2 秒才读得完）；没有出处行的结论；响亮的一拍（这一屏没有峰值，靠缓慢滚动维持生气）。

pairs.note: a faster cut through several pages when the findings come from many sources

en: Three findings at most; a fourth leaves no time for its caption to be read.
The document must be longer than the whole scroll, or the page scrolls into blank space.
Re-time the deal to the real captions; caption length sets how fast the word-by-word darkening reads.
zh: 最多三条；第四条没时间读完说明。
文档要比整段滚动行程长，否则末段滚出空白。
换真实文案后按句长重排发牌时间；说明的长短决定逐词加深读起来的快慢。

upstream.name: 文档驻留发牌
upstream.summary: 文档不淡出而是向左滑出只露约 35% 宽并微缩到 0.92，右侧按旁白节奏慢速发牌三张白底描边药丸（outBack 弹入），每张落定后其下方字幕逐词加深、下一张到来前整句淡出，左侧文档全程极缓慢自动滚动保持"正在被读"
upstream.use: 旁白驱动的"分析结论逐条给出"段落；文档理解、推荐理由、审阅意见类产品的核心说明镜头
upstream.energy: 低（慢发牌节奏，全片无峰值；靠自动滚动维持活性）

summary.en: Two to four benefit words relayed in the centre, each with its own geometry behind it: rings that spin, rings that lock, a metal sheen for the last.
summary.zh: 两到四个利益词在画面中央接力，每个词背后一套专属几何：转动的环、咬合的环，最后一个词扫过金属光泽。

bricks.fits: A three-point benefit statement (quick, locked, polished) or a set of values said one word at a time, in the middle of a film.
bricks.notFor: Words longer than one word (three Chinese characters); calm films (nothing on screen ever stops); light grounds.

intent.en: Let each benefit word be argued by its own geometry, spinning rings for quick, locking rings for tight, a metal sheen for the final word, so three words become one continuous claim rather than three title cards.
intent.zh: 让每个利益词由专属几何替它论证：转动的环是“快”、咬合的环是“紧”、金属光泽给最后那个结论词，三个词连成一句连贯的主张，而不是三张字卡。

content.en: 2–4 single benefit words of the same grammatical kind (en ≤ 9 chars each, zh ≤ 3), optional one-line subs (en ≤ 40, zh ≤ 16), and which geometry backs each word.
content.zh: 2–4 个同一词性的利益词（每个英文 ≤ 9 字符，中文 ≤ 3 字），可选每词一行说明（英文 ≤ 40，中文 ≤ 16），并指定每个词配哪套几何。

fits.zh: 片子中段的三点式利益陈述（快、稳、精致），或一词一词说出的一组价值观。

notFor.zh: 超过一个词的说法（中文超过三个字）；安静的片子（画面上始终没有静止）；浅色底。

pairs.note: the polished last word hands over to the lockup

en: The words must be the same kind (three adjectives or three comparatives) and of similar length; a long word pushes out of its ring.
Give the sheen to the last word only; sheen on every word removes the sense of a conclusion.
Keep the dust, shared stage light and progress bar; without them the relay falls back into three separate cards.
zh: 几个词要同一词性、长度相近；长词会顶出圆环。
金属扫光只给最后一个词；每个词都扫就没有结论感。
保留背景微尘、共用舞台光和进度条；没有它们接力会退回三张分开的字卡。

upstream.name: 利益词接力
upstream.summary: 三个利益词各带一套专属几何接力——虚线大圆减速自转 + 彗星弧飞跑 → 三实线圆 trim 依次生长后收拢咬紧 → 镀铬金属 sheen 扫过后一拍收成纯白；旧词缩到 0.86 淡出，新词描边→填充揭示
upstream.use: 三点式利益陈述（更快/更好/更强）；品牌价值观段落；需要"一词一世界"的中段推进
upstream.energy: 中高（三拍推进 + 全程几何运动 + 背景粒子，无静止帧）
