summary.en: One evening of asks: the chat block lowers and a task list grows out beside it; every ask adds a running row and launches a star from its ring; then a burst of unnamed tasks (those past the film's `ui.cap` queued; without it the last two) and the list's counts. Too many to read is the point.
summary.zh: 一晚上的请求：对话块下移，旁边长出任务列表；每个请求加一行进行中的任务，并从它的环里飞出一颗星；然后是一阵没名字的任务（超过整片 `ui.cap` 的在排队；没设时最后两个）和列表的计数。多到读不完正是要说的。

bricks.fits: Showing volume after the single loop: the product takes many things in one evening.
bricks.notFor: A scene where each task must be read; fewer than three asks.

intent.en: Make the sky fill up: the scale of what is handed off, felt rather than read.
intent.zh: 让夜空被填满：交出去的量是感到的，不是读到的。

content.en: A caption, 3–8 asks (each a bubble and a task title, read at a glance), a number of further tasks (0–16); optional: a file chip on an ask, a progress line on its row, the list's filter tabs, and one quoted follow-up sent along a beam to an earlier task's star (after the burst, or between the asks); file chips inside the bubbles.
content.zh: 一句字幕、3–8 个请求（每个是一个气泡和一个任务标题，一扫而过）、额外任务数（0–16）；可选：交代带文件签、任务行第二行进展、列表筛选页签，以及一条引用补充沿光束续派给之前那颗星（排在一口气派出之后，或插在派发之间）；文件签画进气泡里。

fits.zh: 单个循环之后展示量：一晚上接下很多事。

notFor.zh: 每件任务都要读的场景；少于三个请求。

pairs.note: next: one job that keeps going

en: Only the caption is read; the rows scroll by. Do not raise their size to make them readable, the point is that there are too many.
Pass the film's whole content as `film`: the scene draws its window of that film (the stars sent before it, the chat feed, the block's place), and its length is fitted with it.
zh: 只有字幕要读；任务行是滚过去的。不要为了能读而放大它们，要说的正是太多了。
把整片的 content 作为 `film` 传进来：场景画的是那部片在它这段的画面（之前派出的星、对话记录、块的位置），长度也按它拟合。

source.path: assets/templates/stream/film.js renderEvening, listScrollEased, renderBG stars; sched.js evening

needsFilm.shape: the stream template's content.js: { product, ui, opening, lockup, seed, scenes: [the skeleton's scenes by type, in order] }

summary.en: A column of page cards steps one card at a time only when the word changes, while a noun holds and the verb beside it is relayed in place.
summary.zh: 左列页面卡只在换词时步进一格，右边名词不动、动词原位接力，词块中心对准焦点卡。

bricks.fits: One subject, several capabilities, each with a page that proves it (plans, renders, ships); a tour of a portfolio or of product scenes.
bricks.notFor: Capabilities with no page to show; more than four verbs; light grounds (the alternating cards want a dark ground).

intent.en: Pair each claim with its proof: the verb on the right is the argument, the page card on the left is the evidence, and the column steps only when the word changes, so text and picture footnote each other.
intent.zh: 让每个说法都配上证据：右边的动词是论点，左边的页面卡是证据，只在换词时步进一格，文字和画面互为注脚。

content.en: One noun (en ≤ 10 chars, zh ≤ 4), 2–4 one-word verbs (en ≤ 9, zh ≤ 3) with optional notes (en ≤ 44, zh ≤ 20), and 4–8 page cards (real screenshots, the verbs plus at least two; card k + 1 proves verb k).
content.zh: 一个名词（英文 ≤ 10 字符，中文 ≤ 4 字），2–4 个一词动词（英文 ≤ 9，中文 ≤ 3），可选每词一行说明（英文 ≤ 44，中文 ≤ 20），加 4–8 张页面卡（真实截图，比动词多至少两张；第 k+1 张证明第 k 个动词）。

fits.zh: 一个主体、几种能力，每种都有一页能证明它（规划、渲染、发布）；作品集或产品多场景的巡礼。

notFor.zh: 没有页面可展示的能力；超过四个动词；浅色底（黑白相间的卡要暗底）。

pairs.note: one source page dealt into findings when the proof is a single document

en: The column must stand still between words and step only on the change; a constant scroll turns the evidence into wallpaper.
Align the word block's centre exactly with the focused card's middle; a few pixels off and the editorial rigour collapses.
Use real screenshots and grade their brightness by hand so the alternating cards stay readable.
zh: 左列在两次换词之间必须完全静止，只在换词时步进；持续滚动会让证据沦为背景装饰。
词块垂直中心要和焦点卡中点精确对齐；差几个像素，编辑部式的严谨感就塌了。
页面卡用真实截图，并人工分档亮度，保证相间的卡都读得清。

upstream.name: 胶片词接力
upstream.summary: 左列黑白相间等高页面卡步进滚动（焦点卡全亮、邻卡离焦压暗）、右侧衬线大词原位接力（名词恒定+动词轮换）——切词瞬间才滚动一格，词块垂直中心与当前页面卡中点精确对齐
upstream.use: "一个主体 × 多种能力"的枚举段（Shotcraft frames/builds/ships…）；作品集/案例流展示；产品多场景巡礼
upstream.energy: 中低（编辑部气质，节奏靠切词的"咔哒"感）

summary.en: The sheets slide off and an index card is dealt on; every claim of the film is entered one a beat, each with its exhibit tab pressed and its source.
summary.zh: 纸张滑走，一张索引卡发上来；片子里的每条断言每拍记入一行，各自压上证物标签，并注明出处。

bricks.fits: A recap before the name: every claim and where it came from.
bricks.notFor: films with one exhibit; more than six claims.

intent.en: Close the file: the viewer sees every claim again, each tied to its source.
intent.zh: 合上卷宗：观众再看一遍每条断言，各自连着出处。

content.en: A claim in 1–2 phrases and 2–6 rows (exhibit number, the claim ≤ 36 chars, its source).
content.zh: 1–2 段断言和 2–6 行（证物编号、断言 ≤ 16 字、出处）。

fits.zh: 报名字前的回顾：每条断言和它的出处。

notFor.zh: 只有一份证物的片子；超过六条断言。

en: Restate claims the film struck; no new ones here.
zh: 只复述片子里划过的断言；这里不加新的。

summary.en: An exhibit is laid on the mat, the rest of the page veiled, its printed claim struck with the highlighter and tied to its sticker; the claim rises on the mat, the terms under it.
summary.zh: 一份证物放上垫板，页面其余部分压暗，印出的断言被荧光笔划出并用引线连到贴纸；断言在垫板上升起，条件跟在下面。

bricks.fits: Each published source of a claim: the cold open, every new exhibit.
bricks.notFor: claims with no printed source; pages whose claim cannot be struck where it is.

intent.en: Show the claim where it was printed and strike it, so the viewer sees the evidence before the words.
intent.zh: 在印出断言的原处把它划出来，让观众先看到证据再看到话。

notFor.zh: 没有印刷出处的断言；断言无法在原处划出的页面。

pairs.note: the next claim on the same page

en: Strike only what the page prints; a number the page does not print goes to the worksheet.
One band lit at a time.
zh: 只划页面上印着的；页面没印的数字放到演算纸上算。

summary.en: The whole flow as an exploded view: 2–5 nodes float apart on dash-dot centre lines between two amber ends, then snap into one chain on a beat; amber brackets over the ends, a loop label, a claim and its sub.
summary.zh: 把整个流程画成爆炸图：2–5 个节点沿点划线中心线悬开，夹在两个琥珀色端点之间，然后在一拍上咬合成一条链；两端加琥珀色括号，再加回环标签、一句主张和副句。

bricks.fits: The flow with people at both ends: who starts it, what runs, who signs.
bricks.notFor: Flows with branches; more than five nodes; flows with no person (the ends are people).

intent.en: Assemble the system in front of the viewer: separate parts click into one chain, and the people at its ends are amber.
intent.zh: 在观众眼前把系统装起来：分散的部件咔哒合成一条链，两端的人是琥珀色。

content.en: Title (≤ 26), two ends (word ≤ 5, sub ≤ 16), an end tag, 2–5 nodes (≤ 12), a loop label, a claim (≤ 36), a sub.
content.zh: 标题（≤ 10 字）、两端（词 ≤ 2 字、副注 ≤ 6 字）、端点标签、2–5 个节点（≤ 4 字）、回环标签、主张（≤ 14 字）、副句。

fits.zh: 两端是人的流程：谁发起、跑什么、谁签字。

notFor.zh: 有分支的流程；超过五个节点；没有人的流程（两端代表人）。

en: A six-word claim reads past the build at 100 BPM; keep it to five words.
zh: 100 BPM 下六个词的主张读不完；控制在五个词以内（中文 ≤ 14 字）。

summary.en: A big word and one line at the left; at the right a procedural field round the anchor acts the feature out and steps one state a beat; on paper or reversed out of ink.
summary.zh: 左边一个大词加一行字；右边围着锚点的程序场把功能演出来，每拍走一步；纸底或墨底反白。

bricks.fits: One feature per card in a launch: interference, separation, a log, a waveform, a grid filling in.
bricks.notFor: Features that need a screenshot; more than one line of copy.

intent.en: Each feature is acted out by the picture: the field round the anchor changes its function to show what the word means.
intent.zh: 每个功能由画面演出来：锚点周围的场改变自己的函数，表现这个词的意思。

content.en: A word (≤ 11 chars / 6 字), a line (≤ 32 / 16 字), an optional label (≤ 30 / 16 字), a field kind, paper or ink; `print: 'blocks'` after a dot-quantize seam.
content.zh: 一个词（≤ 11 字符 / 6 字），一行字（≤ 32 / 16 字），可选标签（≤ 30 / 16 字），场的种类，纸底或墨底；接在 dot-quantize 之后用 `print: 'blocks'`。

fits.zh: 发布片里一卡一个功能：干涉、分离、日志、波形、网格填满。

notFor.zh: 需要截图的功能；超过一行文案。

en: Cards with the same `pattern` draw the same field: reuse it only when the film means 'the same one again'.
zh: `pattern` 相同的卡画同一个场：只在片子要说“又是同一个”时复用。

summary.en: A detail card builds itself field by field as a fill cursor jumps ahead from slot to slot; one value is struck and replaced on the way.
summary.zh: 一张详情卡像被逐字段自动填好：填充光标领先一格跳到下一个槽位，骨架让位给内容；途中一个数值被划掉、换成新值。

bricks.fits: Showing structured extraction or autofill, or walking the viewer through what one item carries (picture, name, tags, a changed value, key lines, variants, an action).
bricks.notFor: A list of many items (one card only); a real product page shown as a screenshot; a cut that must land on one big moment (the card is a run of small events).

intent.en: Turn 'a card appears' into 'a form is being filled': the eye is led through what one item carries in order, and the one value struck and replaced is the scene's single change of meaning.
intent.zh: 把“出现一张卡”变成“一张表正在被填写”：视线被领着按顺序走一遍一个条目的信息结构，途中被划掉换新的那个数值，是整屏唯一的语义变化。

content.en: One item: an optional picture, an eyebrow (en ≤ 28 chars, zh ≤ 12), a one-word name (en ≤ 10, zh ≤ 5), 2–3 tags, an old and a new value (≤ 6 chars) with a chip, 2–3 key lines (en ≤ 38, zh ≤ 18), a swatch label and a call to action.
content.zh: 一个条目：可选一张图、一行眉标（英文 ≤ 28 字符，中文 ≤ 12 字）、一个词的名称（英文 ≤ 10，中文 ≤ 5）、2–3 个标签、一旧一新两个数值（≤ 6 字符）加一枚小标、2–3 行要点（英文 ≤ 38，中文 ≤ 18）、色卡说明和一个按钮文字。

fits.zh: 表现结构化抽取或自动填写，或带观众过一遍一个条目带着哪些信息（图、名称、标签、一个改变的数值、要点、变体、操作）。

notFor.zh: 很多项的列表（只放一张卡）；当作截图展示的真实产品页；需要落在一个大时刻上的镜头（这张卡是一串小事件）。

pairs.note: show the finished item as the one in focus

en: Keep the ~1.3 s slow push after the last field; it is the time to read the whole card, not dead air.
Key lines do not wrap; longer copy or Chinese must be refitted to size and line length or it overflows the card.
When the real item has more or fewer fields, re-space the timetable by field group; keep the struck value in the middle.
zh: 最后一个字段落定后约 1.3 秒的缓推是给观众通读整卡的，别当空白砍掉。
要点行不换行；更长的文案或中文要重配字号与行长，否则溢出卡边。
真实条目字段数变了，要按字段分组重排时间表；划价换新那一下留在中段。

upstream.name: 字段逐个落位
upstream.summary: 详情卡像被逐字段抓取般自建——一枚"填充光标"领先跳格，图→标题→分类 pill 依次 pop→原价出现后被划线降级、强调色新价 spring 跳出→正文逐行揭示且高亮块由左向右刷过→色卡点亮→按钮填满，整卡全程极慢 scale 前推
upstream.use: 商品/条目详情页的能力展示；"结构化抽取""自动填充""数据自己长出来"类叙事的主镜头
upstream.energy: 中（连续小事件密集排布，无单点爆发；靠前推保持推进感）

summary.en: One to three figures a beat apart, each resolving out of symbols (or counting) in its own digit slots, its label rising beside it.
summary.zh: 一到三个数字隔一拍出现，每个在自己的数位里从乱码中定格（或滚动计数），标签随后在旁边升起。

bricks.fits: The figures that explain an answer or a problem: one line edited, files rechecked, times faster.
bricks.notFor: More than three numbers (a table or a chart); numbers without labels; decoration.

intent.en: Each figure is a fact that arrives on the beat and stays still to be read; the scramble says it was measured, not typed.
intent.zh: 每个数字是一条在拍子上到达、然后停住让人读的事实；乱码定格说明它是量出来的，不是写上去的。

content.en: 1–3 items, each a value (≤ 9 chars) and a label (≤ 26 chars, ≤ 4 words); optional `count` per item; an optional query (≤ 48 chars).
content.zh: 1–3 项，每项一个值（≤ 6 字）和一个标签（≤ 10 字）；每项可选 `count`；可选查询行（≤ 48 个字符）。

fits.zh: 解释答案或问题的那几个数：改了一行、重查了多少文件、快了几倍。

notFor.zh: 三个以上的数字（用表格或图表）；没有标签的数字；装饰。

through the slice into the lock-up

en: Every figure must come from the product or be computed from figures on screen (e.g. the ratio to a candidate).
zh: 每个数字要么来自产品，要么由屏幕上的数字算出（比如相对某个候选的倍数）。

summary.en: A wipe line brings real lines of a real file over the frames they made; an underline pairs a token with the frame below it, one a beat.

bricks.fits: Showing that a line of input made a piece of output.
bricks.notFor: Code written for the film; outputs not made by those lines.

intent.en: Register a line of input with the frame it produced.
intent.zh: 让一行输入和它产生的画格对齐。

content.en: 2–6 quoted lines with the file and first line number, 1–4 pairs { line, token, result }, a claim (≤ 5 words).
content.zh: 2–6 行引用代码（带文件与首行行号）、1–4 组 { 行, 词, 结果 }、一句主张（≤ 12 字）。

fits.zh: 表明一行输入做出了一段输出。

notFor.zh: 为片子现写的代码；不是由这些行做出的输出。

pairs.note: the band rises from its seam

fits: any film whose input maps line by line to an output

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

summary.en: On night a ruler of the film's beats grows out of the dot, the dot riding it as the playhead at the film's own progress, two words slammed above it.
summary.zh: 夜色底上，一把按全片拍数刻度的标尺从墨点长出，墨点作为播放头停在全片的真实进度上，上方砸下两个词。

bricks.fits: A mid-film marker: "half way", "two left", a time claim measured by the film itself.
bricks.notFor: a timeline of real dates; a film without a fixed length.

intent.en: The film measures itself: the dot is exactly where the film is, so "half way" is literally true.
intent.zh: 片子自己量自己：墨点正好在片子走到的位置，“过半”是字面上的真。

content.en: Two words (≤ 7 chars each), an optional label (≤ 26 chars); the film's length in beats and this scene's start.
content.zh: 两个词（每个 ≤ 3 字），可选标签（≤ 10 字）；全片拍数和本场起点。

fits.zh: 片中的标记：“过半”“还剩两个”，用片子本身量出来的时间说法。

notFor.zh: 真实日期的时间轴；长度不固定的片子。

en: Pass the real film length and start (`film`), or the playhead lies.
zh: 要传真实的全片长度和起点（`film`），否则播放头会撒谎。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

summary.en: A row of feature cards turns over one by one; each back answers its front with one big number, a before/after bar and a label.
summary.zh: 一排功能卡逐张翻面，每张背面用一个大数字、一组前后对照条和一行标签回答正面的功能。

bricks.fits: Features and what each one brought, three or four pairs read as a run of results (feature → outcome).
bricks.notFor: Backs unrelated to their fronts (the turn becomes a decorative card swap); more than four cards; outcomes that need more than one number and a line.

intent.en: "So what?" answered card by card: each feature turns over to show what it brought, so the row reads as a run of results.
intent.zh: 逐张回答“所以呢？”：每个功能翻过来亮出它带来的结果，一排读作成果连报。

content.en: 3–4 cards: front a name (≤ 14 chars, Chinese ≤ 6 characters) and a line (≤ 32 chars, Chinese ≤ 13); back one number (≤ 6 chars), a label (≤ 20 chars, Chinese ≤ 9) and optional before/after values; a headline.
content.zh: 3–4 张卡：正面名称（≤ 14 字符、中文 ≤ 6 字）加一行说明（≤ 32 字符、中文 ≤ 13 字）；背面一个数字（≤ 6 字符）、一行标签（≤ 20 字符、中文 ≤ 9 字）和可选的前后对照值；外加一个标题。

fits.zh: 几个功能和各自带来的结果，三四对读成一串成果（功能 → 结果）。

notFor.zh: 背面和正面无关（翻面成了花哨换卡）；多于四张；结果要不止一个数字加一行字。

en: Front and back must be a cause and its result; an unrelated back makes the flip a decorative swap.
A soft snap on each card's landing makes the run read as a rhythm.
zh: 正反两面必须是因果一对；翻出无关内容就只是花哨换图。
每张翻停配一声轻“啪”，连报的节奏才出来。

upstream.name: 卡片翻面揭示
upstream.summary: 功能卡 3D 翻面揭示——卡片沿 Y 轴翻 180°，正面 UI 翻到侧棱最薄处掠过一道随角度移动的受光，背面揭出大号结论数字，逐张错峰扫过整排
upstream.use: "功能→成果"的成对叙事：一排功能卡逐张翻出各自的指标/结论；元素级转场卡
upstream.energy: 中高

overlaps.note: device-flip turns one window edge-on to swap its page (a hidden cut); flip-row turns a row over to show each card's other side, overshooting to 194° and springing back
louvre turns many slats to change the whole page; flip-row turns whole cards, one meaning each

summary.en: Three pages tumble edge-on into a stair, are pulled into one point that flashes, and a single smoke ring grows around the slammed title.
summary.zh: 三张页卡从侧棱翻飞成阶梯，被吸进一点闪白，一圈烟环从中长出，片名砸进环心。

bricks.fits: The last poster of a launch film: the product's pages gathered and spent into its name (outro, climax).
bricks.notFor: Middle sections (it ends everything on screen); titles longer than one word; quiet, editorial films (the flash and the ring are loud).

intent.en: The film's peak of energy collapses into its name: the product's pages are gathered and spent in one flash, and the title slams through a ring of smoke.
intent.zh: 全片能量顶点收缩成产品名：几张页面被一把吸走、一闪而尽，片名穿过烟环砸出来。

content.en: Three page painters (optional, the sample's otherwise), a one-word title (≤ 10 chars, Chinese ≤ 4 characters), an optional eyebrow, tagline (≤ 40 chars, Chinese ≤ 10) and a wall phrase.
content.zh: 三张页面（可选，不给就用样例）、一个单词片名（≤ 10 字符、中文 ≤ 4 字），可选眉题、标语（≤ 40 字符、中文 ≤ 10 字）和背景字墙短语。

fits.zh: 发布片的最后一张海报：产品的几张页面聚拢、耗尽，变成它的名字（落版、高潮）。

notFor.zh: 中段（它把画面上的一切收掉）；长于一个词的片名；安静的编辑风片子（闪白和烟环很响）。

en: Use it once, at the film's energy peak; it ends everything on screen.
The smoke ring is the aftermath of the collapse, not a celebration: no confetti or particles on top.
zh: 只在全片能量顶点用一次；它会收掉画面上的一切。
烟环是坍缩的余波，不是庆祝：别再加礼花或粒子。

upstream.name: 卡片翻飞收束
upstream.summary: 三张 UI 页卡从侧棱薄边 3D 翻飞成阶梯站定（全程清晰、样条连续丝滑），站定后保持慢转不停，快速收束吸入中心，炸出单个湍流烟雾环扩散，巨字横贯收场
upstream.use: 能量高潮段（功能页群→品牌口号的爆点转场）；霓虹/极光暗场调性；"多页面能力"收束成一句话的段落
upstream.energy: 极高（全片能量顶点用）

overlaps.note: collapse-burst shrinks a word into a dot and bursts it into particles that become the next word; flock-finale pulls three cards into a point and grows one smoke ring around a slammed title
converge-mark gathers pieces into a mark; flock-finale's pull lasts ten frames and its point flashes and rings instead of forming a mark

summary.en: A low camera flies over a data landscape: a bright trunk line winds to a vanishing point, tributaries sweep in and merge, pins rise on them, pulses flow, the vanishing point lights and a two-line title lands in the sky.
summary.zh: 低空镜头在一片数据地景上前飞：一条亮主干蜿蜒奔向消失点，两侧支流切向汇入，支流上立起标签，脉冲流向汇点，汇点亮起，天空落下两行标题。

bricks.fits: The first shot of an opening about many things becoming one: many inputs into one output, many contributors into one release, many sources into one pipeline; a mood-setting world before the product is named.
bricks.notFor: Light, flat or paper styles (it needs a dark ground for the light to read); content that must be read in detail (the pins are glances); slots under 6 seconds.

intent.en: Set a world before naming anything: countless streams of work flowing into one trunk, seen from a low camera gliding over them, so the product is felt as what all that work becomes.
intent.zh: 在说出任何名字之前先立一个世界：无数工作流汇进一条主干，从低空缓缓飞越，观众先感到“这么多东西汇成了一个产品”。

content.en: 3–6 pins naming the streams (en ≤ 16 chars, zh ≤ 6, numbered), an optional eyebrow (en ≤ 28, zh ≤ 10) and a two-line title (line 1 en ≤ 16 / zh ≤ 7, line 2 en ≤ 24 / zh ≤ 9).
content.zh: 3–6 个标签，给各条支流命名（英文 ≤ 16 字符，中文 ≤ 6 字，自动编号），可选眉标（英文 ≤ 28，中文 ≤ 10），两行标题（第一行英文 ≤ 16 / 中文 ≤ 7，第二行英文 ≤ 24 / 中文 ≤ 9）。

fits.zh: 讲“很多东西汇成一个”的开场第一镜：很多输入汇成一个输出、很多贡献者汇成一次发布、很多来源汇成一条流水线；产品被点名之前先立氛围的世界。

notFor.zh: 浅色、平面或纸感风格（光要暗底才读得出）；要细读的内容（标签只是一瞥）；短于 6 秒的槽位。

pairs.note: the lit vanishing point hands over to the brand lockup

en: Do not put it next to another dark glowing-line passage; back to back they read as the film's only trick, so keep two light shots between them.
Grade the line brightness by depth; all lines at full white mat into a cobweb, and no glow at all reads as a wireframe.
Cutting from it into a light product passage needs a hidden-cut transition, not a straight cut from dark to light.
Keep the pin labels at least 18 px equivalent, or they become decorative noise.
zh: 别和别的暗场发光线段落相邻；背靠背读作全片只会一招，中间至少隔两个亮场镜头。
线条亮度按纵深分层；全部纯白会糊成蛛网，完全没辉光又读作线框图。
接亮场产品段要用藏切类转场垫，别从暗到亮生切。
标签字号等效不小于 18 px，否则沦为装饰噪点。

upstream.name: 数据景观开场
upstream.summary: 暗场支流线束地景开场——多条流线汇入主干、虚构 ID 标签浮在线上、相机重景深低速飞越
upstream.use: 品牌级抽象开场（"数据宇宙"隐喻），接亮场产品段或字标；与 glow-flyline-moves 分工：那卡是段落内卡片之间的连线叙事，本卡是开场专用的全画幅地景
upstream.energy: 低开缓升（起步位，为后续爬升留空间）

summary.en: A neon frame runs round an empty place and closes; the page inside wakes from dark while its parts drop out of the air onto it, in turn or all at once.
summary.zh: 霓虹框从左缘两头奔画、圈出位置；框内页面由暗转亮，页面的部件从空中带影贴落，可以错峰也可以齐落（镜头绕页面弧线转）。

bricks.fits: A ceremony of arrival for one UI panel in a dark, neon passage: a feature area shown for the first time, or the opening of a night-toned section.
bricks.notFor: Light or calm films (the neon and the tunnel are loud); a panel the viewer must read in detail (it is shown slanted); more than one per film.

intent.en: Give one panel a ceremony of arrival: the frame claims the place first, then the page wakes inside it and its parts are set down from the air, so the viewer sees the interface being placed, not appearing.
intent.zh: 给一块面板一场登场仪式：框先到、占住位置，页面在框里亮起，部件从空中带影贴落，观众看到的是界面被“安放”进去，而不是凭空出现。

content.en: One UI page as 4–16 crops with their page positions (or a neutral workbench), an optional 1440 × 840 base image, and the product name (en ≤ 12 chars, zh ≤ 6).
content.zh: 一页界面，切成 4–16 块带页面坐标的部件图（或用中性工作台），可选一张 1440 × 840 底图，加产品名（英文 ≤ 12 字符，中文 ≤ 6 字）。

fits.zh: 暗场霓虹段落里给一块 UI 面板的登场仪式：某个功能区第一次亮相，或夜色调段落的开场。

notFor.zh: 明亮或安静的片子（霓虹和隧道很吵）；要观众细读的面板（它是斜着展示的）；一支片里用两次以上。

pairs.note: after the page has landed, a low pass across its regions

en: Pick the landing rhythm by meaning: staggered parts (forerun) for a page being assembled, all parts on one frame (together) for one whole arrival; mixing them gets both rejected.
The floating shadow must be clearly visible; parts that drop without a felt shadow look like a plain fade.
Use one of the two modes per passage and at most once per film; the same frame language twice reads as repetition.
zh: 按意思选落法：错峰贴落（forerun）是页面被拼起来，同帧齐落（together）是整体一次登场；用混了两边都会被否。
悬空贴落的影子必须看得出；没有可感的影子就等于普通淡入。
同一段落两式只用一个，一支片最多一次；同一套框语言重复会读作重样。

upstream.name: 霓虹框先行
upstream.summary: 强透视直角霓虹框自左缘两头奔画先行成型，页面在框内由暗转亮，同时框内组件/文字从 3D 上空带同形软影错峰贴落、随页面点亮同步完成贴合，背景霓虹群（demo 为同形框纵深回声隧道）终段熄灭让位
upstream.use: 暗场品牌片里给 UI 面板做"登场仪式"（框先到、内容后落）；功能区首次亮相；霓虹/赛博调性的段落开场
upstream.energy: 中高（三层动作叠进，但都服务同一次登场）

upstream.name: 霓虹框环绕齐落
upstream.summary: 霓虹框先行描框后，镜头绕页面左→右弧线旋转，页面全部组件/文字**同帧**从空中往下贴合（同形软影同步收敛）——整体登场式的框内安放
upstream.use: 单页 UI 的一次性隆重登场（与巡礼/逐区亮相相对）；暗场霓虹调性段落的主视觉揭幕；neon-frame-forerun 的姊妹镜
upstream.energy: 中高（一次性的大动作，落定即静）

overlaps.note: split heads round one flat element; frame-forerun is the frame for a whole panel in 3D with a page dropping into it
a brand frame snaps into place on the beat; frame-forerun is the frame as a prelude to the page landing

summary.en: The frame in the gate punches to the full frame, holds a beat, and shrinks into its cell on the contact sheet laid underneath.
summary.zh: 片门里的画格冲到满屏，停一拍，再缩进下面印样上它的那一格。

bricks.fits: The turn from a reel to the whole set at once.
bricks.notFor: A frame below 1920 × 1080 source px (it would soften at full size).

intent.en: One frame is the object the eye follows from the reel to the sheet.
intent.zh: 一个画格是眼睛从胶片跟到印样的那个对象。

content.en: The frame (full resolution), its cell on the sheet, the sheet’s rows.
content.zh: 画格（全分辨率）、它在印样上的格、印样各行。

fits.zh: 从一卷胶片转到整组作品的转折。

notFor.zh: 源像素小于 1920 × 1080 的画格（满屏会糊）。

fits: any film about films, frames or renders

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

summary.en: A board of twelve pictures rearranges twice, following a layout switch: grid, feature mosaic with the first picture captioned, then a cascade of prints under the headline.
summary.zh: 十二张图的看板跟着布局开关重排两次：网格、首图带说明的拼贴，再到错落的照片阶梯，标题落在空出的位置。

bricks.fits: A product that shows many pictures (renders, shots, designs) and offers more than one way to see them (demo, proof, rest).
bricks.notFor: Fewer than eight pictures (the grid looks empty); a story about one picture; layouts the product does not have (the switch claims a feature).

intent.en: The viewer sees one set of pictures read three ways, archive, curated and fanned, and believes the product's layouts are a real feature.
intent.zh: 让观众看到同一批图有三种看法（档案、精选、摊开），相信“多种布局”是产品真有的能力。

content.en: 8–12 pictures or screenshots (subjects near the centre), three layout names (≤ 8 chars, Chinese ≤ 3 characters), a header, a featured caption and a headline (≤ 28 chars, Chinese ≤ 12).
content.zh: 8–12 张图或截图（主体靠中间），三个布局名（≤ 8 字符、中文 ≤ 3 字），页眉、精选图注和一个标题（≤ 28 字符、中文 ≤ 12 字）。

fits.zh: 展示大量图片（渲染、镜头、设计）并提供不止一种看法的产品。

notFor.zh: 不到八张图（网格显空）；只讲一张图的故事；产品没有的布局（开关等于宣称有这个功能）。

en: The layouts on the switch must exist in the product; the switch claims them.
Portrait prints crop landscape pictures to a strip: keep subjects near the centre.
zh: 开关上的布局必须产品真有；开关就是在宣称它。
竖幅相纸会把横图裁成中间一条：主体放中间。

upstream.name: 三段布局重排
upstream.summary: 12 张瓦片在规则网格、feature mosaic、对角瀑布串三种排版间连续变形，位置宽高各自插值、逐片微错峰，段间留 hold
upstream.use: "同一批内容多种看法"的陈列转场：作品集/模板库/相册产品的布局能力展示
upstream.energy: 中（连续流动的重排，无爆点，气质从容）

overlaps.note: layout-morph is one change of layout; gallery-reframe chains two of them behind a visible switch, adds the caption, the header and the headline

summary.en: The climax: the gap between two points of a print is measured on its own axis, the label computed, the rest of the print stepped back, the claim held in a pause.
summary.zh: 高潮：在截图自己的坐标轴上量出两点之间的差距，标签由计算得到，其余部分退后，主张在停顿中定格。

bricks.fits: A cost ratio, a score gap, a latency difference read off one chart.
bricks.notFor: Gaps between prints; values with no shared axis.

intent.en: The difference is drawn on the evidence and computed, so the claim cannot be argued with.
intent.zh: 差距画在证据上、由计算得出，主张因此无可辩驳。

content.en: Two points and values on the print; a label pattern; the claim (≤ 6 words / 16 字).
content.zh: 截图上的两个点和值；标签模板；主张（≤ 6 词 / 16 字）。

fits.zh: 从一张图上读出的成本倍数、分数差、延迟差。

notFor.zh: 跨截图的差距；没有共同坐标轴的值。

pairs.note: rise over the desk after the claim

en: Mark values read off an axis with `~`.

fits: any launch argued from published evidence

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

summary.en: One real frame of each film through the gate, a claw pull-down a beat, its name under the gate while it is registered.
summary.zh: 每支片一格真实画面依次穿过片门，每拍拉一格，停在片门时下面写片名。

bricks.fits: Showing a set of films, styles or renders one after another.
bricks.notFor: One film; frames that need reading time.

intent.en: A beat per film: the set is felt as a rhythm, each named.
intent.zh: 每支片一拍：整组作品以节奏被感知，各有名字。

content.en: 1–12 frames (16:9) each with a name (≤ 2 words / 6 字).

fits.zh: 依次展示一组影片、风格或渲染。

notFor.zh: 只有一支片；需要阅读时间的画格。

fits: any film about films, frames or renders

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: The claim as a general arrangement: a two-line headline, then input → system → output as three boxes on one axis with arrows, the system name large in the middle, an overall dimension under them.
summary.zh: 把主张画成总体布置图：两行标题，然后是同一轴线上的“输入 → 系统 → 输出”三个方框和箭头，系统名在中间放大，下方一条总尺寸线。

bricks.fits: The claim of a system film: what goes in, what the product is, what comes out.
bricks.notFor: Claims with branches or more than one product; names longer than 14 characters.

intent.en: Show the product as one designed part between an input and an output, dimensioned like a real assembly.
intent.zh: 把产品画成输入与输出之间的一个被设计的部件，像真正的装配图一样标尺寸。

content.en: Label, two lines (≤ 18 chars), a sub (≤ 6 words), input, system and output each a tag and a name.
content.zh: 标签、两行（每行 ≤ 8 字）、一句副标题、输入/系统/输出各一个标签和名称。

fits.zh: 系统类片子的主张：进去什么、产品是什么、出来什么。

notFor.zh: 有分支或多个产品的主张；超过 6 字的名称。

en: Three names must leave 110 px between boxes; long names fail before they shrink.
zh: 三个名称之间要留出 110 px；名称太长会直接放不下。

summary.en: The palette link: the word's first four glyphs morph into four swatches (text, ground, field, line) that hop on 1/16 notes, the hex labels type under them, a type specimen rises; the stage name in the centre.
summary.zh: 配色环节：大字的前四个字形变成四块色板（字色、底色、场色、线色），按十六分音符依次一跳，色值在下面敲出，字体样张升起；中央是阶段名。

bricks.fits: A reel's colour step: the real hex values of the preset.
bricks.notFor: Palettes of more than four roles; a film without the word before it.

intent.en: Show that every colour of the film comes from one preset, by turning the word into it.
intent.zh: 把大字直接变成色板，说明整片每个颜色都出自同一个预设。

content.en: No copy of its own: the palette's hex values, the specimen, the stage name and note.
content.zh: 本身没有文案：色值、字体样张、阶段名和注释。

fits.zh: 作品集里的配色一步：预设的真实色值。

summary.en: The camera flies low over a product page in three legs, almost edge-on; the page's words hover with soft shadows and land as the camera passes them.
summary.zh: 相机分三段贴着产品页面低飞，几乎与页面平行；页面上的字带着软阴影悬浮，镜头经过时依次落下。

bricks.fits: A hook or a demo that shows the product's interface as a place, without reading it (demo, hook).
bricks.notFor: Interfaces that must be read (the page is seen at a grazing angle); a single feature; light films that should stay flat.

intent.en: The interface as a landscape: the camera skims its surface and the page completes itself as it passes, so the viewer feels inside the product's world.
intent.zh: 把界面拍成地形：镜头贴着表面掠过，页面在镜头经过时自己完成，观众像身在产品的内里世界。

content.en: Product name, a section name, 6–10 tree items and 3–5 tabs (≤ 14 chars, Chinese ≤ 5 characters), a title and subtitle, 4–6 list rows; none of it is read closely.
content.zh: 产品名、分区名、6–10 个侧栏条目和 3–5 个标签（≤ 14 字符、中文 ≤ 5 字），一个标题和副标题，4–6 行列表；都不需要细读。

fits.zh: 把产品界面当一个地方来展示、不要求读清的开场或演示。

notFor.zh: 必须读清的界面（掠射角下看不清）；单个功能；要保持平面的明亮片子。

en: Lift the hovering words (~1.3× brightness) so they are not swallowed by the dark; without visible hover the landing is lost.
Not in the same section as perspective-glide: there the page moves, here the camera does.
zh: 悬空的字要提亮约 1.3 倍，别被暗部吞掉；看不出悬浮，落定就白做了。
别和 perspective-glide 同段：那个页面动，这个镜头动。

upstream.use: 功能区巡礼（把 UI 当地景飞掠）；配合暗场+霓虹缘光做产品"内里世界"段落；界面内容逐区登场

summary.en: One piece from each part of the film flies in from its side and lands around the centre for a group photo; the camera cranes down, the mark and wordmark press in letter by letter while the cast steps back, a rule and the tagline follow, and the frame fades.
summary.zh: 全片每段各出一块素材从各自方向飞入、在中心周围落位合影；镜头吊降，标志和字标逐字压入、配角退后，横线和标语跟上，最后淡出。

bricks.fits: The ending of a film that showed several screens: a curtain call of the screens it showed, then the lock-up.
bricks.notFor: Films with fewer than five distinct screens to bring back; endings that should be quiet (it is a launch).

intent.en: A curtain call: everything the film showed comes back together around the name, so the ending feels like a launch.
intent.zh: 谢幕合影：片子里出现过的画面一起回到名字周围，让收尾像一场发布。

content.en: 5–9 screenshots from the film (cropped to cover; placeholders by shape without them), optional page behind, a mark, a wordmark ≤ 16 chars, an optional tagline ≤ 34 chars.
content.zh: 5–9 张片中截图（裁切铺满；没有就按形状画占位），可选背景页，一个标志，≤ 6 字的字标，可选 ≤ 12 字的标语。

fits.zh: 展示过多个画面的片子的结尾：先请出场过的画面谢幕，再落版。

notFor.zh: 可请回的不同画面少于五个的片子；应该安静收尾的片子（它是发布感）。

pairs.note: a wall of the same screens earlier makes the curtain call a callback

en: Bring back screens the viewer saw; new screenshots here are noise.
The pieces stay on screen around the name: busy screenshots compete with the wordmark, keep them calm or let them recede.
zh: 请回观众看过的画面；这里放新截图只是噪声。
素材一直围着名字：太花的截图会和字标抢，挑素净的或让它们退后。

upstream.summary: 全片元素从四面八方飞来围住字标合影，crane 落机位+舞台光+金尘做成发布会收场

upstream.energy: 峰值（全片最高点）

summary.en: The lights are down on a product page; a lamp searches it and locks on one card, the camera pushes in low from the side, the card lifts, a light runs twice round it, a note floats beside it, and both settle back.
summary.zh: 关灯的页面上，一束聚光游走后锁定一张卡；镜头推进到斜侧特写，卡片弹起悬浮，一道光沿轮廓跑两圈，旁边浮起两行注记，最后卡和注记一起贴回页面。

bricks.fits: The first shot of a "one hero" product opening: one core object (a card, an item, a module) made the protagonist of the film, in its page.
bricks.notFor: Pages without a grid of comparable items (the lamp needs something to choose from); more than one hero; fast cutting (it is the slowest, most textured shot, 5.75 s); dark pages (the pool reads by showing a light page in a dark room).

intent.en: Make one object the protagonist of the film: of everything on the page, this card; the lamp chooses it, the lift gives it weight, the running light inspects it, and the reseat says it belongs to the page.
intent.zh: 把一个对象立成全片主角：页面上那么多，偏偏是这一张；聚光替观众选中它，弹起给它分量，轮廓光检视它，贴回原位说明它属于这个页面。

content.en: A light page with a grid of comparable cards (tile-card faces or the film's page image) and one hero card (or image); an optional two-line note (each en ≤ 16 chars, zh ≤ 7).
content.zh: 一张有一格格可比较卡片的浅色页面（卡面或影片自己的页面图）和一张主角卡（或图）；可选两行注记（每行英文 ≤ 16 字符，中文 ≤ 7 字）。

fits.zh: “单一主角”式产品开场的第一镜：把一个核心对象（一张卡、一个条目、一个模块）在它的页面里立成全片主角。

notFor.zh: 没有一格格可比较条目的页面（聚光需要有得挑）；不止一个主角；快切（这是最慢、质感最重的一镜，约 5.75 秒）；暗色页面（光池靠暗室里一张亮页面读出来）。

pairs.note: when the hero is drawn from a set first
after the hero, walk through what it carries

en: Open on one hero with the whole arc; a group of cards dancing does not carry a first impression.
Light effects go to the hero only; a glint on every card was rejected twice.
Text on the card blurs in the push-in unless the face is rasterised at high resolution.
End the note's dark backing short of the card's left edge, or it presses a dark wedge onto the card.
zh: 开场直接上单主角加完整动作弧；多卡群舞撑不起第一印象。
光效只给主角；每张卡都闪一下被否过两次。
推进特写时卡上文字会糊，卡面要高分辨率栅格化。
注记的暗色衬底右缘要停在卡左缘之前，否则在卡面左侧压出一道暗楔。

upstream.summary: 关灯的剧场里一束钨丝聚光（带体积光柱）扫过页面锁定一张卡，斜侧推进后卡片弹起悬浮、香槟色光束沿轮廓两圈、连同 3D 注记一起贴回原位
upstream.use: "单一主角"式产品开场；把一个核心对象（卡片/条目/模块）立成全片主角
upstream.energy: 中（质感最高的一镜，节奏慢而稳）

summary.en: The card outline morphs into a hexagon, three accent lines re-read it as a cube, the faces take three tones; a caption rises and three counted face labels hang off the cube.
summary.zh: 卡片轮廓变成六边形，三条强调色线把它重读成立方体，三个面上三种墨色；左侧说明升起，三个带计数的面标签挂在立方体上。

bricks.fits: The turn of a promotion: one flat thing revealed as a solid source (a spec, a schema, a model).
bricks.notFor: Films without a flat object before it; more than three counts.

intent.en: A flat thing is revealed as a solid source, so the viewer understands that everything else is generated from it.
intent.zh: 平面的东西被揭示为一个立体的源头，观众明白其余一切都是从它生成的。

content.en: A caption (≤ 15 chars / 7 字) and up to three counted face labels (≤ 15 / 8 字, may use {endpoints} {schemas} {sdks}).
content.zh: 一行说明（≤ 15 字符 / 7 字）和最多三个带计数的面标签（≤ 15 / 8 字，可用 {endpoints} {schemas} {sdks}）。

fits.zh: 升级片的转折：一个平面的东西揭示为立体的源头（规格、模式、模型）。

notFor.zh: 之前没有平面对象的片；超过三个计数。

en: The caption is 86 px bold: Chinese holds seven characters at most.
zh: 说明是 86 px 粗体：中文最多七个字。

summary.en: The real candidates in cells; a highlight hops over them, each value rises under it, the answer scrambles and locks in amber, or the verdict says none passes.
summary.zh: 真实候选项排成格子；高亮逐格跳过，每个值在它下面升起，答案的数字乱码后锁定成琥珀色，或者结论说一个都没过。

bricks.fits: Running the question over real options with measured values: builds, configurations, parsers, policies.
bricks.notFor: Made-up candidates or values; more than five options; a choice without a measured limit.

intent.en: The viewer watches the answer being found: anticipation builds hop by hop and resolves on the lock, or the failure is stated plainly.
intent.zh: 观众看着答案被找出来：一格一格跳，期待越来越强，锁定时落地；或者干脆说明一个都没过。

content.en: A restated question (≤ 34 chars), 2–5 candidates each with a label (≤ 5 chars) and a measured value (≤ 8 chars), a numeric limit, an optional query (≤ 48 chars).
content.zh: 一句复述的问题（≤ 14 字）、2–5 个候选项（标签 ≤ 3 字、测得的值 ≤ 5 字）、一个数值上限、可选的查询行（≤ 48 个字符）。

fits.zh: 把问题放到带实测值的真实选项上跑一遍：构建版本、配置、解析器、策略。

notFor.zh: 编造的候选或数值；超过五个选项；没有测量上限的选择。

pairs.note: into the reveal: `into: 'reveal'`, the last beat is the exposure build
after a failed search, through the whip, into its evidence

en: The verdict and the answer are computed from the candidates and `limit`; never type them.
Candidates already shown in an earlier search go in `known` so they hop on eighths.
zh: 结论和答案都由候选和 `limit` 算出，不许手写。
前一次检索出现过的候选写进 `known`，按八分音符跳。

a vertical list through a still focus; here cells in a row and a moving highlight

summary.en: The claim under the horizon: a hot line draws out from the centre, a scanline sphere rises out of it as the camera pushes in, the claim decodes under it in two lines, a sub and one to three facts land.
summary.zh: 地平线下的主张：一条炽亮的线从中心向两边拉开，扫描线球体从线里升起、镜头推近，主张分两行在线下解码出现，随后一句副标和一到三条事实。

bricks.fits: The claim right after the opening's flash.
bricks.notFor: A claim of more than eight words; films that do not open with prompt-boot (the sphere is born at its point).

intent.en: Make the claim the horizon of the film: one line of light, the product rising from it, the promise written under it.
intent.zh: 把主张做成整部片子的地平线：一条光线，产品从中升起，承诺写在线下。

content.en: Two claim lines (≤ 4 words each), a sub (≤ 5 words, [marked] words in ink), 0–3 facts (a key and a value).
content.zh: 两行主张（每行 ≤ 9 字）、一句副标（≤ 16 字，[方括号] 内为墨色）、0–3 条事实（键和值）。

fits.zh: 紧接开场闪白之后的主张。

notFor.zh: 超过八个词的主张；不是以 prompt-boot 开场的片子（球体从它的光点诞生）。

en: The sphere is a light layer: on a light ground it disappears; keep the dark presets.
zh: 球体是光层：在浅色底上会消失；只用暗色预设。

summary.en: Inputs → hub → outputs: nodes slide in around the owner's hub, connectors draw, dots travel in and out, each output lights on the beat and its checks tick along the bottom.
summary.zh: 输入 → 中枢 → 输出：节点围绕负责人的中枢滑入，连线画出，光点流入流出，每个输出在拍点亮起，底部对应的检查依次打勾。

bricks.fits: A chapter that shows what the tool does with its inputs, and the checks each output passes.
bricks.notFor: More than three inputs or outputs; flows with branches or loops (use you-ends for a loop).

intent.en: Show the tool as the owner in the middle: everything passes through it, and each result is checked.
intent.zh: 把工具画成中间的负责人：一切经过它，每个结果都被检查。

content.en: The header, a command, 1–3 inputs and 1–3 outputs (a name and a sub), the hub (label, name, sub), 0–5 checks each tied to an output.
content.zh: 页眉、一条命令、1–3 个输入和 1–3 个输出（名称和说明）、中枢（标签、名称、说明）、0–5 个检查（各对应一个输出）。

fits.zh: 展示工具如何处理输入、每个输出通过哪些检查的章节。

notFor.zh: 超过三个输入或输出；有分支或循环的流程（循环用 you-ends）。

en: Each output lights on a beat; with three outputs and five checks the page runs about five bars.
zh: 每个输出在拍点亮起；三个输出加五个检查时整页约五小节。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: Several sources joined to one hub by paths with light running along them: they keep feeding it (connect) or slide in and are swallowed (merge).
summary.zh: 几个来源由带光点的路径连到同一个中枢：要么持续输送（接入），要么顺着路径滑进去被吞并（汇流）。

bricks.fits: Integrations, one entry for many inputs, consolidation of tools: merge when the sources disappear into the product, connect when they stay and feed it.
bricks.notFor: A pipeline with order (use a row of steps); more than six sources (the layout and the paths crowd); the product page as the subject (it is a picture in the hub here).

intent.en: Turn 'many sources, one place' into a physical process: paths connect, and the sources are either swallowed so only the product remains (merge) or stay and keep feeding it (connect).
intent.zh: 把“多个来源、一个去处”变成看得见的物理过程：通路接上，来源要么被吸进去、最后只剩产品（汇流），要么留在原处持续输送（接入）。

content.en: 4–5 sources as logos, images or neutral glyphs; one mark for the hub (on an opaque disc); in connect a page painter as the hub; in merge one caption (en ≤ 28 chars, zh ≤ 12).
content.zh: 4–5 个来源（标志、图片或中性图标）；中枢一个标志（托在不透明圆片上）；接入式中枢是一页画面；汇流式一句说明（英文 ≤ 28 字符，中文 ≤ 12 字）。

fits.zh: 集成、多个输入一个入口、工具合并：来源消失进产品里用汇流，来源留着并持续输送用接入。

notFor.zh: 有先后顺序的流水线（用一排步骤）；超过六个来源（布局和路径会挤）；以产品页本身为主体（这里它只是中枢里的一张图）。

pairs.note: the turn-over flip that opens connect: an old page becomes the hub

en: In connect, pop all sources on one frame, then draw all tubes on the next beat; connecting one by one reads as separate negotiations.
Keep the accent for the packets and ripples; colouring the sources takes the subject away from the hub.
Put an open-shaped hub mark on an opaque disc, or the line ends show through its gap.
If a caption follows narration, time it to the spoken word, not to the end of the merge.
zh: 接入式要所有来源同帧弹现、下一拍所有光管同帧齐连；逐个连读作一个个谈判。
强调色只给光点和涟漪；给来源上色会把主体从中枢抢走。
开口形的中枢标志要托在不透明圆片上，否则线头从缺口露出来。
配旁白时，说明出现的时刻对齐旁白落词，而不是吞并结束。

upstream.name: 曲线汇流吞并
upstream.summary: 左侧四个来源节点各有一条细贝塞尔曲线连向右侧同一汇聚点，曲线先错峰由左向右 draw-on，节点沿自己的曲线滑向汇聚点并三段式加速缩小到消失，强调色数据包全程沿路径滑行，吞并完成后曲线从左端反向擦除只留品牌标志（demo：白瓷圆片托 video-shotcraft 镜刻标志）
upstream.use: "多源整合/统一接入/数据汇聚"的核心机制镜头；集成、聚合、单一入口类产品的说明段落
upstream.energy: 中（长镜慢速推进，靠数据包滑行维持活性；吞并瞬间是唯一小高点）

upstream.name: 集成星图
upstream.summary: 旧页面一次性快翻 180°（侧棱瞬间亮闪）落成新中枢页，五个集成 app 图标同帧弹现、随即五条彩虹光管同帧齐连，光管内输送脉冲持续流动——"翻开新一页，生态一齐接入"
upstream.use: 集成/生态能力段（一个产品连一切）；版本翻新叙事（旧页翻成新页）；暗场霓虹调性的功能高潮

summary.en: A field of unlit keycaps rises from the centre out until it fills the frame; after a breath, bands of light sweep down it and light every key, then a title lands on a veil.
summary.zh: 上百枚熄灯的图标键帽从中心向外错峰浮现铺满全屏，停一拍后几道光带极快向下扫过、逐行点亮，最后在暗幕上落下标题。

bricks.fits: Showing scale before the name: a feature or integration universe laid out in grey, then lit at once by the product; an opening or a lockup.
bricks.notFor: Fewer than about a hundred things (the field needs to read as "many"); icons that must be read one by one; light, flat styles.

intent.en: Lay out the whole universe of features in grey so the viewer registers 'this many', then light it all in one fast sweep, so the product reads as what brings it all to life.
intent.zh: 先用灰阶把整个功能宇宙摆满，让观众意识到“有这么多”，再用几道快速光带一举点亮，产品就是让这一切亮起来的那一个。

content.en: 6–16 simple solid icons (SVG paths on a 24 grid; hearts, stars, bolts, ticks: recognisable shapes, not abstract blocks), repeated over about 170 keys; an eyebrow (en ≤ 20 chars, zh ≤ 8) and a two-line title (en ≤ 16 / 24, zh ≤ 6 / 9).
content.zh: 6–16 个简笔实心图标（24 网格的 SVG 路径；心、星、闪电、对勾这类认得出的形，不要抽象色块），铺满约 170 个键位；一行眉标（英文 ≤ 20 字符，中文 ≤ 8 字）和两行标题（英文 ≤ 16 / 24，中文 ≤ 6 / 9）。

fits.zh: 点名之前先交代规模：一片功能或集成的宇宙先以灰阶铺开，再被产品一下点亮；用于开场或落版。

notFor.zh: 少于约一百样东西（这片阵列要读作“很多”）；要一个个读的图标；浅色平面风格。

pairs.note: the lit field hands over to the brand lockup

en: Never light the whole field on one frame; the light must sweep down in bands, or it reads as a different picture swapped in.
Wipe the light in with a clip, not a cross-fade; half-transparent warm colour over a dark ground passes through a muddy olive.
Use recognisable solid icons; abstract blocks do not read as a universe of features.
zh: 点亮不能同帧硬翻；要几道光带向下扫，否则读作换了一张图。
点亮用裁切擦入，不用透明度交叉淡入；暖色半透明叠在暗底上会过一段橄榄泥色。
图标要用认得出的实心简笔形；抽象色块读不出“功能宇宙”。

content.en: 1–10 rows (name, duration, row strip); 1–2 captions (≤ 6 words / 16 字).

fits.zh: 关于时长、版本或实测渲染的主张。

notFor.zh: 时长全都一样的一组（没有可拉长的）。

fits: any film about films, frames or renders

summary.en: The rows of a list arrive one by one into their places on a page as the camera follows: risen from below with a press and a counter, or dropped from above into slots.
summary.zh: 列表的行一条条落进页面上的位置，镜头跟着走：从下方升上来、每落一张整摞一压、计数器跳一格；或者从上方落下、扣进虚线槽位。

bricks.fits: Showing that a list is being filled for real (results found, rows imported, items collected): a count that grows with weight, or structured rows that slot into a page.
bricks.notFor: Reading the rows (each is legible only as it lands); more than five rows; a list whose order or ranking is the point; holding on the page as the main shot of a film.

intent.en: Show a list being filled for real: each row arrives into its own place and the page answers with weight or a click, so 'we collected these' reads as earned, not as a list that was always there.
intent.zh: 表现一个列表被实打实地填起来：每一行落进自己的位置，页面用一压或“咔哒”一扣回应，观众读出“这是攒下来的”，而不是本来就在的列表。

content.en: 3–5 rows, each a title (en ≤ 18 chars, zh ≤ 8), a meta line (en ≤ 16, zh ≤ 7), optional note (en ≤ 26, zh ≤ 11), value, delta or thumbnail; a title (en ≤ 24, zh ≤ 10), eyebrow, counter label and caption.
content.zh: 3–5 行，每行一个标题（英文 ≤ 18 字符，中文 ≤ 8 字）、一行元信息（英文 ≤ 16，中文 ≤ 7），可选备注（英文 ≤ 26，中文 ≤ 11）、数值、涨跌或缩略图；一行标题（英文 ≤ 24，中文 ≤ 10）、眉标、计数器标签和说明。

fits.zh: 表现一个列表被真实地填起来（找到的结果、导入的行、收集的条目）：带分量地增长的计数，或结构化的行扣进页面槽位。

notFor.zh: 要读行内容（每行只在落下时看得清）；超过五行；顺序或排名本身是重点的列表；当作全片主画面久停在页面上。

pairs.note: the count that grew lands as a result

en: Keep the list straight-on; a tilted stylised camera makes rows unreadable.
The anticipation press must be visible without stepping frame by frame; too small and it is not felt.
Rows must land into real slots of the page; rows that hover above it look fake.
Keep the light seam inside the row's rounded corners; light spilling past them looks cheap.
zh: 列表必须正视；风格化的倾斜机位会让行读不清。
下压蓄力的幅度要不逐帧也看得出；太小等于没有。
行要落进页面真实的槽位；悬在上方不落地显得假。
强调色缝要裁在行的圆角以内；光溢出圆角很廉价。

summary.en: The card splits into the parts of the product mark, which fly in on arcs; the point lands as the mark dot, the name wipes out, the tagline rises and the closing command types on.
summary.zh: 卡片裂成产品标志的几块，沿弧线飞进去；那个点落成标志上的圆点，名字擦出，标语升起，结尾的命令逐字打出。

bricks.fits: The close of a film whose product has a geometric mark and a command to run.
bricks.notFor: Marks that are pictures or words only; closings without a command (use a plain lock-up).

intent.en: The object the viewer followed all film becomes the product's mark, and the command to get it is typed, so they leave with a name and an action.
intent.zh: 观众跟了一整片的对象变成产品标志，取用它的命令被打出来，观众带走一个名字和一个动作。

content.en: The product's name (≤ 12 chars), the mark as parts in grid units plus a dot, a tagline (≤ 26 chars / 12 字), a command (≤ 36 chars).
content.zh: 产品名（≤ 12 字符），以网格单位描述的标志块与圆点，一句标语（≤ 26 字符 / 12 字），一条命令（≤ 36 字符）。

fits.zh: 产品有几何标志和可运行命令的片子的收尾。

notFor.zh: 图形或纯文字标志；没有命令的收尾（用普通落版）。

pairs.note: hands it the Run button as the baton

en: Hold the typed command ≥ 3 s; a closing command that vanishes cannot be copied.
zh: 打完的命令至少停 3 秒；一闪而过的结尾命令没法抄。

summary.en: The closing lock-up: something on screen becomes the mark (a ring collapses onto it, an app icon flips into it, or an input field and three pieces assemble it), the mark steps aside, the wordmark lands beside it, a tagline follows and it holds to be read.
summary.zh: 收尾标志落版：画面里的东西变成标志（光环收缩落定、应用图标翻转绽开、或输入框和三块部件拼装成标），标志让位，字标落在旁边，标语跟上，停够读完。

bricks.fits: The last screen of a film when the product has a mark: the mark, the name and one line, with the way in chosen by what came before (a busy film: ring; a product with an app icon: flip; a prompt or chat product: assemble).
bricks.notFor: Films without a mark and a name to show (use name-stamp); ends that must keep the product UI on screen (strip-away); more than one tagline.

intent.en: The film resolves into the product's signature: something the viewer has just seen becomes the mark, and the name is left to remember.
intent.zh: 全片收束成产品签名：刚看到的东西变成标志，留下要记住的名字。

content.en: A mark (image or vector; a placeholder without one), a wordmark ≤ 16 chars, an optional tagline ≤ 34 chars; for flip an app icon, for assemble a prompt ≤ 36 chars and the mark's pieces.
content.zh: 标志（图片或矢量，没有就用占位）、≤ 6 字的字标、可选标语 ≤ 12 字；flip 要应用图标，assemble 要 ≤ 15 字的输入句和标志的部件。

fits.zh: 有标志的产品片尾：标志、名字和一句话；入场按前文选（热闹的片子用 ring，有应用图标用 flip，对话或输入类产品用 assemble）。

notFor.zh: 没有标志的片子（用 name-stamp）；片尾要留住产品界面的（用 strip-away）；不止一句标语。

pairs.note: a line condensed into the name just before the lock-up
shares drawMark, so a film can end its demo with strip-away and its other cut with mark-lockup

en: Hold the finished lock-up at least one second past its reading time; a cut on the last letter loses the name.
flip swaps on the thinnest frame: an icon that does not resemble the mark makes the swap read as a cut.
assemble needs the mark as separable pieces; a single-shape logo only floods the field.
zh: 落版成形后读完再多停至少 1 秒，最后一个字母刚落就切会丢名字。
flip 在最薄那帧换图：图标和标志不像，换图就像硬切。
assemble 要标志能拆成部件；整块的标志只能做到输入框灌满。

upstream.summary: 霓虹切口大环快速收束成中央实心小白 O、过冲刹车时换成 video-shotcraft 标志，图标左移让位，字标字母逐个滑入完成 lockup，强调色标语收尾
upstream.use: 片尾品牌定妆：从满屏图形能量收束到"图标+字标+标语"的标准 lockup

upstream.energy: 中高（收尾点睛，一次完整变形讲完）

summary.en: The camera pushes in on the anchor while the mark inks up out of it, then pulls back on a log scale into the whole mark; name and line rise beside it; the plate takes one dot-gain impression.
summary.zh: 镜头推近锚点，标志的黑版从锚点向外上墨，随后按对数尺度拉远露出整个标志；名字和标语在旁边升起；黑版最后压一次网点扩大。

bricks.fits: The lock-up of a film whose recurring anchor is a piece of the product mark.
bricks.notFor: Marks without a separable piece; word-only marks.

intent.en: The reveal that the anchor was part of the mark all along: the camera pulls back and the rings of the film were its arcs.
intent.zh: 揭示锚点从头就是标志的一部分：镜头拉远，片里的圆环原来是它的弧线。

content.en: The product name (≤ 12 chars, Latin), a line (≤ 28 / 14 字), the mark as SVG paths with the anchor's box.
content.zh: 产品名（≤ 12 字符，拉丁字母），一行字（≤ 28 字符 / 14 字），以 SVG 路径给出的标志与锚点框。

fits.zh: 贯穿锚点是产品标志一部分的片子的落版。

notFor.zh: 拆不出一块的标志；纯文字标志。

en: Leave 1–2 s without the bed for the push-in; the silence makes the pull-back land.
zh: 推近时留 1–2 秒没有音乐床；静默让拉远落得住。

summary.en: The most frequent pair is picked, lit on the board, fused on every row, written as a rule and taken off the token bar; or a loop of such merges at one every two beats or one a beat.
summary.zh: 挑出最常见的一对，在棋盘上点亮，每一行同时合并，写成一条规则，词元条随之缩短；或者把这样的合并连成一串，两拍一个或一拍一个。

bricks.fits: Teaching a rule once, slowly, then letting it repeat faster into the result.
bricks.notFor: Steps whose state is not a merge, sort or reduction.

intent.en: A rule is taught once, slowly, then repeats faster, so the viewer learns the step and then believes it converges.
intent.zh: 规则先慢讲一遍，再加速重复，观众先学会这一步，再相信它会收敛。

content.en: The run, which steps to show (`from`, `to`), the pace (`slow` | `loop`), a caption (≤ 64 / 24 字 with markup).
content.zh: 运行输入，显示哪几步（`from`、`to`），节奏（`slow` 或 `loop`），说明（含标记 ≤ 64 字符 / 24 字）。

fits.zh: 把一条规则慢讲一遍，再让它加速重复到结果。

notFor.zh: 状态不是合并、排序或归约的步骤。

en: Run the slow step once; a second slow step bores, a loop without a slow step teaches nothing.
zh: 慢步只跑一次；两次就拖沓，没有慢步直接循环就什么都没教。

summary.en: A release history as a journey: the camera sprints along a time axis past milestone cards that spring up as it reaches them, brakes hard on the last one and pushes in.
summary.zh: 把版本史拍成一次时间轴旅行：镜头沿刻度轴缓起、冲刺，每到一个刻度那张卡片从轴上弹立，末刻度急刹并推近。

bricks.fits: A history whose speed is the point (shipping often, years of work) ending on the milestone the film is about.
bricks.notFor: Histories the viewer must read item by item (only the last two cards are readable); more than five milestones.

intent.en: Tell a history as speed: past versions flash by like scenery, and the hard stop on today says 'this is what matters now'.
intent.zh: 把一段历史讲成速度：过去的版本像窗外风景一样闪过，在“今天”急刹，说明“现在这个最重要”。

content.en: 3–5 milestones, each a label (en ≤ 6 chars, zh ≤ 3), a date (en ≤ 8, zh ≤ 5), a title (en ≤ 18, zh ≤ 8), a two-line description (en ≤ 40, zh ≤ 20) and a metric (en ≤ 20, zh ≤ 8); an eyebrow and a headline (en ≤ 32, zh ≤ 14).
content.zh: 3–5 个里程碑，每个一个标签（英文 ≤ 6 字符，中文 ≤ 3 字）、日期（英文 ≤ 8，中文 ≤ 5）、标题（英文 ≤ 18，中文 ≤ 8）、两行描述（英文 ≤ 40，中文 ≤ 20）和一个指标（英文 ≤ 20，中文 ≤ 8）；一行眉标和一句大标题（英文 ≤ 32，中文 ≤ 14）。

fits.zh: 速度本身就是重点的一段历史（发版很勤、多年积累），落在本片要讲的那个里程碑上。

notFor.zh: 要逐条读的历史（只有最后两张卡读得清）；超过五个里程碑。

pairs.note: after the stop on today, make that version the protagonist

en: Leave at least a second still after the brake; plan the end first and work the travel backwards.
Only the last two cards are read; put the milestone that matters last and keep the earlier ones glanceable.
zh: 急刹后至少留 1 秒静止；排时间线时先留好末段，再倒推行程。
只有最后两张卡读得清；把要讲的里程碑放最后，前面的只求一瞥。

upstream.name: 时间线穿行
upstream.summary: 时间轴横移——镜头沿水平刻度轴加速掠过版本刻度，每过一格卡片弹立短停，末刻度急停推近
upstream.use: changelog/里程碑/发展史段落（"我们一直在发货"的另一种拍法）；与 scroll-brake-moves 分工：那卡是纵向列表急刹，本卡是横向时间旅行
upstream.energy: 中高（加速→急刹的节奏型镜头）

a vertical list braking on its key item; milestone-run is horizontal travel through history

summary.en: The close: the ground opens out of the line, a blade cuts the line into the name in the line colour, the band contracts into the caret, which types the URL; the closing line enters; on the last downbeat the caret falls flat under the URL.
summary.zh: 收尾：底色从线里打开，一把刀把线切成线色的产品名，剩下的线条收成光标、敲出网址；结束语进场；最后一个强拍上光标平躺成网址的下划线。

bricks.fits: The lock-up of a thread film.
bricks.notFor: Names over 16 characters; a film without a URL (the band then stays under the name).

intent.en: End where the film began: the line that typed the request is cut into the name and types the link.
intent.zh: 回到开头：当初敲出需求的那条线，被切成产品名、再敲出链接。

content.en: The name (≤ 16), one closing line (≤ 52), the URL (≤ 52).
content.zh: 产品名（≤ 8 字）、一句结束语（≤ 20 字）、网址。

fits.zh: thread 片子的收尾。

notFor.zh: 超过 16 个字符的名字；没有网址的片子（那时线条留在名字下面）。

pairs.note: its card squashes into the line

en: The closing URL needs 3 s after it is typed: the close takes the bar rounding to give it.
Pass the film's chain as `before` / `after`: the hand-offs read the neighbours, and the link's length is fitted with them (a link alone fits differently).
zh: 网址敲完要停 3 秒：收尾环节吃掉小节取整来保证这一点。
把整片的链作为 before / after 传进来：交接读的是相邻环节，长度也和它们一起拟合（单独一环拟合出的长度不同）。

summary.en: The lock-up: name and version (amber when it is the answer), the tagline, the install command typing; the ground flips once more on the last downbeat.
summary.zh: 落版：名字和版本号（版本是答案时为琥珀色）、标语、安装命令打出来；最后一个强拍上底色再翻一次。

bricks.fits: The closing of a query film: the product that answered, and how to get it.
bricks.notFor: A film that ends on a claim or a reveal (use answer-whiteout as the close); a name without a command.

intent.en: The answer gets a name and a way in: the name stands still, the command types out and holds long enough to copy, the last flip closes the rhythm.
intent.zh: 答案有了名字和入口：名字不动，命令打出来并停留到够人抄下，最后一次翻底收住节奏。

content.en: A name (≤ 12 chars), an optional version (≤ 6), a tagline (≤ 34 chars), an install command (≤ 34 chars of code).
content.zh: 名字（≤ 6 字）、可选版本号、一句标语（≤ 14 字）、安装命令（≤ 34 个字符的代码）。

fits.zh: 提问式片子的收尾：给出答案的产品，以及怎么用上它。

notFor.zh: 以主张或揭晓收尾的片子；没有命令的名字。

pairs.note: the figures before it, through runtime slice-smear

en: The version is amber only when it is the search's answer (`answer: true`).
Hold the typed command at least 3 s.
zh: 只有版本号就是检索答案时才用琥珀色（`answer: true`）。
命令打完至少停 3 秒。

summary.en: The name is stated first: a crosshair draws itself, the name presses in letter by letter with a glint under each, a kicker types itself, and the lockup holds a full second before lifting away.
summary.zh: 先立名号：准星描画，名字逐字压印、字底闪过强调色短划，副标打字机打出，整组静止满一秒后上浮消散。

bricks.fits: The first beat of an opening that names the product before any of it is shown; a quiet lockup.
bricks.notFor: High-energy openings (it starts low on purpose); names longer than two words; repeated mid-film titles.

intent.en: Give the viewer the name to remember before anything of the product is shown: quiet, pressed like ink, with one complete still moment.
intent.zh: 在任何产品画面出现之前先让观众看清并记住名字：安静、像墨一样压印，有一个完整的静止时刻。

content.en: The product name (up to 2 words; en ≤ 16 chars, zh ≤ 7) and an optional kicker line (en ≤ 32, zh ≤ 12).
content.zh: 产品名（最多两个词；英文 ≤ 16 字符，中文 ≤ 7 字）和一行可选副标（英文 ≤ 32，中文 ≤ 12）。

fits.zh: 开场第一拍，在展示产品之前先立名号；安静的落版。

notFor.zh: 高能量开场（它故意低起步）；超过两个词的名字；片中反复出现的标题。

pairs.note: a louder second beat that takes the name into the product

en: The full-second hold belongs to the name's lockup; do not copy it onto ordinary title or content cards.
Keep the opening low; a showy first beat leaves the film no room to climb.
zh: 满一秒的静止是给名号落定的；别照搬到普通字卡或内容卡上。
开场能量要低；第一拍就炫技，后面没有爬升空间。

summary.en: Three recap words as rows of neon tubes on an angled brick wall, running in opposite directions and lit one row at a time, then switched off row by row with a flicker.
summary.zh: 三个回顾词做成斜拍砖墙上的三行霓虹灯管字，行与行反向滚动、轮流点亮，结尾逐行闪两下熄灭。

bricks.fits: A recap or a rest before the end: three short words the film has earned (three steps, three promises), in a night or launch-party mood.
bricks.notFor: Words the viewer has not met before (they scroll and are only lit a third of the time); more or fewer than three; light, editorial or documentary styles.

intent.en: Three words the film earned glow like signs on a street at night: a recap with a party mood before the end.
intent.zh: 片子挣来的三个词像夜街招牌一样亮起：带点派对气氛的回顾，收尾前喘口气。

content.en: Exactly three words, one word each (≤ 9 chars), already met earlier in the film.
content.zh: 正好三个词，每个 ≤ 3 字，片中前面已经出现过。

fits.zh: 收尾前的回顾或休息：三个片子已经讲过的短词（三步、三个承诺），夜景或发布派对气质。

notFor.zh: 观众没见过的词（会滚动，每行只亮三分之一时间）；不是三个；明亮、编辑感或纪录感的风格。

pairs.note: the wall powers down, then the lock-up on a dark frame

en: Each word is lit only a third of the time and scrolls: new words are not read.
On a light look the glow has nothing to glow against.
zh: 每个词只亮三分之一时间还在滚：新词读不出来。
浅色风格上光晕没有暗底可衬。

summary.en: A stretch of the stream night after the closing sweep for a film's own composition: the sky goes on with the film's motes and push, and the mascot stays on its perch or leaves the frame to the composition.
summary.zh: 收束之后留一段 stream 的夜空给片子自己的合成：夜空照整片的微尘与推进继续，吉祥物留在线顶，或把画面让给合成。

bricks.fits: A section the stream skeleton has no scene for (a draw, an offer, a reveal) after the close, or an ending of the film's own in place of the lock-up.
bricks.notFor: Anything a stream scene already draws; a stretch with nothing over it (the night alone is a held frame); before the close (the stars are still in the sky there).

intent.en: Keep the film one continuous night past the close, so the film's own section or ending sits in the same sky with no seam.
intent.zh: 让收束之后仍是同一片夜空，片子自己的段落或结尾放在里面，看不出接缝。

content.en: Nothing to read: its length in beats (the composition's own) and whether the mascot stays on its perch; the composition over it is the film's.
content.zh: 没有字：长度（拍数，按合成自己的需要）和吉祥物留不留在线顶；上面的合成由片子自己画。

fits.zh: 收束之后 stream 骨架里没有的段落（抽奖、福利、揭晓），或代替落版的片子自己的结尾。

notFor.zh: stream 场景已经能画的东西；上面什么都不放（只剩夜空就是一帧定格）；收束之前（那时星还在天上）。

pairs.note: a reveal over it as the film's own ending

en: Give it the composition's length: the film's sky push and the lock-up after it are laid out with it, so a host that redraws the sky with another length shows a seam.
With `perch: false` the composition draws the mascot where it takes it from: the perch is at (230, 156), the size the film's `mascotSize.sit`.
As the film's last scene it takes the film's rounding to a whole bar: read its length from the plan, not from `beats`.
zh: 长度给合成自己的长度：整片夜空的推进和后面的落版都按它排，宿主用别的长度重画夜空就会露接缝。
`perch: false` 时吉祥物由合成从线顶接走：线顶在 (230, 156)，大小是整片的 `mascotSize.sit`。
它是整片最后一场时会吃掉整片取整到整小节的余量：长度以排出来的为准，不以 `beats` 为准。

summary.en: A chapter card: a 640 px numeral on one side, a mono label, the chapter title at 225 px over a 12 px ink rule and a caption; the numeral steps 6 px on every beat while it holds.
summary.zh: 章节卡：一侧是 640 px 的巨型数字，另一侧是等宽标签、225 px 的章节标题、12 px 墨线和一行说明；停留时数字每拍挪 6 px。

bricks.fits: Between parts of a claim-plus-steps film: one card per chapter, two seconds each.
bricks.notFor: Films with one part; titles longer than two words; a film already paced by another chapter device.

intent.en: The film announces its structure like a poster series: a giant numeral says where you are before the page says what.
intent.zh: 片子像一套海报那样报出结构：先用巨型数字说“第几部分”，再由页面说“是什么”。

content.en: Number (1–2 digits), label (≤ 14 chars), title (≤ 14 chars), caption (≤ 40 chars); side left or right.
content.zh: 编号（1–2 位）、标签（≤ 6 字）、标题（≤ 5 字）、说明（≤ 16 字）；数字在左或在右。

fits.zh: “主张 + 步骤”型片子各部分之间：每章一张卡，各约两秒。

notFor.zh: 只有一部分的片子；超过两个词的标题；已经用别的章节手法定节奏的片子。

en: Two chapter cards in a row lose the numeral's weight; put a page between them.
zh: 两张章节卡挨着放，巨型数字就失去分量；中间要隔一页。

summary.en: A page of decisions: each question has two options, the person's pick fills in the accent and its note appears; a summary box and an ink confirm block with a tick close the page; an ink frame walks the picks while it holds.
summary.zh: 一页决定：每个问题两个选项，人选中的那个填上强调色并出现注释；最后是汇总框和一块带勾的墨色确认块；停留时墨框在选项间走动。

bricks.fits: A chapter page where a person decides something the product then acts on: settings, reviews, approvals.
bricks.notFor: More than three questions; options longer than a short phrase; decisions the product makes alone (the accent means a person).

intent.en: Show that a person decides, and what: the accent fills the chosen option, so the viewer sees each decision being made.
intent.zh: 让人看到“是人在决定、决定了什么”：强调色填进被选的那项，每个决定都看得见。

content.en: Page head (number, title, caption), 1–3 questions with two options (≤ 16 chars) and a note, a summary (≤ 40 chars) and a confirm line.
content.zh: 页头（编号、标题、说明）、1–3 个问题各两个选项（≤ 8 字）和注释、一句汇总（≤ 16 字）和确认行。

fits.zh: 某章里由人做出、产品随后执行的决定：设置、评审、审批。

notFor.zh: 超过三个问题；选项长于短语；产品自己做的决定（强调色代表人）。

pairs.note: its pick carries into the loop's first node (block-carry)

en: The unpicked option must stay ink outline: filling both makes the accent stop meaning a decision.
zh: 没被选的选项要保持墨色描边；两个都填色，强调色就不再表示决定。

summary.en: A two-level title sits inside a ring of content cards orbiting it; the key line arrives out of a blur, a highlighter sweeps it and turns its letters dark, a kicker floats up.
summary.zh: 八张内容卡沿椭圆匀速公转，中间两级标题逐字解糊落定，荧光马克块横扫关键行、扫过处字反白，副行浮出。

bricks.fits: The first shot of an opening that says "there is a whole set of these": a library, templates, a feature matrix, case studies; one claim held up by real product pictures.
bricks.notFor: A single hero object; claims longer than one short line; light, sparse styles where eight cards read as clutter.

intent.en: Hold up one claim with a whole set of real product pictures circling it: cards always entering and leaving say 'there is more', while the title stays fixed in the middle.
intent.zh: 用一整圈真实产品画面托住一句主张：卡片永远有进有出，暗示“还有更多”，标题稳稳钉在正中。

content.en: 6–10 product pictures (16:9 crops or the film's own cards, each with a static first frame), a lead line (en ≤ 40 chars, zh ≤ 14), a key line (en ≤ 24, zh ≤ 9, one line) and an optional kicker (en ≤ 32, zh ≤ 16).
content.zh: 6–10 张产品画面（16:9 切图或影片自己的卡，首帧要有静态骨架），一行引语（英文 ≤ 40 字符，中文 ≤ 14 字）、一行关键句（英文 ≤ 24，中文 ≤ 9，必须一行）和可选副行（英文 ≤ 32，中文 ≤ 16）。

fits.zh: 开场第一镜，说“这里有一整套东西”：素材库、模板、功能矩阵、案例集；用真实产品画面托住一句主张。

notFor.zh: 单个主角对象；超过一短行的主张；浅色稀疏的风格，八张卡会显得杂乱。

pairs.note: a 3D ring when cards must turn and be named one by one

en: Never tilt the cards with the orbit; they change place, not angle, or the ring becomes a roller coaster and the text tilts.
Keep the key line on one line; the highlighter and the letter inversion assume a single line box.
Add no second moving layer (particles, sweeps, breathing gradients) over the turning ring; two constant motions leave no hierarchy.
Each card's first frame must be a filled still; cards whose content draws in from nothing show as blanks while the ring opens.
zh: 卡不能随公转倾斜；只换位置不换角度，否则环变成过山车，卡内字也歪了。
关键句必须在一行内；马克块和反白都假设高亮词在同一行。
环上不要再叠第二个持续运动（粒子、扫光、渐变呼吸），否则读不出主次。
每张卡的首帧要有静态骨架；“从零画出来”的卡在环撑开期间是空白。

upstream.name: 环形卡阵标题开场
upstream.summary: 石墨暗场上八张 16:9 暗色内容卡按 45° 均布在 720×380 椭圆上匀速公转（卡身永不倾斜，纵深只由 sin θ 给出 ±12% 缩放、z 序与远处压暗失焦），环撑开期间卡内容冻结首帧、f24 之后八张一起开播；居中两级标题逐字解糊下沉落定，关键词到位那一刻荧光马克块自左横扫铺满、扫过处字反白为墨，mono 副行随后浮出；可选末段整行失焦淡出、环继续转着交棒下一镜
upstream.use: 开场第一镜 = 「这个产品有一整套东西」；素材库/模板库/功能矩阵/案例集的门面拍；需要用真实运动的产品画面托住一句主张，而不是把截图摆成静态九宫格
upstream.energy: 中（唯一的持续运动是匀速公转，全片只有马克块横扫一次冲击）

summary.en: The storyboard link: swatches, glyphs or the line itself grow into six 16:9 panels, sketches draw in them, panel 3 (the merge's first frame) is outlined in the line colour; the stage name. Opening the film, the line is cut into four segments that open into panels.
summary.zh: 分镜环节：色板、字形或那条线本身长成六格 16:9 分镜，格里画出草图，第三格（合并镜头的第一帧）用线色描边选中；中央是阶段名。作为片子第一环时，那条线切成四段打开成分镜。

bricks.fits: A reel's planning step; the first link of the short chain.
bricks.notFor: More than six panels; boards whose panels show nothing the film does.

intent.en: Show the film planned before anything moves, and choose the shot the camera will go into.
intent.zh: 在一切动起来之前先展示规划好的片子，并选出镜头要推进去的那一格。

content.en: No copy of its own: the stage name and note.
content.zh: 本身没有文案：阶段名和注释。

fits.zh: 作品集里的规划一步；短链的第一环。

notFor.zh: 超过六格；格里画的不是片子真做的事。

en: Pass the film's chain as `before` / `after`: the hand-offs read the neighbours, and the link's length is fitted with them (a link alone fits differently).
zh: 把整片的链作为 before / after 传进来：交接读的是相邻环节，长度也和它们一起拟合（单独一环拟合出的长度不同）。

summary.en: The six panels gather into one card at main size; the title rises, language tabs and code enter, the highlight steps tab to tab leading edge first, and Run takes the accent.
summary.zh: 六块面板收成一张主尺寸的卡片；标题升起，语言标签和代码进场，高亮前沿先动、逐个切换标签，最后运行按钮接过强调色。

bricks.fits: The demo beat of a developer product: one call shown in several languages.
bricks.notFor: More than four tabs; code lines over 44 characters.

intent.en: A whole interface narrows to one call shown in the viewer's language of choice, so 'it works in yours' is seen.
intent.zh: 整个界面收成一个调用，用观众自己的语言展示，“你的语言也能用”是看见的。

content.en: A title (≤ 28 / 12 字), 1–4 tabs (language, 1–3 code lines ≤ 44 chars), the Run label (≤ 6 chars / 3 字).
content.zh: 标题（≤ 28 字符 / 12 字），1–4 个标签页（语言名，1–3 行代码，每行 ≤ 44 字符），运行按钮文字（≤ 6 字符 / 3 字）。

fits.zh: 开发者产品的演示拍：一个调用用几种语言展示。

notFor.zh: 超过四个标签页；超过 44 字符的代码行。

en: The highlight moves leading edge first; jumping both edges at once reads as a cut.
zh: 高亮要前沿先动；两边同时跳读起来像剪切。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: One parameter drives a layout: a big readout over a dial ruler, a row of blocks under a selection frame with measured gaps; the value draws back, swings out, holds and springs home, and everything follows in the same frame.
summary.zh: 一个参数带动整块布局：大读数和刻度拨盘，下面一排带选框和间距标注的块；数值先后撤、再甩出、停一拍、弹回，所有依赖它的东西同帧跟着动。

bricks.fits: Showing that one setting controls many things at once, in a design, low-code or configuration demo: change one number and the layout follows in the same frame.
bricks.notFor: Several parameters; values the viewer cannot see in the layout; light, decorative passages; audiences who do not know design-tool selection frames.

intent.en: Film the cause, not just the before and after: one number moves and everything that depends on it moves in the same frame, so the viewer believes the parameter really drives the layout.
intent.zh: 拍出因果，而不只是前后对比：一个数字在动，所有依赖它的东西同帧跟着动，观众才相信真是这个参数在驱动布局。

content.en: One parameter with its unit and values (rest, peak), a label (en ≤ 18 chars, zh ≤ 8), a layer name (en ≤ 14, zh ≤ 6) and 3–6 block labels (en ≤ 12, zh ≤ 4), the first active.
content.zh: 一个参数及其单位和取值（常值、峰值），一个标签（英文 ≤ 18 字符，中文 ≤ 8 字），一个图层名（英文 ≤ 14，中文 ≤ 6），3–6 个块标签（英文 ≤ 12，中文 ≤ 4），第一个为当前项。

fits.zh: 设计、低代码或配置类演示里，表现一个设置同时控制很多东西：改一个数，布局同帧跟着变。

notFor.zh: 多个参数；在布局里看不出来的数值；轻松装饰性的段落；不认识设计工具框选的受众。

pairs.note: a choice whose result is a number, after the dial

en: The readout and the layout must come from the same value on the same frame; one frame apart breaks the trust.
Turn one parameter per shot; two or more read as random tweaking.
If the picture already shows a real inspector field, drop the big readout so the value is not reported twice.
zh: 读数和布局必须来自同一个值、同一帧；差一帧，“参数驱动”的信任就碎了。
一镜只拨一个参数；两个以上读作乱调。
画面里已有真实的检查器数值框时，去掉大读数，别重复报数。

upstream.summary: 间距拨盘驱动布局——一排链接块带框选描边+缝隙间距标注，徽章数字逐格跳动、块被参数实时推开再弹簧回弹归位；"参数驱动布局"的可视化
upstream.use: 设计工具/低代码产品的"改一个数、界面跟着动"卖点镜头；"用设计工具语义做包装"的品类语言
upstream.energy: 中（工具理性型，爽点在数字与位移的锁定同步）

overlaps.note: a number changing as an odometer; param-dial is a live value driving a layout

bricks.approvedBy: taste/journal.md 2026-11-10 · K 片积木重组：算不退步，进 Skill

summary.en: Getting started as a parts list: a bill-of-materials table of 1–3 rows with BOM balloons, then a chain of 2–5 chips (the first steps) under a THEN label, and a note.

summary.en: A fixed-width pill lands slightly large and out of focus with a light inside it; a sentence types in at an even pace and the light recedes as it does.

bricks.fits: The quiet moment a request is given, before the product answers.
bricks.notFor: Text longer than a line; busy or fast passages; showing the reply.

intent.en: A rest between louder beats: the input glows while it waits for you, and gives its light to the words as they arrive, so the request feels calm and personal.
intent.zh: 高能段之间的一个休止：输入条等你开口时亮着光，字一出来就把光让给文字，请求显得安静而亲近。

content.en: One request sentence (en ≤ 34 chars, zh ≤ 16, one line) and an optional caption under the pill (en ≤ 24, zh ≤ 10).
content.zh: 一句请求（英文 ≤ 34 字符，中文 ≤ 16 字，一行内）和胶囊下方一行可选说明（英文 ≤ 24，中文 ≤ 10）。

notFor.zh: 超过一行的文字；忙碌或快节奏的段落；展示回答（交给下一场）。

en: Do only three things: land, type, let the light recede; any extra bounce, colour change or icon motion stops it being a rest.
On a light stage the glow must be strong and the ambient light must recede with it, or the receding light is not seen.
Re-fit the pill width (about 1.8–2× the sentence) and the typing window when the sentence changes.
zh: 只做三件事：落位、打字、光退；任何额外的弹跳、变色、图标动画都会让这一拍不再是休止。
亮场里内嵌光要给足饱和度，背后环境光要一起退，否则看不出“光退”。
句子变了，胶囊定宽（约句宽 1.8–2 倍）和打字窗口一起改。

summary.en: Four cells, each running its own brick, start a few frames apart and play at once, each labelled on a chip.

bricks.notFor: Bricks that need the full frame to read (type below the quarter-frame floor); more or fewer than four things; a calm section.

intent.en: Information overload on purpose: four things happen at once and some quarter moves every few frames, so the viewer feels how much the product does.
intent.zh: 刻意的信息轰炸：四件事同时发生、每隔几帧就有一格动一下，让观众感到产品能做的事很多。

fits.zh: 四个功能或结果同时出现，各带自己的小动作。

notFor.zh: 要全屏才看得清的积木（字小于四分之一画面的下限）；多于或少于四件事；安静的段落。

en: Stagger the starts so no two quarters hit a heavy event on the same frame; four at once is the usual failure.
About 2 s of bombardment is the limit; longer needs a second event per quarter.
zh: 起动要错开，任何一帧都不该有两格同时出重事件；四格同时弹入是最常见的退化。
轰炸段约 2 秒是上限；再长要给每格加第二轮事件。

summary.en: A sentence with one slot: the stem holds still while the slot cycles through words (or pictures) on the beat, then the sentence lands; five ways to cycle.
summary.zh: 一句话留一个词槽：句干不动，槽里的词（或图）按节拍轮换，最后落成完整的一句；五种换法。

bricks.fits: A list of features, audiences, roles or steps said as one sentence (Built for ___, Every ___ checked, Your ___ agent).
bricks.notFor: Items that need reading time each (over two words, four Chinese characters); lists without a common stem; more than six items.

intent.en: A promise and its proofs in one line: the stem stays put and only the slot changes, so a list reads as one sentence and ends as a conclusion.
intent.zh: 一句话里装下承诺和证据：句干不动、只换槽里的词，清单读成一句话，最后落成结论。

content.en: A stem (≤ 18 chars, Chinese ≤ 6 characters), 3–6 items of 1–2 words (≤ 14 chars, Chinese ≤ 4 characters, lengths within 2× of each other), an optional tail; `bracket`: a picture per item.
content.zh: 句干（≤ 18 字符、中文 ≤ 6 字），3–6 个 1–2 词的条目（≤ 14 字符、中文 ≤ 4 字，长短相差不超过一倍），句尾可选；`bracket` 版每项配一张图。

fits.zh: 把一串功能、对象、角色或步骤说成一句话（为 ___ 而生、每一次 ___ 都检查过、你的 ___ 助手）。

notFor.zh: 每项都要读一会儿（超过两个词或四个汉字）；没有共同句干的清单；多于六项。

en: The stem must not move a pixel; any wobble loses the list.
Keep items within 2× of each other's length, or the slot jumps and the sentence swings.
One slot style per film; the closing words take the stem's size and weight, or they read as a new title.
zh: 句干一像素都不能动；一晃列举感就散。
各项长短相差控制在一倍内，否则槽宽跳变、句子左右甩。
一支片只留一种词槽；收束的词与句干同字号同字重，否则读成新标题。

upstream.name: 词槽轮换
upstream.summary: 句中词槽轮换——固定句干钉死不动，句尾 pill 徽章每 ~0.7s 老虎机滚一格（旧的上飞加速淡出、新的从下带模糊滑入），连换 N 个功能词后落成完整句子收束
upstream.use: "功能列举"类文案的最优雅解法（比逐条列表快、比字符级滚动有语义）；一句话卖点 + 多个动词短语的段落
upstream.energy: 中（稳定节拍器，无峰值）

upstream.name: 胶囊滚轮挤开
upstream.summary: 白底句式 "Your `chip` Handled" 里深色胶囊内词竖向滚轮轮换，胶囊宽度按预量文本宽插值平滑伸缩、两侧文字被自然挤开收拢，胶囊上下露出 13% 透明度的灰色幽灵项
upstream.use: "我们替你搞定 ___" 这类句式卖点；SaaS 功能列举的一句话收口；浅底品牌片主视觉一拍
upstream.energy: 中（三拍稳定节拍，宽度伸缩是唯一的连续运动）

upstream.name: 竖向词条滚轮
upstream.summary: 句尾词换成竖向滚轮，3 次换词各 0.55s（outQuint 七成 + outBack 三成，前快后极慢带微过冲），相邻行按距离上垂直 blur 与灰度，中心词落定瞬间从灰染成强调色
upstream.use: "Crafted for ___" / "Built for ___" 这类句干 + 受众/对象列举的一句话卖点；浅底品牌片的干净一拍
upstream.energy: 中（稳定三拍，无峰值）

upstream.name: 双词合拢
upstream.summary: 双词对峙合拢——左"NEW"右特性词钉死在等屏边距两侧硬切轮换、全程零收缩，换到最后一词才唯一一次 ease-in-out 滑到居中咬合成短语，下方小字近乎硬切浮现；收尾揭晓型文字卡
upstream.use: 特性清单收束到产品名/口号的段落（"NEW × 一串特性 → NEW <产品名>"式）；发布会式 recap、版本号揭晓
upstream.energy: 中低（机器节奏、小字规格清单气质，不是砸字）

upstream.name: 对焦框轮换
upstream.summary: "Your ___ agent" 填空排版，四角对焦框钉在句中不动，头像队列在框内垂直 spring 轮换三次，入框放大清晰、出框按距离缩小淡化模糊，角色标签同步更换，切换瞬间对焦框呼吸 7%
upstream.use: "一个位置，多种角色"的能力枚举；团队/身份/预设/人格类产品的核心一句话镜头
upstream.energy: 中（三次等距切换构成稳定节拍器，对焦框脉冲是唯一装饰性动作）

summary.en: Three chapter cards hang in one 3D space; the camera holds on each, flies to the next as its title rises, then pulls back to show all three under the closing line.
summary.zh: 三张章节卡悬在同一个 3D 空间里，相机逐张停留、飞往下一张，标题随落位升起，最后拉远看全三张，收尾一句话升起。

bricks.fits: A film or section told in three steps or chapters, with a line that sums them up (demo, turn, lockup).
bricks.notFor: More or fewer than three steps; chapters that need more than a title and a line; a camera that should stay still.

intent.en: Three steps told as three places in one space: each chapter gets its own angle, and the pull-back at the end shows how they make one whole.
intent.zh: 把三步讲成同一空间里的三个地方：每章换一个空间视角，最后拉远让观众看到三者合成一个整体。

content.en: Three chapters, each a kicker (≤ 14 chars, Chinese ≤ 6 characters), a one-word title (≤ 9 chars, Chinese ≤ 4) and a line (≤ 40 chars, Chinese ≤ 14); a closing headline (≤ 20 chars, Chinese ≤ 8).
content.zh: 三章，每章一个眉题（≤ 14 字符、中文 ≤ 6 字）、一个单词标题（≤ 9 字符、中文 ≤ 4 字）和一行说明（≤ 40 字符、中文 ≤ 14 字）；收尾标题（≤ 20 字符、中文 ≤ 8 字）。

fits.zh: 分三步或三章讲的一支片或一段，加一句总括（演示、转折、落版）。

notFor.zh: 多于或少于三步；每章要的不只是一个标题加一行字；镜头应当不动。

en: Keep the text on the rolled third card short; it only reads once the camera rights it.
zh: 侧躺的第三张卡字要短；转正后才读得出。

upstream.name: 空间步进演示
upstream.summary: impress.js 式空间演示：卡片以不同位置/旋转/缩放散布 3D 空间，相机取各步姿态之逆依次飞行对齐，末步拉到 OVERVIEW 总览
upstream.use: 概念/路线图/三步法的空间化讲述；替代平面 slides 的"每一步都换个空间视角"
upstream.energy: 中（每次转场有空间惊喜，停留段安静读卡）

overlaps.note: pose-fly is one flight between two cards; space-steps chains three of them with holds, the chapter content and the closing plate
chapter-push pushes through flat chapter cards; space-steps flies between cards posed in 3D

summary.en: The merge link: the camera pushes through panel 3 into its shot, three glossy spheres on the field drift together, merge through a viscous neck, squash on landing and settle; the stage name under the sphere. Without the curves after it, the sphere squashes into the rod.
summary.zh: 合并环节：镜头穿过第三格推进它的镜头，场色上三个光滑球体靠拢、经粘稠的颈部融合、落地压扁再回弹、静止；阶段名在球下。后面没有曲线环节时，球压成一根线。

bricks.fits: A reel's shading or physics step; the middle of the short chain.
bricks.notFor: Films without a WebGL host; anything that must look photoreal.

intent.en: Show volume, light and physics computed per frame, in the line colour.
intent.zh: 用线色展示逐帧算出的体积、光和物理。

content.en: No copy of its own: the stage name and note.
content.zh: 本身没有文案：阶段名和注释。

fits.zh: 作品集里的着色或物理一步；短链的中段。

notFor.zh: 没有 WebGL 的宿主；必须照片级真实的画面。

en: Without WebGL the spheres fall back to flat discs (a P0 failure of the mode): render in a host with WebGL.
Pass the film's chain as `before` / `after`: the hand-offs read the neighbours, and the link's length is fitted with them (a link alone fits differently).
zh: 没有 WebGL 时球体退化成平面圆（模式的 P0 失败）：要在支持 WebGL 的宿主里渲染。
把整片的链作为 before / after 传进来：交接读的是相邻环节，长度也和它们一起拟合（单独一环拟合出的长度不同）。

summary.en: The product introduces itself from the top of the thread: its name lights beside the mascot, a point lights on the spine, a short light reaches right and the chat block unfolds from it; two lines from the product arrive as bubbles.
summary.zh: 产品在线的顶端自我介绍：名字在吉祥物旁亮起，主干上亮一个点，一道短光向右伸出，对话块从那里展开；产品说的两句话以气泡出现。

bricks.fits: Right after the hook: the product's name and what it promises, in its own voice.
bricks.notFor: A product without a conversational interface; more than two lines.

intent.en: Let the product speak for itself, from the thread that just took everything.
intent.zh: 让产品亲口说话，从刚接走一切的那根线上。

content.en: A name (≤ 10 characters) and two lines (≤ 86 characters / 40 Chinese characters each); optional: the product's name large and one line of who it is, on the right of the block.
content.zh: 一个名字（≤ 10 字符）和两句话（每句 ≤ 86 字符 / 40 个汉字）；可选：右侧的大号产品名和一句身份。

fits.zh: 开场之后：产品的名字和它的承诺，用它自己的口吻。

notFor.zh: 没有对话式界面的产品；超过两句。

zh: 对话块在后面几场还会留着（位置是按整片排的）：不要以空主干结尾。
把整片的 content 作为 `film` 传进来：场景画的是那部片在它这段的画面（之前派出的星、对话记录、块的位置），长度也按它拟合。

summary.en: A loop's real stages on night, one word a beat centred, a STEP n / N counter above and a row of progress dots below; the accent dot is the current step.
summary.zh: 夜色底上，一个循环的真实步骤一拍一个居中砸下，上方是“第 n / N 步”，下方一排进度点，强调色的点是当前步骤。

bricks.fits: How it works in 3–7 real stages: a pipeline, a loop, an algorithm's round.
bricks.notFor: stages that need explaining; more than seven; made-up stages.

intent.en: The method as rhythm: one stage a beat, the dot walking the row, so the viewer feels the loop rather than reads it.
intent.zh: 把方法变成节奏：一拍一个步骤，墨点在那排点上走，观众是感到循环而不是读懂它。

content.en: 3–7 stage words (≤ 9 chars each).
content.zh: 3–7 个步骤词（每个 ≤ 4 字）。

fits.zh: 用 3–7 个真实步骤讲怎么工作：流水线、循环、一轮算法。

notFor.zh: 要解释的步骤；超过七个；编造的步骤。

en: Each step word is cut by the next on the beat: keep them to one word.
zh: 每个步骤词在下一拍被切掉：只用一个词。

summary.en: A matrix of steps by targets: an accent cursor walks the cells, each finished cell is marked DONE and its column gets an accent underline; a 400 px side numeral counts columns and a strip sums the run.
summary.zh: “步骤 × 对象”的矩阵：强调色光标逐格走过，完成的格子标上“完成”，整列完成后划一道强调色下划线；侧边 400 px 数字计列，底部一条汇总。

bricks.fits: A chapter page where the same steps run over several targets: databases, regions, services, files.
bricks.notFor: More than 4 × 5 cells; steps that run in parallel (the cursor is one at a time).

intent.en: Show a run as progress through a grid: one cursor, one cell at a time, so order and completeness read at once.
intent.zh: 把一次运行画成在格子里推进：一个光标、一次一格，顺序和完成度一眼可读。

content.en: Page head, 2–4 row names, 2–5 column names (≤ 10 chars), a done label, a side number and a strip line.
content.zh: 页头、2–4 个行名、2–5 个列名（≤ 5 字）、“完成”标签、侧边数字和一行汇总。

fits.zh: 某章里同一组步骤跑过多个对象：数据库、地区、服务、文件。

notFor.zh: 超过 4 × 5 格；并行执行的步骤（光标一次只在一格）。

en: The DONE label is a mono label: in Chinese it is 完成 at 28 px, not capitals.
zh: “完成”是等宽标签：中文 28 px，不转大写。

summary.en: Whole – part – whole: three strands (or two) fork from the spine and each ends in a glass card; each card is enlarged in turn in place on its strand, its rows arriving, the next growing as the previous shrinks; then all of them again and a sub-line. One card is a single pass: one strand straight into it, already large, its rows read.
summary.zh: 总–分–总：主干分出三根（或两根）细丝，各挂一张玻璃卡；每张卡依次在细丝上原地放大、各行出现，下一张放大时上一张同时缩小；最后全部一起，再加一句副标题。只有一张卡时一遍过：一根细丝直连到已经放大的卡，读完各行。

bricks.fits: What the product keeps between tasks (memory, decisions, files): up to three, shown together and one by one, or one shown on its own.
bricks.notFor: More than three things; things that are not lists; one card that needs a sentence of its own while open (one card is read under the scene's caption).

intent.en: Show the parts and keep the whole: up to three things the product keeps, each read in turn.
intent.zh: 看部分、留住整体：产品保存的东西（最多三样），一样样读。

content.en: Two captions; one to three cards, each with a title, a sub-line and 1–3 rows (≤ 34 characters / 17 Chinese characters); optional: the tangle the strands are pulled out of, a caption per open card (two or three cards), a line flowing into a card, a new task starting from a card; rows up to 5 with the flowed line.
content.zh: 两句字幕；一到三张卡，各有标题、副标题和 1–3 行（≤ 34 字符 / 17 个汉字）；可选：开头线团拽成几股、每张卡放大时的章节句（两张或三张卡时）、一句话顺线流进卡、从卡开工的新任务行；连流进的那句最多 5 行。

fits.zh: 产品在任务之间保存的东西（记忆、决定、文件）：最多三样时先一起再一样样，一样时单独展示。

notFor.zh: 超过三样；不是列表的东西；只有一张卡却要在卡打开时另说一句（一张卡时读的是场景字幕）。

en: The rows are glances (0.8 s each): what a card says is its `say`, read while the card is open; a card without `say` holds for its rows' glances only.

One card is a single pass: it opens already large on one strand, with no whole before or after; its rows are read under the scene's caption, so a card's `say` is refused. Two cards hang at y 435 and 645 and hand over as three do; `day-after-day` needs three cards.
Pass the film's whole content as `film`: the scene draws its window of that film (the stars sent before it, the chat feed, the block's place), and its length is fitted with it.
zh: 卡里的行是扫一眼的（每行 0.8 秒）：一张卡要说的话放在 `say`，卡打开时按读字计时；没给 `say` 的卡只停够各行的扫一眼。
一张卡时一遍过：卡在一根细丝上直接以放大状态出现，前后没有“全部一起”；各行在场景字幕下读，所以不能给卡 `say`。两张卡挂在 y 435 和 645，交接方式同三张；`day-after-day` 要求三张卡。
把整片的 content 作为 `film` 传进来：场景画的是那部片在它这段的画面（之前派出的星、对话记录、块的位置），长度也按它拟合。
