summary.en: A click on the editor's primary button and the interface evaporates around it layer by layer, outside in; the button alone glides to the centre of a dark frame, then lets go to the lock-up.
summary.zh: 点一下编辑器的主按钮，界面由外向内一层层蒸发；只剩按钮滑到暗场中央，再交给标志落版。

bricks.fits: The end of a product demo whose last action is the point (publish, ship, send): the action stays, everything else goes, then the name.
bricks.notFor: Products without a primary action in their UI; endings that should keep the product on screen.

intent.en: Everything but the one action falls away, so the viewer leaves with that action and the name behind it.
intent.zh: 除了那一个动作，其余都褪去：观众带走的是这个动作和它背后的名字。

content.en: The primary action's label (one word ≤ 10 chars), a document title ≤ 20 chars, a wordmark ≤ 16 chars, a mark; up to four screenshots for the editor's cards.
content.zh: 主操作按钮的文字（≤ 3 字），≤ 8 字的文档标题，≤ 6 字的字标，一个标志；编辑器里的卡片最多 4 张截图。

fits.zh: 最后一个动作就是重点的产品演示的结尾（发布、上线、发送）：动作留下，其余褪去，再落名字。

notFor.zh: 界面里没有主操作的产品；片尾要留住产品画面的。

pairs.note: a cursor-led demo ending on the same click

en: The button must be the action the film was about; any other button turns the ending into a random click.
zh: 按钮必须是全片讲的那个动作；换成别的按钮，结尾就成了随手一点。

summary.en: A question typed in a terminal is answered by counting: sources pop in as pills, the window grows, a field of cells fills one column at a time and a bar fills, each figure landing with a hop.
summary.zh: 在终端里打出的问题用计数回答：来源以药丸弹出，窗口长高，小格一列列填满、进度条填满，每个数字落定时跳一下。

bricks.fits: Opening a film on a question and its scale.
bricks.notFor: Answers that are not counts; more than two figures.

intent.en: Hook the viewer with a plain question and a number big enough to need explaining.
intent.zh: 用一个朴素的问题和一个大到需要解释的数字抓住观众。

content.en: A question (≤ 40 / 18), up to three source pills (≤ 12 / 4), one or two counts (label ≤ 26 / 12, value, optional "nearly" prefix), a note.

notFor.zh: 同时两个子集；小到看不见的子集（不到约 1 %）。

summary.en: A check run on a copy: a dashed box (the source) links to an ink box (the copy); result rows fill, a counter climbs with an accent flash, and an accent band lands with two statements: what passed and what the person still decides.
summary.zh: 在副本上跑检查：虚线框（源）连到墨色框（副本）；结果行逐条填好，计数器上数并闪一下强调色，最后一条强调色带落下，写两句话：通过了什么、人还要决定什么。

bricks.fits: A proof page: a dry run, a replay on a shadow copy, a test pass before the person signs.
bricks.notFor: Results with more than six rows; failures to dramatise (the band states a pass).

intent.en: Prove the claim on a copy before anyone signs: rows of results and a counter, then a band that hands the last word to the person.
intent.zh: 在有人签字之前先在副本上证明：一行行结果和计数，最后用色带把决定权交还给人。

content.en: Page head, from and to box labels, 3–6 result rows (≤ 24 chars), a count, an optional blind-spot line, two statements (≤ 32 chars).
content.zh: 页头、源与副本框的标签、3–6 行结果（≤ 12 字）、一个计数、可选的盲区说明、两句陈述（≤ 14 字）。

fits.zh: 证据页：试运行、影子副本回放、人签字前的测试通过。

notFor.zh: 结果超过六行；要渲染失败的戏剧性（色带陈述的是通过）。

pairs.note: the loop that the proof feeds

summary.en: Two sides of a comparison slam together over a question: an ink half against an accent half, each with its number, a flash, a shake and a stamp between them.
summary.zh: 一个问题之下，比较的两边对撞合拢：墨色半边对强调色半边，各带一个数字，闪白、震动，中间盖一枚章。

bricks.fits: The before and after, or us against the old way, told as two numbers (problem, turn, proof).
bricks.notFor: Comparisons of more than two sides; sides without a number; a gentle contrast (the slam reads as a fight).

intent.en: A comparison settled in one hit: the old way and the new slam together, each a number, so the gap is felt as a clash rather than read in a table.
intent.zh: 一击定胜负的对比：老办法和新办法对撞合拢，各带一个数字，差距是“撞”出来的，而不是从表格里读出来的。

content.en: A question (≤ 24 chars, Chinese ≤ 9 characters), two sides each with a name, a number and unit (≤ 3 digits), a caption (≤ 46 chars, Chinese ≤ 13) and 0–4 items; a 1–3 character mark and an optional verdict.
content.zh: 一个问题（≤ 24 字符、中文 ≤ 9 字），两边各一个名称、一个数字加单位（≤ 3 位）、一行说明（≤ 46 字符、中文 ≤ 13 字）和 0–4 个条目；1–3 字符的标记和可选结论。

fits.zh: 之前和之后、我们和老办法，讲成两个数字（问题、转折、证据）。

notFor.zh: 多于两方的比较；没有数字的两边；温和的对照（对撞读作打架）。

en: Only for a real two-sided contrast; without one, the slam is just a slanted wipe.
Counts as the film's loud hit: keep it away from other flash or impact transitions.
zh: 只用于真有两方对峙的内容；没有对峙，对撞只是一次斜缝擦除。
它是全片响的一击：别和别的闪白或撞击转场挤在一起。

summary.en: A live transcript above, a scrolling waveform capsule below: words rise on their syllables, the pause shows in both, and on send the transcript becomes a message bubble.
summary.zh: 上方实时转写、下方滚动声纹胶囊：词随音节浮现，停顿两处同时可见；发送后转写收进一枚消息气泡。

bricks.fits: Voice input in a demo: what was said and that it was heard, ending on the sent message.
bricks.notFor: More than two short phrases; a real recording's waveform (it is drawn from the phrases' timing, not from sound); conversations with replies.

intent.en: A live receipt that it is listening: the viewer reads what was said in the transcript and sees in the waveform that it was heard, rising when you speak and flattening when you pause, then the words are sent.
intent.zh: “它真的在听”的实时回执：观众从转写读到说了什么，从声纹看出被听见了（说话时高耸、停顿时塌平），最后这句话被发出去。

content.en: 1–2 short spoken phrases (each en ≤ 32 chars, zh ≤ 12, one line), an optional hint (en ≤ 26, zh ≤ 10), a listening label and a sent label (en ≤ 18, zh ≤ 6); optional word times to sit on a voice-over.
content.zh: 1–2 句说出的短语（每句英文 ≤ 32 字符，中文 ≤ 12 字，一行内），可选提示语（英文 ≤ 26，中文 ≤ 10），一个“正在听”标签和一个“已发送”标签（英文 ≤ 18，中文 ≤ 6）；可选每个词的时刻以对齐旁白。

fits.zh: 演示里的语音输入：说了什么、它听见了，最后落在发出去的消息上。

notFor.zh: 超过两句短语；真实录音的波形（声纹按短语时序画出，不是从声音算的）；带回复的对话。

pairs.note: a quieter typed version of the same request

en: With a real voice-over, sit the words and the waveform's talk and pause on the voice track; a second off and it shows.
The waveform follows speech, not the music; tying it to the score turns a product feature into decoration.
zh: 有真人旁白时，词和声纹的说停要对齐音轨；错位一秒就穿帮。
声纹跟着说话走，不跟配乐；跟着 BGM 跳就从产品功能变成了装饰。

summary.en: The work is read and counted: the terminal becomes a wall of small windows, a teal reader ticks each, marks run along a rail into a ledger card and pour their dots onto its heap while the counter counts.
summary.zh: 把工作读一遍、记下来：终端变成一面小窗墙，青色读取框逐个打勾，记号沿轨道跑进账本卡片，倒出圆点，计数器跟着数。

bricks.notFor: Small counts (under about 50); exact data the viewer must check.

intent.en: Show where the number comes from: a machine read every item and each one became a dot on the page.
intent.zh: 交代数字从哪来：机器读了每一件，每件都成了纸上一颗点。

content.zh: 上一场的终端、墙的说明（≤ 50 / 22）、读取者标签（≤ 20 / 6）、账本标题、计数单位、两行图例、点数。

fits.zh: 把一堆工作变成之后可以分的计数。

notFor.zh: 小数量（约 50 以下）；观众要核对的精确数据。

en: The counter counts the dots that have landed, not a separate number.
Say what a mark and a dot stand for (the legend) before the heap is sorted.
zh: 计数器数的是已落下的点，不是另一个数字。
分堆之前先用图例说清一颗记号、一颗点各代表什么。

summary.en: Keywords fly out of the depth toward the camera and past it through a tunnel of faint rings and streaks, looping seamlessly behind a still title.
summary.zh: 关键词从纵深飞向镜头并掠过，穿过淡淡的光环与流线，无缝循环在一行静止的标题后面。

bricks.fits: A hook or a lockup that says "a lot of things, all here": a still title over a field of the product's nouns.
bricks.notFor: Words that must be read one by one; calm, editorial films such as dossier (the flow never stops); light grounds (the glow and the veil want a dark ground).

intent.en: Say 'a lot of things, all here' without asking anyone to read them: the product's nouns stream out of the depth past the camera, so the viewer reads three or five at a time but feels there are many, behind one still title.
intent.zh: 不要求观众读，也能说清“很多东西，全在这里”：产品的名词从纵深飞向镜头并掠过，观众每次只读到三五个，却感到很多，前面压着一行静止的标题。

content.en: 12–28 short keywords of similar length (en ≤ 18 chars, zh ≤ 6), a few marked for the accent, an optional still title (en ≤ 32, zh ≤ 14) and eyebrow (en ≤ 24, zh ≤ 10).
content.zh: 12–28 个长度相近的短关键词（英文 ≤ 18 字符，中文 ≤ 6 字），挑几个用强调色，可选一行静止标题（英文 ≤ 32，中文 ≤ 14）和眉标（英文 ≤ 24，中文 ≤ 10）。

fits.zh: 说“很多东西，全在这里”的钩子或落版：一行静止标题压在产品名词组成的词场上。

notFor.zh: 要逐个读的词；安静的编辑感片子，如 dossier（流动从不停）；浅色底（光晕和暗幕要暗底）。

pairs.note: the still title line over the tunnel

en: Keep the word count and word length close to the defaults; density scales with the count, and Chinese words need a smaller size or near words fill the frame.
Laps per loop must be a whole number, or the loop does not join.
It is a background layer; turning the words up to full brightness as the subject reads as clutter.
zh: 词数和词长保持在默认量级；词数一变密度整体缩放，中文词要调小字号，否则近处的词占满画面。
每个循环的圈数必须是整数，否则首尾接不上。
它是背景层；把词拉满亮度当主角反而读作杂乱。

summary.en: An accent word rises and warps beat by beat, ghosts smearing off it, while an ink word slams under it with its full stop.
summary.zh: 一个强调色的词升起并一拍拍扭曲，带着拖影；下面一个黑字砸下，带着句号。

bricks.fits: A problem that is unstable or blamed: "blame everyone", "flaky tests".
bricks.notFor: a calm statement; a word that must be read exactly (the warp blurs it).

intent.en: Instability made visible: the problem word cannot hold its shape while the plain word under it lands hard.
intent.zh: 让不稳定看得见：问题词保持不住形状，下面那个平实的词却重重落下。

content.en: Two single words (≤ 10 chars), an optional label.
content.zh: 两个单词（每个 ≤ 4 字），可选标签。

fits.zh: 不稳定或互相甩锅的问题：“甩锅给所有人”“测试时好时坏”。

content.en: One heavy word (en ≤ 9 letters, zh ≤ 3 chars), an optional eyebrow (en ≤ 22 chars, zh ≤ 8) and subtitle (en ≤ 44, zh ≤ 16), and one live product picture with large areas of colour and bright lines (dark or darkened).
content.zh: 一个超粗的词（英文 ≤ 9 个字母，中文 ≤ 3 字），可选眉标（英文 ≤ 22 字符，中文 ≤ 8 字）和副标（英文 ≤ 44，中文 ≤ 16），加一张有大块色面和亮线的产品画面（暗色或调暗）。

fits.zh: 开场第一镜或章节卡，名字或一个词的主张与产品要放在一起：字是门，产品在门里；结尾产品占满全屏，下一场可以直接在它里面开始。

notFor.zh: 浅色舞台后面放浅色画面（窗里必须有大块色面和亮线）；细体或轻字重；超过约九个字母（中文三个字）的词；同一支片还用了 counter-portal 的穿笔画（同一招用两次）。

pairs.note: a quiet name first, then the word that opens into the product

en: Darken a light page or use its dark theme; the strokes must show large areas of colour and bright lines, or the word does not read as a window.
Do not outline the letters; variable fonts build glyphs from overlapping contours and an outline draws their insides.
The picture is watched in close-up the whole time; rasterise it at high resolution or it blurs inside the strokes.
Not in the same film as counter-portal's push through a stroke; both grow a world out of a word.
zh: 浅色页面要先调暗或换暗色主题；笔画里要透出大块色面和亮线，否则字读不出“窗”。

字里的画面全程被特写盯着；要高分辨率栅格化，否则在笔画里糊成一片。
别和 counter-portal 的穿笔画同片并用；两者都是“字里长出世界”。

summary.en: A two-way control: a segmented control whose stretching thumb slides and swaps the icons, or a toggle whose sun turns to a crescent.

bricks.fits: A two-way mode or theme switch pressed in a demo (A to B, light to dark), from a page-size control to a close-up hero.
bricks.notFor: More than two options (use choice-chip); controls nobody presses.

intent.en: Make one press of a two-way control the whole story, 'we went from A to B': the thumb's slide is the world answering, and the new icon popping in rewards the switch.
intent.zh: 让一次两态控件的按下讲完整件事——“我们从 A 走到了 B”：滑块滑过是世界的回应，新图标弹出是切换的奖励。

content.en: Two one-word labels (en ≤ 9 chars, zh ≤ 3) with their icons for the segmented form; nothing for the sun-and-moon toggle.
content.zh: 分段式要两个一词标签（英文 ≤ 9 字符，中文 ≤ 3 字）及各自图标；日月拨动开关不需要内容。

fits.zh: 演示里被按下的两态模式或主题切换（A 到 B、亮到暗），从页面尺寸的控件到特写主角都可以。

notFor.zh: 超过两个选项（用 choice-chip）；没人按的控件。

pairs.note: the pointer that presses it; without it the UI moves by itself

en: Keep it to two segments; across three or more the thumb's slide is too quick to read where it stops.
Collapse the old icon by width, not just scale, or a ghost gap stays inside the control.
Switch the theme at most once per film; it is a feature beat, and repeated switching reads as a demo accident.
zh: 只用两段；三段以上滑块滑得太快，读不出停在哪。
旧图标要把宽度收到零，不能只缩放，否则控件里留一道幽灵缝。
一支片主题切换最多一次；它是功能叙事，反复切读作演示事故。

bricks.notFor: Marks that stand for several items or a percentage; separating categories by shape.

content.zh: 只需选形状：方块、圆点或象形（页、盒、芯片）。

notFor.zh: 代表多件或百分比的标记；靠形状区分类别。

zh: 不要用形状区分类别，靠颜色和位置。

summary.zh: stream 的吉祥物位：线顶端的锚点，四种姿态（坐着、落下、落地压扁、缠成一个点）；默认是代码画的线团，也可以换成片子自己的吉祥物图片，锚点不变。

bricks.notFor: Brands without a mascot that must not have one; people or photographs.

intent.en: Give the thread a root the viewer can recognise: the product itself, sitting where all the work comes back to.
intent.zh: 给线一个能认出来的根：产品本身，坐在所有事最后回到的地方。

content.en: Nothing to read: an optional image of the film's own mascot; a size for the box it fills (30–160 px, default 60).
content.zh: 没有字：可选的一张片子自己的吉祥物图片；可设它填满的框的大小（30–160 px，默认 60）。

fits.zh: 有吉祥物或角色的产品；线长出来的根。

notFor.zh: 明确不要吉祥物的品牌；真人或照片。

落地压扁是这个风格里唯一的弹跳，不要再加。

summary.en: A look whose texture is light: orbs drifting behind the content, an aurora rising from the foot of the frame, rings breathing round the subject; a night and a dawn preset.
summary.zh: 以光为质感的样式：光斑在内容背后漂移、极光从画框底部升起、同心圆环绕主体呼吸；有夜、晨两套预设。

bricks.fits: One quiet section of a film (or a whole calm film) whose ground should breathe: a product held still, a turn, a closing claim.
bricks.notFor: Busy films (the light competes with the content); paper and print styles; more than one light texture at a time.

intent.en: Let the ground breathe: the product reads as a source of light in a quiet dark section, without any hit or cut.
intent.zh: 让底色呼吸：在一段安静的暗场里，产品读成一个光源，不靠任何打点或剪切。

content.en: Any calm section's content on top; one light per section (orbs, aurora bloom or breathing rings round one subject); a night or a dawn preset.
content.zh: 上面放任何安静段落的内容；每段只用一种光（光斑、极光或围着一个主体呼吸的圆环）；夜、晨两套预设。

fits.zh: 一支片里一段安静的暗场（或整支安静的片）：产品静置、转折、收尾主张。

notFor.zh: 热闹的片（光会抢内容）；纸面与印刷风格；一段里叠两种光。

pairs.note: the bloom texture under the turn of the ground

en: One light per section, in the accent only: violet-to-cyan neon glows on black are a known AI tell.
A film dark all through drowns the light; keep it to the quiet section.
zh: 每段只用一种光，只用强调色：黑底上紫到青的霓虹渐变是公认的 AI 味。
整支片都暗时光就不再有意义；只放在安静的那一段。

upstream.name: 暗场光斑呼吸
upstream.summary: 三团 500-700px radial 光斑 + blur(100px)，双正弦漂移；卡缘辉光按光斑距离 [180,720]px→[1,0] 加权取 max 驱动
upstream.use: 全片唯一暗场段落的氛围与数据叙事：铺底噪用 A、讲数据流向用 B、要背景给前景搭腔用 C；Linear 官网味
upstream.energy: A 低（底噪级）/ B 中 / C 中高

upstream.name: 同心波纹手机
upstream.summary: 暖沙底四层同心圆错相呼吸如水波，中央手机 mockup 屏内 feed 自动缓滚，两侧白色 chip 先后 spring pop 入场并悬浮
upstream.use: 移动端产品的"这就是它"定格镜头；功能点分列两侧的介绍段；片头/片尾的产品全景
upstream.energy: 低（安静、有呼吸感，靠同心圆的持续起伏撑住不冷场）

upstream.name: 极光升腾反黑
upstream.summary: 浅灰底从底部升起紫橙柔焦 blob，随后整个底色在约 0.36s 内压暗到近黑、blob 压成余晖；文案同步 blur-out 换句 blur-in，换句间留空档不 cross-fade
upstream.use: 叙事转折点（"多年以来…→一切都变了"）；品牌片从铺垫拉到重音的那一拍；深浅色系之间的段落切换
upstream.energy: 由低到高（前 2/3 是酝酿，压暗那一瞬是全片重音）

upstream.name: 光斑飞线接力
upstream.summary: A+B 焊接：光斑 surge 与卡脉冲共用落点帧，涨亮 1+1.6×surge、5f 起升 15f 消散
upstream.use: 全片唯一暗场段落的氛围与数据叙事：铺底噪用 A、讲数据流向用 B、要背景给前景搭腔用 C；Linear 官网味
upstream.energy: A 低（底噪级）/ B 中 / C 中高

summary.en: The handset look: a head-on code-drawn device on a near-black or porcelain ground, one accent for the region in play, Inter Tight in the margin, IBM Plex Mono for notes and the source line.
summary.zh: handset 的样式：近黑或瓷白底上一台正面、代码画的设备，一个只标当前区域的强调色，页边用 Inter Tight，注释与来源行用 IBM Plex Mono。

bricks.fits: Launches whose claim can be seen on the product’s own screen: real captures of pages, pickers, docs, official charts.
bricks.notFor: Products with no screen; stories of many artefacts side by side; anything that needs a drawn UI.

intent.en: A quiet, locked-off frame where the only colour is the product’s own screen and one mark pointing at it.
intent.zh: 安静、固定的画面：唯一的颜色是产品自己的屏幕，加一个指向它的标记。

content.en: Real captures of the product (2× or 3×); short margin copy (a value ≤ 10 chars, lines ≤ 18 chars).
content.zh: 产品的真实截图（2 倍或 3 倍像素）；页边短文案（数值 ≤ 10 字符，一行 ≤ 18 字符 / 14 字）。

fits.zh: 能在产品自己的屏幕上看到主张的发布：真实的页面、选择器、文档、官方图表截图。

notFor.zh: 没有屏幕的产品；多件物料并排对照的故事；需要画出来的界面。

en: Take another preset when the accent sits within ΔE00 20 of a colour filling the ringed region.
Never draw a UI on the screen; only captures go there.
zh: 强调色与被圈区域里的主色 ΔE00 不足 20 时换一套配色。
屏幕上不画界面，只放截图。

summary.en: The split look: paper for what is written, a dark bench behind real results, one accent that is the seam between them; Archivo semi-expanded for claims, JetBrains Mono for everything that really is code.
summary.zh: split 的样式：写的东西在纸面上，真实结果在深色台面上，唯一的强调色就是两者之间的接缝；主张用 Archivo 半宽体，真正的代码一律 JetBrains Mono。

bricks.fits: Developer tools whose input maps line by line to an output: generators, compilers, config files, CLIs with a report, diff tools.
bricks.notFor: Products with no visible output; benchmark launches; a one-screen app.

intent.en: Show cause and effect as two sides of one edit: the line written, the result it made.
intent.zh: 把因果呈现为一次编辑的两边：写下的一行，和它做出的结果。

content.en: Real outputs (frames, renders, pages) and the real input text that made them (a request, a list, file lines, a command, a one-line diff).
content.zh: 真实的输出（画格、渲染、页面）和做出它们的真实输入（请求、列表、文件行、命令、一行 diff）。

fits.zh: 输入与输出逐行对应的开发者工具：生成器、编译器、配置文件、带报告的命令行、diff 工具。

notFor.zh: 没有可见输出的产品；跑分发布；单屏应用。

en: The seam within ΔE00 20 of a colour filling a result it crosses reads as part of the result: take `diff-plum` for green or teal results.
Never dim, tint or grain a result: the seam already says which side is in play.
zh: 接缝色与它穿过的结果里大面积颜色 ΔE00 小于 20 会被看成结果的一部分：绿或青的结果换 `diff-plum`。
结果不加暗、不染色、不加颗粒：接缝已经说明哪边在说话。

summary.en: The blueprint look: one engineering drawing on reprographic paper, line work in two weights, one amber for a person's annotation or approval, a fine and a major drafting grid, a drifting lamp, IBM Plex Sans Condensed and Plex Mono on ISO 3098's √2 series.
summary.zh: blueprint 的样式：一张印在晒图纸上的工程图，两种线宽，唯一的琥珀色只给人的批注和批准，细、粗两级制图网格，缓慢移动的灯光；字体 IBM Plex Sans Condensed 与 Plex Mono，字号按 ISO 3098 的 √2 系列。

bricks.fits: Products that are a system with parts, a plan a person signs and machine checks: rollout, backup, migration, pipeline tools.
bricks.notFor: Consumer products, emotional stories, anything without structure to draw; films that need people or photographs.

intent.en: A launch drawn as an engineering drawing: every line drafted, the product shown as a designed system, amber only where a person signs.
intent.zh: 把发布画成一张工程图：每根线都是画出来的，产品是被设计出来的系统，只有人签字的地方用琥珀色。

content.en: A system with 3–9 things to draw (problem, arrangement, details, checks), a person who decides at least once, a name and URL.
content.zh: 一个能画成 3–9 张图的系统（问题、布置、详图、检查），至少一次由人决定，产品名和网址。

fits.zh: 由部件组成、有人签字的计划和机器检查的产品：发布、备份、迁移、流水线工具。

notFor.zh: 消费类产品、情绪故事、没有结构可画的东西；需要人物或照片的片子。

en: The condensed family is registered as `Plex Condensed` (the template's name, tools/fonts.json); a host that loads it as IBM Plex Sans Condensed must alias it.
The ISO series has no step at 40: Chinese notes at 40 px sit off the series, which is intended.
zh: 窄体字族按模板的名字注册为 Plex Condensed（tools/fonts.json）；宿主若以 IBM Plex Sans Condensed 加载须起别名。
ISO 系列没有 40 这一级：中文注释用 40 px 是有意偏离。

summary.en: The dossier look: real published pages laid one at a time on a near-black mat, on paper mounts with hard stacked edges, the rest of each page veiled, a single highlighter colour for a published claim and its proof, serif claims and mono terms on the mat, a ruled worksheet that computes, a locked camera.
summary.zh: dossier 的样式：真实发布的页面一张张放在近黑的垫板上，贴在有硬边叠层的纸托上，页面其余部分压暗，只有一种荧光笔颜色标出已发布的断言和它的证据；垫板上是衬线断言和等宽条件，旁边一张会计算的格子演算纸，镜头锁定。

bricks.fits: Claims that can be shown where they were published: benchmark tables, price lists, changelogs, charts, app screens; 20–45 s.
bricks.notFor: Products without published evidence; mechanisms to explain; mood pieces.

intent.en: Make the viewer trust a claim by showing it where it was printed, struck like evidence in a file.
intent.zh: 让观众相信一条断言：把它在原出处展示出来，像卷宗里的证据一样划出。

content.en: 2–5 real published pages (captured at 2×) with the line each claim is printed on; one figure to compute.
content.zh: 2–5 张真实发布的页面（2 倍截图）以及每条断言所在的那一行；一个要计算的数字。

fits.zh: 能在原出处展示的断言：跑分表、价格表、更新日志、图表、应用截图；20–45 秒。

notFor.zh: 没有公开证据的产品；需要讲解的机制；氛围片。

en: The accent means only a published claim and its proof: the stroke, the leader's core, the stickers and tabs, the struck name and result.
Never recolour, retouch or rebuild a page: crop, scale (≤ 4/3) and the uniform veil only.
zh: 强调色只表示已发布的断言及其证据：划痕、引线芯、贴纸和标签、被划的名字和结果。
页面不许改色、修图或重排：只能裁切、缩放（≤ 4/3）和统一的压暗。

source.path: the dossier source film, layout.js, film.js type

summary.en: The exhibit look: real prints in neutral mounts on a light (or dark) desk under an overhead camera, label stock for mounts, chips and readings, one pencil for what the film points at.
summary.zh: exhibit 的样式：顶拍的浅色（或深色）桌面上，真实截图装在中性卡纸框里；框、标签、读数都用标签纸色，只有一支铅笔色标出片子正在指的东西。

bricks.fits: Launches argued from published evidence: official tables, charts, release pages, the product’s own screens.
bricks.notFor: Films with no real asset; dense dashboards; anything that needs a drawn UI.

intent.en: A curator’s desk: the evidence is real and untouched, the film only points at it with one pencil.
intent.zh: 策展人的工作台：证据真实、原样，片子只用一支铅笔去指。

content.en: 3–5 real captures (16:9 crops of ≥ 1200 × 675 source px), each with its source line; short captions (≤ 6 words / 16 字).
content.zh: 3–5 张真实截图（16:9 裁切，源像素 ≥ 1200 × 675），各带来源行；短说明（≤ 6 词 / 16 字）。

fits.zh: 用公开证据立论的发布：官方表格、图表、发布页、产品自己的界面。

notFor.zh: 没有真实素材的片子；密集的仪表盘；需要画界面的场合。

en: Ring one region at a time and keep the accent ΔE00 ≥ 20 from the colours inside it.
Assets are only cropped, scaled and veiled: never recolour or rebuild them.
zh: 一次只圈一处，强调色与圈内颜色 ΔE00 ≥ 20。
素材只裁切、缩放、加遮罩：不重新上色、不重画。

summary.en: The trace look: a flat dark diagram where a run draws the picture, four semantic colours with one meaning each, a serif for the author, a mono for the run, a sans for the narration.
summary.zh: trace 的样式：平涂深底的图解，画面由运行结果画出；四种语义色各只有一个含义，衬线体讲观点，等宽体给运行数据，无衬线体讲解。

bricks.fits: Explainers of a mechanism that runs on a tiny input: tokenising, compressing, sorting, counting; any proof by a run.
bricks.notFor: Launch films; claims with no mechanism; anything that needs photographs or a brand colour.

intent.en: A mechanism is believed because it is seen running: the picture is the run's state, with four colours that each mean one thing.
intent.zh: 机制被相信，是因为看见它在跑：画面就是运行状态，四种颜色各只表示一件事。

content.en: A small input the mechanism really runs on (four to six rows); captions and a thesis.
content.zh: 机制真能跑的小输入（四到六行）；说明和结论。

fits.zh: 在小输入上运行的机制讲解：分词、压缩、排序、计数；任何用一次运行来证明的东西。

notFor.zh: 发布片；没有机制的主张；需要照片或品牌色的片。

en: Every colour has one meaning; using the accent for emphasis breaks the legend.
Source Serif 4 and Noto Serif SC are not in tools/fonts.json: samples show the sans instead of the serif.

bricks.notFor: A film: it carries no point of view.

notFor.zh: 成片：它没有立场；一支片要用某个风格的样式。

zh: 不是成片的样式：用它做的片读起来像没做完的小样。

summary.en: The halftone look: warm newsprint, one black plate and one process ink that prints only the anchor; every picture a procedural field printed as an AM screen; Bricolage Grotesque and IBM Plex Mono.
summary.zh: halftone 的样式：暖色新闻纸，一块黑版加一种只印锚点的印刷色；所有画面都是程序生成的场，用调幅网点印出；字体 Bricolage Grotesque 与 IBM Plex Mono。

bricks.fits: Launches of models and tools that want a printed, editorial feel with one recurring brand piece.
bricks.notFor: Screenshots and UI demos; films with several brand colours; photographic material.

intent.en: The film reads as printed: one black plate, one process ink kept for the brand piece, and every picture a field of dots that change size, never grey.
intent.zh: 整支片像印出来的：一块黑版，一种只留给品牌件的印刷色，所有画面都是只变大小、不变灰度的网点场。

content.en: A product mark with one separable piece (the anchor), four to six features each with a word.
content.zh: 一个能拆出一块（锚点）的产品标志，四到六个各配一个词的功能。

fits.zh: 想要印刷感、编辑感的模型和工具发布片，有一个反复出现的品牌件。

summary.en: The line presses a word into itself, takes its weight, then grows into a bar that a blade cuts into the next word.
A word leaves up through the top rail, the rails breathe to the next word, which rises in from the bottom rail.
A line of fixed length curls into a ring, or one outline morphs into the next while turning through its symmetry angle.
Three lines from the centre and three dashed hidden edges turn a flat hexagon into a cube without moving anything.
A box opens along its edges into a flat cross; the six squares slide and stretch into the panels of a layout.
One rounded rectangle springs from one interface state to the next; its content leaves first and enters after it lands.
Bar tops become points and the bars thin away; a trend curve then draws through the same points.
The line rolls up a loop and carries its sentence round and out; the next sentence follows it in and the loop opens.
A card collapses into its node, a pulse runs along the line (splitting into lanes), and the next nodes bloom into cards.
A frame jumps one candidate per half beat, laps the row, slows and locks on the answer; the others step back.
A word shrinks into its dot; the dot holds, squashes, bursts into particles that condense into the next word.
The film's pieces fly along arcs into the cells of the mark; a ring marks the empty cell and the dot lands in it last.
The anchor the eye is on stays put while the world around it is replaced; a final pull-back shows it is part of the mark.
A stream of lines runs past at speed, brakes exponentially and stops with the key item in the reading band.

variants.label: card rows of three heights; the key row stops at the middle, lifts and outlines while the rest dim
overshoot brake: sprint, run 30 px past the stop, come back, then lock

summary.en: A line resolves left to right; each cell flickers through the content's own alphabet until it locks.

variants.label: cycle: phrases pass through one fixed-width slot, scrambling, jittering and splitting with the noise; the last lands clean

summary.en: A word squashes into a line that becomes a looping path; a token runs it and the loops shrink until it is straight.
One halftone wave field changes parameters: a second source spreads, a front quantizes it, the blocks resolve into a sprite.
The next scene waits inside a letter's counter; the camera pushes through the counter until it is the frame.

variants.label: through a stroke: the letters are cut out of the cover and the camera pushes into the stem of one

summary.en: A staircase front whose steps are the next chart's values wipes across; the old bars retract into it; it stays as the chart.
The old picture fades as phosphor afterglow; the beam returns and draws the new path, then the new reading settles.
The ringed cells of a real asset rise in place and grow; their numbers are redrawn in code; the asset dims beneath (or the numbers land in the next scene).
The asset fills the frame first; as the camera pulls back, its window grows outward from the asset's edges, titled with the source.

fits: every mode with real assets (an asset's first appearance)

summary.en: The window stays still; the asset inside pushes in on the region to read, never past its source resolution.

variants.label: crash zoom with a rebound: pull back, slam in, pass the landing by 6 % and come back, an accent flash
crash zoom with a dead stop: pull back, slam in, the frame outside the region flashes and the window shakes

summary.en: The asset dims to half; one hard-edged band stays lit and moves to the next region to read.
A value lifts off one asset, rides a one-screen pan, and lands on the same value printed in a second asset.
Assets lie side by side on one plane; the camera trucks about a screen to the next, blurred only while fast.

variants.label: travel across several screens: slow start, sprint, brake in the last 12 %, then a 1.28× push on the landing

summary.en: A hidden cut inside one object, not a hand-off: the window turns edge-on, its content is swapped on the frame no face shows, and it turns back with the next page.

variants.label: turn over: a lean back, an accelerating turn past the back, a settle; a lift and a light near edge-on

summary.en: An accent line, led by a small dot, draws from a claim to its source in a real asset; a ring closes round the source.

variants.label: flyline: a glowing line grows out-cubic behind a bright head, its tail fading; the target pulses on arrival

summary.en: The official logo shrinks and flies to the top left to become a window's title; the window opens from there.
A long page is flicked through a still window, pulls back while fast, and coasts to an exact stop on the next section; headings pin as chapters.

fits: scroll (the through-line: every move along the sheet)
every mode with a long page

summary.en: The page flies back to its top: it accelerates, streaks past everything between and brakes softly onto the first section.

fits: scroll (the return to the top before the lock-up)
handset (back to the top of a page)
every mode with a long page

summary.en: Headings that reach the top stay pinned as the chapter while their section scrolls under them; the next one pushes them out.

fits: handset (a long page in the screen)
every mode with a long page

summary.en: A row opens in place: the page below slides down while what the row carries is revealed from the fold line.

fits: any mode whose page has rows that carry more

summary.en: The paper roll drops and the sheet hangs where it passed, or comes back up and winds the sheet onto itself.
The next screen slides up over the current one like the next post in a feed; the current one steps back into a deck.

fits: every mode with a run of screens

summary.en: Frames on a strip of film move through a fixed gate, a pull-down at a time or in one run, and stop with the next frame registered.

fits: strip (the through-line: every move of the reel)
exhibit (a contact strip on the desk)
every mode with a sequence of frames

summary.en: A registered frame punches to the full frame, or the full frame shrinks into its place in the next scene.

fits: strip (a frame to the full frame and back)
every mode with a frame in a gate or a cell of a sheet

summary.en: The cell the grease pencil ringed on the contact sheet punches to the full frame; the ring stays on the sheet.

fits: strip (the pick on the contact sheet)
exhibit (a contact sheet on the desk)
every mode with a grid of thumbnails

summary.en: A seam is cut down the content (or a caret stands up into it); the halves part like pocket doors, or the next content slides out of the seam.

fits: split (the opening: the caret becomes the seam)
every mode with two related contents

variants.label: barn door: the next content comes up from 1.08 to 1 as the halves part
close with impact: the next content's halves slam shut over the current one, a flash and a shake on the hit

summary.en: The content is cut into slats (along a table's own rows); each slat pushes sideways in turn and brings in a slice of the next content.

fits: split (a change of result beside the seam)
every mode with a table or a list

variants.label: each slat turns over about its own axis, the next content on its back, the wave speeding up

summary.en: A copy of the seam crosses the frame; behind it the next state, ahead of it the current one.

fits: split (input and result change at once)
every mode whose frame is divided by a rule

summary.en: The seam moves, then a branch runs down from it and opens a second result pane behind its tip.
Two registered renders of one frame either side of the seam; the seam moves and the after takes over.

fits: every mode with two renders of one frame

variants.label: scrub: wind back, fling, settle, hold, scrub back; a grip that stretches with speed; tags cut by the seam

summary.en: The claim, set large in code, fills with its evidence through the letters, then the letters swell until the asset fills the frame.

fits: every mode at a claim with its evidence

summary.en: The frame pulls back into a grid of its siblings, a ring hops to the next tile, and the camera dives into it.

fits: exhibit (zoom out to the table of prints)
every mode with a set of screens

summary.en: The next asset assembles over the current one as a mosaic of tiles that grow from points, outward from the claim.
A ticker band drops down the frame wiping in the next asset; its crawl carries the next source in and stops as the caption.

fits: every mode whose scenes carry a source line

summary.en: The camera slides to the next exhibit; numeral, window and caption chip move at three depths and land together.

variants.label: depth cues: far numerals out of focus, front chips soft with speed, the landing window lifts; rates 0.5 / 1 / 2

summary.en: The top sheet is drawn out to the side and tucked under the pile; the sheet beneath squares up to be read.
Push in on a value, cut on a still frame to the same value printed in the next source at the same place and size, pull back.

fits: every mode with two sources of one value

summary.en: Ink wicks through absorbent paper from a few brush touches; dark rims, uneven wash, the new frame where it settles.

variants.label: hair: the wet front runs ahead along the paper's fibres in fine hairs, with a longer pale halo

summary.en: A drop lands and blooms like ink in water; a rolling ring of ink opens the new frame inside it.
The dot swells into a hard-edged disc that opens on the new frame (or the frame closes down to the dot).

variants.label: anchor: the disc opens from a circle already in the frame, without an ink ring; the old frame is pushed away about it and dimmed

summary.en: One line draws down the frame and opens like a seam into curling marbled dye; the new frame is inside.
An ink shutter runs up each of the twelve grid columns in turn; the new poster is behind it.
A print lamp crosses the sheet; the new drawing develops behind it, line work first, then full colour.
The picture collapses like a CRT switched off (height, then width, to a dying spot) and the new one powers on.
An ordered-dither front sweeps out from the origin; cells flick on in the phosphor accent, then show the new frame.
The frame splits into unit tiles; each is marked in place, then turns over to the new frame, in order from the origin.
A front carried by a vector field sweeps across; content is dragged along the streamlines it lights up.
The token bar’s cells grow into bars that sweep over the frame, then fall back to uncover the new one.
The subject's own outline grows from its centre and floods the frame; inside it, the same geometry in the next material.
The word holds its place while an aperture (band, circle, closing bars or a cut) opens onto the next ground.
The new card pushes the old one off with a strong motion streak along the push that is gone on landing.

variants.label: brake: accelerate into the streak, swap in it, stop hard with a long tail

summary.en: The frame is cut into text-line bands that slide off with streaks; the new frame's bands arrive as streaks that resolve.
The frame is exposed up to white, two white frames cut, and the answer lands with blur, scale and colour offset decaying to zero.

variants.label: in place: exposed to white, two white frames, the other version comes back out of the white where the first was

summary.en: A defocused straightedge sweeps past the lens; the old frame becomes the new one entirely under its body.

variants.label: card: an oversized interface card sweeps upright past the lens, well out of focus; the cut hides under it
